The Lighthouse Restaurant.summary: The Lighthouse Restaurant, run by lady entrepreneur Prathiksha Nayak, is struggling to stay afloat during these tough times. The restaurant, known for its coastal cuisine, offers dishes like Alle piao, stuffed pomfret, and unicorn special prawns.  The video highlights the importance of supporting local restaurants like The Lighthouse, especially during these challenging times.

The Lighthouse Restaurant.title: Homestyle COASTAL FARE At THE LIGHTHOUSE RESTAURANT | A Homemaker’s Expression Of Food & Memories
The Lighthouse Restaurant.address: No. 62, 80 feet road, Near MS Ramaiah Hospital, opposite to apple store Devasandra, Village, RMV 2nd Stage, Ashwath Nagar, R.M.V. 2nd Stage, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560094

best_dishes.name: Squid Koliwada
best_dishes.summary: Squid cooked with koliwada masala, a spicy and flavorful dish.

best_dishes.name: Prawn Ghee Roast
best_dishes.summary: Prawns cooked in a ghee roast masala with coconut and cashew, a milder version of the traditional dish.

best_dishes.name: Prawn Hinga Udha
best_dishes.summary: A gently poached prawn curry with asafoetida and coconut oil, best enjoyed with boiled rice.

best_dishes.name: Kori Rotti
best_dishes.summary: Chicken curry with a savory onion punch, coconut, coriander, cumin, and mustard seeds, served with dry roti.

The Lighthouse Restaurant.summary: The Lighthouse Restaurant, run by Prathiksha Nayak, offers a unique dining experience that feels more like a South Canara home than a restaurant. The menu features coastal fare from the Kundapur-Mangalore belt, with a focus on family recipes and dishes inspired by legendary establishments along the West Coast. Some of the must-try dishes include the Squid Koliwada, Prawn Ghee Roast, and Prawn Hinga Udha. While the restaurant also offers Chinese and North Indian cuisine to cater to its diverse clientele, it's the coastal fare that truly shines. The highlight of the restaurant is its commitment to preserving and showcasing the flavors of coastal Karnataka.

Mane Holige.title: Tasting 8 Varieties Of Holige At MANE HOLIGE! Bele, Badam, Jackfruit, Gulkand, Dates, Pineapple..
Mane Holige.address: Mane Holige Jayanagar, 126, 30th Cross Rd, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011

Bele Holige.name: Bele Holige
Bele Holige.summary: A classic holige with lentil and jaggery filling

Badam Holige.name: Badam Holige
Badam Holige.summary: A rich holige with almond filling

Jackfruit Holige.name: Jackfruit Holige
Jackfruit Holige.summary: An unusual holige with jackfruit filling

Mane Holige.summary:
Mane Holige in Jayanagar, Bangalore is a popular holige shop that offers 23 varieties of holige. They are known for their traditional bele holige, as well as unique varieties like jackfruit and badam. The holige are made fresh to order and are served hot with ghee. The shop also has a wide variety of other snacks and sweets.  

**What makes this restaurant unique?** They offer a whopping 23 varieties of holige!

YELNEER KATTE.title: Cooling Down With Bengaluru’s Latest TENDER COCONUT SHAKE Trend! ‘Original' YELNEER KATTE
YELNEER KATTE.address: 57, E Anjaneya St, Gandhi Bazaar, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004

Katte Special.summary: Coconut flesh crushed with coconut milk, cream and nuts, this is the one to have if you prefer tasting the ‘coconutty’ character. The nuts and raisins also add to the nutty flavor and thick texture of this shake, the pomegranate seeds provide a fruity pop and the swirl of condensed milk a rich, creamy finishing touch. The sweetness is just right.

Yelneer Mango Shake With Vanilla Ice Cre.summary: A loaded shake, coconut flesh ground with coconut water and fresh mango, topped with vanilla ice cream, chocolate syrup, nuts, fresh mango and some condensed milk. A tasty milkshake, but one cannot taste much of the coconut as it is overpowered by the ice cream, chocolate sauce and a copious amount of sugar.

YELNEER KATTE.summary: This video reviews Yelneer Katte, a popular spot in Bengaluru known for its unique coconut-based desserts and drinks. The reviewer particularly recommends the Katte Special, a refreshing blend of coconut flesh, milk, cream, and nuts, praising its authentic coconut flavor and balanced sweetness.  He finds the Yelneer Mango Shake less impressive, as the coconut flavor is overwhelmed by the mango, ice cream, and chocolate. The highlight of Yelneer Katte is its creative use of tender coconut in various forms, offering a refreshing twist on traditional desserts.

Tarayi Coastal Cuisine.title: TARAYI COASTAL CUISINE | This Family Eatery Is A Labour Of Love! Fish Thali, Ghee Roast, Crab Masala
Tarayi Coastal Cuisine.address: #7, 3rd Main Road, karavalli Road, KK Halli, St Thomas Town, Post, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560084

best_dishes.summary: Prawns cooked in a slightly sour, warm and spicy ghee roast masala

best_dishes.name: Crab Masala
best_dishes.summary: Crab meat in an aromatic masala of onions, tomatoes and spices

best_dishes.name: Fish Thali
best_dishes.summary: A budget friendly thali with portions of mackerel curry and fry, sambar, rasam, vegetables and boiled rice

Tarayi Coastal Cuisine.summary:
Tarayi Coastal Cuisine is a small family eatery in St. Thomas Town, East Bengaluru, run by Freeda Ananth and her husband Vijay Ananth. Freeda, wanting to share her late mother's culinary legacy and start her own business, opened Tarayi. They serve Mangalorean-Kundapur fare with a Kerala influence. The food is homestyle and affordably priced.  Must-try dishes include their Prawn Ghee Roast, Black Pomfret Fry, Crab Masala, and Fish Thali. 

Highlight: Tarayi is a true labor of love, a small family-run eatery with a big heart, serving delicious and authentic coastal cuisine.

NRK BAMBOO BIRIYANI.title: This Biryani Is Steamed In Bamboo For Two Hours! NRK BAMBOO BIRIYANI Food Truck, Mysuru
NRK BAMBOO BIRIYANI.address: NRK Bamboo Biryani, Water Tank, Vijayanagar Chat Street, High Tension Double Road, Vijayanagar, Mysuru, Karnataka 570016

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A unique biryani where semi-cooked mutton masala is layered with aromatic rice and egg inside a bamboo cylinder and steamed for two hours. The bamboo imparts a distinct aroma to the biryani and the masala infuses the rice and meat.

NRK BAMBOO BIRIYANI.summary: This video features NRK Bamboo Biryani, a food truck in Mysuru, run by Ramamurthy.  The highlight is their unique Bamboo Biryani available in chicken and mutton variants. The biryani is prepared by layering meat masala, rice and egg inside a bamboo cylinder and steaming it for two hours. This method gives the biryani a distinct aroma and taste.

Ganga\u2019s Mudde Mane.title: GANGA’S MUDDE MANE | Homely Gowda Cuisine| This Brave Couple Makes A Fresh Start Despite Challenges!
Ganga\u2019s Mudde Mane.address: Ganga’s Mudde Mane, 3rd cross, Manjunath Nagar, Kanakapura Rd, Raghuvanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560062

Kaal Soup.summary: An aromatic soup that serves well to whet your palate. The tomato conveys a pulpy texture laden with the meaty broth.

Brain Fry.summary: Flavoured with the lightest touch of spice, pepper and curry leaves, the ‘bheja’ is cooked to perfection and melts in its rich buttery lushness when placed in the mouth. If you love the brain, a must-order here!

Chicken Tava Roast.summary: Marinated in a green chilli, ginger garlic paste, it is the freshness of the mint that shines through the masala.

Boti Kal Goju.summary: A thick preparation enlivened with the starchiness of raw banana and nourishment of lentils, the boti is cooked through well.

Mutton Kheema Ball Curry.summary: The kheema unde is rich in its meatiness and is complemented by the green chilli and coriander. Eat this hot to prevent the gram flour, used to bind the meat, from making its presence felt on the palate.

Chicken Kheema Goju.summary: Tiny cubes of chicken tossed in a tasty masala. What makes this dish interesting are flecks of yam that bring its earthy flavours.

Nalli Fry.summary: A weighty lamb shank, some of the meat has a bit of a bite, but as you work your way to the core of the nalli, the meat is tender. There is depth of flavour from the spices and the pepper.

Veg Meals.summary: A vegetarian will enjoy this simple but homely assemblage with as much gusto as a non vegetarian. From the scrumptious dill fritters to the comforting sprouts saaru and rasam, each dish bears the mark of a talented home cook, in this case, Nalini Hemant Kumar. I would happily order this with a non-vegetarian side.

Mutton Peas Pulav.summary: Made three days a week, this is a pulao that is moist, gentle and aromatic. The aroma of the whole spices is what one tastes on the palate alongside the faint warmth of green chillies whose heat has been toned down by some coconut milk that goes into the pulao just before it is placed on dum. The meat in the pulao is soft and has a bit of fat ribboned through it, the peas are endearing in their soft bite.

Ganga\u2019s Mudde Mane.summary:
Ganga’s Mudde Mane is a small eatery run by a couple, Hemanth Kumar and Nalini, serving authentic Gowda cuisine.  Hemanth, a seasoned cook with 15 years of experience, and Nalini, a former teacher who joined to support her husband,  prepare each dish with a homely touch. The restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring classics like Kaal Soup, Brain Fry, Chicken Tava Roast, and their signature dish, Mutton Nalli Fry.  A standout feature is their commitment to using fresh, local ingredients, evident in the vibrant flavors and aromas. Despite facing initial challenges, their courage and determination shine through in the delicious, hearty meals they serve.  

Highlight:  A unique aspect of Ganga’s Mudde Mane is their dedication to preserving the authenticity of Gowda cuisine, using traditional recipes and techniques passed down through generations.

Nani Hotel.title: Tasty, Rustic Breakfast At NANI HOTEL, Vijayapura | Popular Ghee MASALA DOSA, Bele Bhath And More...

best_dishes.name: Tuppa Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A golden-brown dosa that is slightly thick and biscuity in its crunch and lush with ghee, cradling within its fold a creamy, flavourful palya. The chutney makes for a spicy accompaniment.

best_dishes.name: Bele Bhath/ Tomato Bhath/ Puliyogare/ Chitranna/ Kesari Bhath
best_dishes.summary: Tomato bhath and bele bath are must try

Nani Hotel.summary: This video is about a popular breakfast spot located 50 kilometers from Bangalore called Nani Hotel. The restaurant is known for its traditional South Indian breakfast dishes, especially their ghee masala dosa. The dosa is thick and crispy, and it comes with a spicy chutney and a creamy potato filling. Other popular dishes include idli, vada, bisi bele bhath, chitranna, tomato rice, masala vade, kesari bath, and coffee.  The highlight of the restaurant is its traditional food and the affordable price.

KAPPA CHAKKA KANDHARI.title: Tasting A Delicious, Traditional Kerala Meal | KAPPA CHAKKA KANDHARI | Ramassery Idli, Appam & Stew
KAPPA CHAKKA KANDHARI.address: 438, 18th Main Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095

best_dishes.name: Rajayogi Meal
best_dishes.summary: A set menu that’s fit for a king, this smorgasbord of a dozen dishes is sheer indulgence! Begin with juicy prawns in a coconut-kokum masala that is steamed in a petite banana leaf pouch, spicy ‘touchings’ of needle fish, the plumpest soft shell crabs, and a delicately flavoured pearl spot fish draped in a robust, toddy shop masala, amongst other delicacies that include a peppery chicken peralan and a slow-cooked mutton coconut fry. After an interlude of a sweet, sour and spicy, pineapple-nendram relish, the main courses troop out - pidi, tiny rice dumplings steeped in coconut milk and served with a flavourful simple chicken curry, a velvety mutton stew and appam combo, and a prawn puttu biryani that hits the spot. For dessert, there’s much to choose from, we tried the chilli-pricking kandhari ice cream and the luscious tender-coconut cloud pudding.

best_dishes.summary: NA

best_dishes.name: Koorka Fry

best_dishes.name: Ramassery Idli With Varutharacha Chicken Curry & Sambar
best_dishes.summary: The idli is aromatic and soft, slightly pasty, and has a bit of a weight that lends to combining with the sambar or spicy chicken curry.

best_dishes.name: Ayakora Nellikai Masala Fry
best_dishes.summary: A fish fry inspired by frugal tribal traditions, the fish is spiced with a paste of sun-dried gooseberries, green peppercorn and kandhari, bird’s eye chilli.

best_dishes.name: Cloud Pudding
best_dishes.summary: NA

KAPPA CHAKKA KANDHARI.summary: Kappa Chakka Kandhari restaurant in Bangalore serves traditional Kerala cuisine using ingredients sourced from specific regions in Kerala. Chef Regi Mathew, known for his culinary expertise, leads the restaurant. The video highlights the Rajayogi Meal, a grand set menu with various dishes like prawn in coconut-kokum masala, soft shell crabs, pearl spot fish, and more. The restaurant also offers a la carte options like Kappa Vada, Koorka Fry, Ramassery Idli with chicken curry, and Ayakora Nellikai Masala Fry. The unique aspect of Kappa Chakka Kandhari is its commitment to authenticity, using ingredients from their place of origin in Kerala, making it a true culinary experience.

SIDDY\u2019S PIZZA.title: Tasting North Bengaluru’s Best Pizza At SIDDY’S PIZZA | Veg Margherita, Chicken, Sicilian Pepperoni
SIDDY\u2019S PIZZA.address: 810, HIG, 1st & 2nd Stage, B-Sector Yelahanka, New Town Main Rd, Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064

Garlic Butter Bread.summary: Pillowy soft and gushing with garlic-infused buttery flavour; the butter is molten as the bread comes out of the oven! Changes your perspective of what simple garlic bread can be! The cheddar cheese dip makes for an indulgent accompaniment.

Classic Margherita & Cheese - Large.summary: Its dough fermented for a few hours, the pizza is firm and toasty, drooping at the edge, burdened under the weight of a generous topping of cheese. The sharp, spicy notes of the homemade tomato sauce, salsa semplice, is softened by the mozzarella.

Smoked Chicken & Cheese - Large.summary: The juicy personality of the chunky, smoked chicken franks take over the palate the moment you bite into this cracker of a pizza, followed then by the slightly, sweet crunch of the onions. The cheese and tomato sauce play second fiddle to the meat and onions. If you love smoked chicken, this pie is a must-have!

Classic Pepperoni & Cheese - Large.summary: Lush in virgin olive oil, this is a classic Sicilian style pizza, its ‘bready’ texture quite similar to a focaccia. There’s plenty of mozzarella that sits atop the pizza, followed by the spicy sauce and onions. But it is the fat-laden savoury fervour of the pepperoni that is the hero of this pizza! This pizza is also the sort that would make for a great midnight snack when left over in the refrigerator.

SIDDY\u2019S PIZZA.summary:
This video is a food review of Siddy's Pizza, a pizzeria in Yelahanka New Town, Bangalore. The reviewer is impressed by the quality of the pizzas, which are made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and cooked to perfection in a wood-fired oven. He especially enjoys the Smoked Chicken & Cheese pizza and the Classic Pepperoni & Cheese pizza. The reviewer also appreciates the restaurant's cozy atmosphere and friendly service. 

Highlight: What makes Siddy’s Pizza unique is that the owner, Siddy, makes everything from scratch, including the dough, sauce, and toppings. He also uses a traditional Sicilian recipe for his pizzas, which gives them a unique flavor and texture.

Vijay Kitchen.title: This Couple Serves The Authentic Taste Of Nellore | CHEPALA PULUSU | VIJAY KITCHEN | Andhra Bhojanam
Vijay Kitchen.address: 533, B Block, AECS Layout, Marathahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

best_dishes.name: Chepala Pulusu
best_dishes.summary: A sour and spicy fish curry made with tamarind, raw mangoes, chilli powder and a secret fenugreek spice blend.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Pepper Ghee Roast
best_dishes.summary: Moist and juicy mutton coated with coarsely ground pepper and tossed in ghee. The meat is cooked twice for a unique flavor.

best_dishes.name: RR Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: A fiery dish for spice lovers with chicken and lots of green chillies. Ask for ghee to tone down the heat.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Fry Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A popular dish made with leftover biryani rice topped with flavorful chicken fry.

Vijay Kitchen.summary: Vijay Kitchen, run by Sashidhar Reddy and Vijayalakshmi, offers authentic Nellore cuisine based on traditional family recipes. Their signature dish, Chepala Pulusu, is a must-try, made with a secret spice blend and slow-cooked for enhanced flavor. The restaurant prides itself on its use of fresh ingredients and traditional cooking methods, evident in dishes like Mutton Pepper Ghee Roast and the fiery RR Chilli Chicken. What makes Vijay Kitchen unique is its dedication to preserving the culinary heritage of Nellore, offering a taste of Andhra Pradesh in the heart of Bengaluru.

Sri Chikkaveeranna Sweets.title: SRI CHIKKAVEERANNA SWEETS | This 72-Year-Old Village Shop Serves PURE GHEE MITHAI & KHAARA Items!
Sri Chikkaveeranna Sweets.address: Sri Chikkaveeranna Sweets, Shidlaghatta Road, Vijayapura Town, Karnataka 562110

Tuppa Jilebi.name: Tuppa Jilebi
Tuppa Jilebi.summary: Made of a batter that is fermented overnight in a clay pot, and fried in pure ghee, the result is a white jilebi that crackles with a sticky bite and unburdens its ghee-laden sweetness with just a tinge of sourness.

Tuppa Avalakki.name: Tuppa Avalakki
Tuppa Avalakki.summary: Red rice puffed to a crisp in a bath of boiling ghee, comes together with ghee-roasted cashewnuts, curry leaves, Bengal gram and generous sprinkling of spices to make a seriously addictive khaara or mixture.

Mysore Pak.name: Mysore Pak
Mysore Pak.summary: Soft and crumbly, lush with ghee, this is the sort of Mysore Pak that dissolves on the palate with the light lilt of cardamom, when fresh. You can taste the weight of the gram flour, especially in the tiny clumps that have held on to the ghee as the gram flour is lightly roasted before it finds its way into the sugar syrup or paaka. The hero ingredient in this mithai though is the ghee that makes it Sri Chikkaveerana’s most popular mithai for over seven decades.

Badam Halwa.name: Badam Halwa
Badam Halwa.summary: Garnished with chironji seeds and slivers of pistachio and almonds, the halwa is rich with the reduced milk solid, ghee and the grainy bite of coarsely ground almonds. Although, the Mysore Pak is traditionally more popular here, the badam halwa comes a close second.

Sri Chikkaveeranna Sweets.summary: Sri Chikkaveeranna Sweets is a popular sweet shop in Vijayapura, Bengaluru, known for its pure ghee sweets and savouries. Established in 1948, the shop has been run by the same family for three generations.  Their signature dish is the Mysore Pak, made with a special technique of lightly roasted gram flour and generous amounts of ghee. Other must-try items include the Tuppa Jilebi, fermented overnight in clay pots, and the rich Badam Halwa made with homemade khoa. What makes this sweet shop unique is its commitment to tradition, using pure ghee and traditional recipes passed down through generations

THE TAMARA COORG.title: Kodava Breakfast, Spa Day, Bonfire Dinner… Fantastic Plantation Holiday At THE TAMARA COORG | Part 2
THE TAMARA COORG.address: The Tamara Coorg, Kabbinakad Estate, Yevakapadi, Napoklu Nad Madikeri, Karnataka 571212

THE TAMARA COORG.summary: This video is about a luxurious and relaxing stay at The Tamara Coorg resort. It showcases the beautiful scenery, the delicious food, and the various activities available to guests, including a spa day with organic treatments, a plantation walk and coffee brewing experience, and a bonfire dinner under the stars.  What makes the experience unique is the focus on local Kodava cuisine and the immersive plantation setting.

The Tamara Coorg.title: Delicious Cuisine, Amazing Luxe Holiday At THE TAMARA COORG | Spectacular Plantation Resort | Pt 1

The Tamara Coorg.summary: This video is a review of The Tamara Coorg, a luxurious coffee plantation resort in India. The host highlights the breathtaking views, refreshing nature trails, rejuvenating spa therapies, personalized coffee brewing, and bespoke dining experiences. The cuisine focuses on traditional Kodava food, showcasing the flavors of the land.  The unique aspect of this resort is its commitment to providing a luxurious and personalized experience, making it an ideal destination for a relaxing and indulgent getaway.

Royal Mess.title: ROYAL MESS | This Couple Serves Memorable Hyderabadi Mughlai Food At Their Mysuru Home Eatery!
Royal Mess.address: Royal Mess, 4th Cross Rd, S S Nagar, Siddique Nagar, Bannimantap, Mysuru, Karnataka 570015

best_dishes.name: Mutton Kheema
best_dishes.summary: A coarse and grainy mutton kheema cooked with meat on the bone, resulting in a deep-flavored and warming dish.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Masala
best_dishes.summary: A flavorful masala with gentle sweet flavors of fresh tomato and the savoriness of onions. The meat is soft with a bit of fat.

Royal Mess.summary: Royal Mess is a small home eatery in Mysore run by Sameena Khanum and her family. They serve delicious Hyderabadi-Mughlai cuisine, with dishes like Mutton Kheema and Mutton Masala being highly recommended.  The warm hospitality adds to the dining experience. Be sure to call ahead to check availability and consider ordering special dishes in advance. This hidden gem offers a taste of home-cooked Hyderabadi flavors in a cozy setting.

SAPA Sourdough & Pastry.title: Exploring SAPA Sourdough & Pastry | Mysuru’s Charming New Dessert Café | Must-Try Chocolate Tart!
SAPA Sourdough & Pastry.address: 1A, 13th Cross, Kalidasa Road, V.V Mohalla, Jayalakshmipuram, Mysuru, Karnataka 570012

best_dishes.name: Chocolate Chip Tea Cake
best_dishes.summary: Buttery and gooey with the chocolate chip, this cake could potentially make for a great accompaniment to coffee.

best_dishes.name: Oat Crumble & Vanilla Sour Cream Cheesecake
best_dishes.summary: A rich cheesecake with a slightly sour twang that is balanced by an oat crumble crust. With its delicate whiff of vanilla, this makes for an enjoyable cheesecake.

best_dishes.name: Chocolate Tart
best_dishes.summary: A must-try dessert, layers of dark chocolate and salted caramel ensconced in a biscuity chocolate tart shell, topped with pistachio crumb.

SAPA Sourdough & Pastry.summary: This video is a review of SAPA Sourdough & Pastry, a new coffee house in Mysore, India. The reviewer highlights the cafe's charming ambiance, delicious bakes, and delectable pastries. They highly recommend the salted caramel chocolate tart. The cafe offers a variety of other treats, including cheesecake and tea cake, all at reasonable prices.  What sets this cafe apart is its dedication to using high-quality ingredients, evident in their sourdough creations and flavorful pastries.

Shivalli.title: Traditional Breakfast At New SHIVALLI | Kotte Kadubu, Rajamudi Dosa, Kuchalakki Ganji, Ragi Ambli
Shivalli.address: Mudagere, Channapatna, Bangalore, Mysore Rd, Channapatna, Karnataka 562160

best_dishes.name: Kotte Kadubu
best_dishes.summary: Soft and slightly grainy, the kadubu is a much-sought-after breakfast delicacy here; savour it with their flavourful south canara sambar and spicy ‘kai’ chutney

best_dishes.name: Thenginkai Ganji
best_dishes.summary: Rice soaked in coconut milk and topped with a lashing of ghee. Pleasant in its aroma, flavour and texture, this is a porridge to savour if you’d like something light post a heavy meal the evening before. The cucumber served alongside provides an element of crunch.

best_dishes.name: Kuchalakki Ganji
best_dishes.summary: Boiled rice, sourced from Kundapur, cooked simply with salt and served with a drizzle of hot ghee. Comforting in its nourishing flavours, the rice retains its form and is soft to the bite, having lent some of its starchy heft to the broth. The hand pounded chutney of green chillies, fresh coconut and rock salt provides a spicy edge to the ganji.

best_dishes.name: Ragi Ambli
best_dishes.summary: The cumin is dominant in its flavour in this earthy but sumptuous broth of finger millets. There is also a delicate tinge of green chilli heat and pepper.

best_dishes.name: Neer Dosa
best_dishes.summary: The Rajamudi rice lends a brownish tinge to the dose, and also a crusty crunch. The dose is roasted with generous lashings of ghee, ensure you ask for your dose to be kadak. The flavours are quite unlike a traditional neer dose; although enjoyable on its own when hot, the bela kai, jaggery with fresh grated coconut makes for a delicious companion. If you like a touch of spice, there is the chutney too.

Shivalli.summary: Shivalli is a popular vegetarian restaurant on Mysore highway known for its traditional South Indian breakfast. Established 20 years ago, it has been recently renovated with a contemporary vibe while staying true to its roots of serving authentic cuisine.  The highlight of this restaurant is its use of traditional ingredients and recipes like the Rajamudi rice for Neer Dosa and the flavourful sambar and chutney that accompany the Kotte Kadubu.

Lakshman Mess.title: Lunch At LAKSHMAN MESS | Mysore’s Famous Naati (Local) Non Veg Eatery |Mutton Pulav, Curries & Fries
Lakshman Mess.address: No.87, 1,k 46/1, Santhepete Rd, Behind Mysuru City Corporation, KR Mohalla, Chamrajpura, Mysuru, Karnataka 570024

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: Chunks of meat that have a bit of bite, cooked in a delicious masala that is dominant in the flavour notes of coriander and mint, and the aroma of the special spice blend. The pepper coconut milk adds a layer of creamy warmth. This is the sort of dish that makes for an appropriate side dish to taste with the demure pulav.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Pulav
best_dishes.summary: Delicately flavoured and moist, the Lakshman Mess pulav employs a combination of the long-grained basmati and short-grained rice varieties. You taste the faint edge of the green chili alongside the mint and coriander, the whole spices too aren’t the sort that dominate the palate. The meat is tender and juicy.

best_dishes.name: Kaima
best_dishes.summary: Minced mutton balls simmered in a spicy gravy, spicy when compared to the mutton curry and pulav.

Lakshman Mess.summary: Lakshman Mess is a popular eatery in Mysore, known for its Naati style non-vegetarian cuisine. The restaurant is run by Lakshman and his son, Satya, who use recipes passed down from Lakshman's mother.  They started as a small pushcart operation and eventually opened this restaurant. They are known for their Mutton Pulav, Mutton Chops and Kaima. The highlight of Lakshman Mess is their commitment to using fresh, local ingredients and their affordable prices

Upahara Darshini (Deepu Gaadi).title: Must-Try Mysore’s Very Popular KUKKARAHALLI LAKE Breakfast Tradition | DEEPU GAADI & MYSURU KAAPI

best_dishes.name: Thatte idli
best_dishes.summary: Soft and a bit pasty, goes well with the chutney

best_dishes.name: Set masala dosa
best_dishes.summary: Well roasted, crisp and translucent dosa with spicy red chutney

Upahara Darshini (Deepu Gaadi).summary: This video is about a popular breakfast spot in Mysore called Upahara Darshini (Deepu Gaadi) located near Kukkarahalli lake. They are famous for their Set Masala Dosa, a smaller version of the regular dosa, allowing customers to enjoy more. The dosa is crisp and comes with a spicy red chutney. Another popular dish is the Thatte idli, known for its soft and pasty texture. A meal at Deepu Gaadi paired with filter coffee from Mysuru Kaapi makes for an authentic Mysore breakfast experience.  The unique aspect of this eatery is its location at a food rickshaw near the lake, adding to the charm of the traditional breakfast experience.

best_dishes.name: Kaima Sambar
best_dishes.summary: Mutton dumplings simmered in curry with springy bite to it

best_dishes.name: Mutton Fry
best_dishes.summary: Bannur mutton cooked with its own fat. The curry isn't too spicy

best_dishes.name: Bannur Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Biryani with kasoori methi, red chillies and spices. The meat is soft and moist, deep pink in its colour and veined with fat

Bannur Ramaswami Military Hotel.summary: This video is about Bannur mutton, Karnataka’s most prized mutton, which isn’t actually from Bannur but from Bandur. The video takes us on a culinary journey to Bannur Ramaswamy Military Hotel, a family eatery showcasing this special meat. The highlight of the video is the unique taste of the Bannur mutton, which is juicy and tender

Original KOTE IDLI KANAKAPURA.title: Serving Delicious Wood Fire Idlis For 50 Years | Original KOTE IDLI KANAKAPURA| 4 Idlis Rs. 10 Only!

best_dishes.name: Idlis
best_dishes.summary: The idlis are soft and porous, yielding with a slightly pasty texture. They are served with a spicy, roasted gram and red chilli chutney.

Original KOTE IDLI KANAKAPURA.summary: This video tells the inspiring story of Mr. Ramchandra, who has been serving delicious wood-fired idlis for 50 years at his shop, Original Kote Idli Kanakapura.  He wakes up at 4 am every morning to make the batter from scratch and steam over 3000 idlis, which are sold out before noon! The highlight of this eatery is the incredibly affordable price - four idlis for just Rs. 10!

best_dishes.name: Kaal Soup
best_dishes.summary: A peppery soup infused with the freshness of coriander.

best_dishes.name: Khaima Goju
best_dishes.summary: Mutton mince with a rustic rawness to the masala that is smoothed by the fluffy texture of the idli.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Leg Piece
best_dishes.summary: Chicken leg piece cooked soft and tender to the bone, you can taste the pungency of ginger garlic that’s softened by the acidity of tomatoes.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Fry
best_dishes.summary: Mutton fry with a blend of coriander and the heat of green chillies in the masala. The flavours are mild but satisfying.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Liver Fry
best_dishes.summary: Mutton liver fry with a gentle gravy and the added touch of peas.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: A unique chilli chicken with the fresh flavours of green chilli instead of overwhelming heat.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Kabab
best_dishes.summary: Scrumptious and flavourful chicken kabab, with moist and well-seasoned chicken.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Mildly flavoured Chicken Biryani, allowing the taste of the seeraga samba rice and individual spices to shine through.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Mutton Biryani where the tender and moist mutton enhances the flavours of the biryani, with its rich taste complementing the rice.

Halli Jonne Biryani.summary: This video tells the story of Halli Jonne Biryani, a popular eatery in Jayanagar, Bengaluru.  The owner, Ningaraju, started with a humble pushcart, driven by his passion for food and the need to support his family.  The highlight of his eatery is the uniquely mild-flavoured biryani served in traditional jonne (cups made of dried banana leaves).  The video provides an overview of the restaurant's journey, a glimpse into the making of the biryani, and a tasting of various dishes, showcasing the authentic flavours of Karnataka cuisine.

Amma Hotel.title: Most Popular FISH FRY in Kozhikode| Amma Hotel | Kingfish, Red Snapper,Fish Meals| Calicut Food Tour

best_dishes.name: Ayakora (Kingfish) Fry
best_dishes.summary: A thick slice of kingfish coated in a flavourful masala and fried to perfection. The masala has a spicy kick and is infused with the aroma of coconut oil. It pairs well with rice and lentil curry.

best_dishes.name: Chembali (Red Snapper) Fry
best_dishes.summary: A plump piece of red snapper, coated in Amma Hotel's special masala and fried. While the masala is spicy, it doesn't overpower the taste of the fish itself.

best_dishes.name: Fish Meals
best_dishes.summary: A satisfying and unlimited meal served on a banana leaf. It features kuruva rice, a flavourful vegetable paruppu curry, a simple choora (tuna) curry, valakaya (raw banana) upperi, and rasam.

Amma Hotel.summary:
Amma Hotel, a popular fish fry restaurant located in the bylanes of Puthiyara in Kozhikode, is a must-visit for locals and tourists alike. Known for its delicious and affordable seafood, the restaurant is particularly famous for its Ayakora (Kingfish) Fry and Fish Meal. The fish is coated in a secret masala and fried over a rubber wood fire, giving it a unique and delicious flavor. The Fish Meal, served on a banana leaf, is a complete and satisfying meal that is easy on the wallet.  

**Highlight:** The unique taste of Amma Hotel's fish fry comes from their secret masala recipe and the traditional method of frying the fish over a rubber wood fire.

Rahmath Hotel.title: Making & Tasting KOZHIKODE'S Famous RAHMATH HOTEL BIRYANI | Mutton, Chicken| ft@VolpeWhereAreYou
Rahmath Hotel.address: Aravind Ghosh Rd, Near Mathrubhumi Office, Mananchira, Kozhikode, Kerala 673001

best_dishes.name: Mutton stew
best_dishes.summary: An aromatic stew, the meat has soaked up the lush creaminess of the coconut milk and the savouriness of the onions which also lend a gentle bite. the potatoes in the stew also add to the body of this dish. The meat pieces are tender and thoughtfully sized small, make this a dish that’s convenient to share. Enjoy this with soft, puffy, rice pathiris.

best_dishes.name: Kallumakaya Fry
best_dishes.summary: Cooked in a thick gravy made of onions, tomatoes, green chillies, the kallumakaya or mussels are cooked to the perfect texture that results in a juicy, yielding bite of this mollusc. This preparation displays a harmonious balance of savoury, sweet, sour, the warmth that comes from slivers of ginger, and is perfect to be mopped up with the rice pathiri.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A steaming hot biryani, served with lemon and dates pickle, raita and salad, as typical to the region. The white leghorn chicken is cooked twice, first in the masala and next, as the biryani simmers on dum. The bird is juicy and moist. The flavour of the biryani is quite gentle, if you like it spicy, you can always perk things up with the lemon date and chilli pickle.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: This one-dish meal is a happy celebration of flavours. the meat, coated in a robust masala, is cooked to perfect doneness and is a juicy pink inside. the tomatoes lend a gentle acidity, thereby a unique to the biryani. you can never tire of a good biryani and this is definitely one of those.

best_dishes.name: Beef Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A flavourful biryani that jolts your senses awake. you can savour the hearty presence of the meat in the rice. the meat is tender, has a salty savouriness that complements the spices in the masala. you definitely taste the fulsome meat broth in every grain of rice.

Rahmath Hotel.summary: Rahmath Hotel in Kozhikode is a beloved culinary destination renowned for its exceptional meat biryanis, particularly their beef and mutton varieties.  The restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring chicken, fish, prawn, mussel, and squid biryanis, but it's the meat-based dishes that attract long queues of eager patrons, especially on weekends.  This video takes viewers on a captivating culinary journey through Rahmath Hotel, showcasing the meticulous preparation of their signature biryani.  What sets Rahmath Hotel's biryani apart is its focus on meat, incorporating generous portions of tender and flavorful meat into each dish.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Aromatic and flavorful rice dish cooked with tender chicken, spices, and ghee.

Paragon Restaurant.summary: Paragon is a must-visit restaurant in Kozhikode, Kerala, known for its iconic status and popularity. They are particularly famous for their Chicken Biryani, a flavorful rice dish cooked with tender chicken, spices, and ghee.

Paragon Restaurant.title: MAKING of CHICKEN BIRYANI at KERALA’s Most Popular PARAGON RESTAURANT, Kozhikode | Tasting 11 DISHES
Paragon Restaurant.address: Kannur Rd, near CH Over bridge, Kozhikode, Kerala 673001

best_dishes.name: PRAWN DRY FRY
best_dishes.summary: You taste the sweetness of the fresh prawns and the fragrance of the coconut oil in which this crustacean is fried. The prawn is perfectly seasoned and cooked textbook perfect to a yielding crunch and succulent inside.

best_dishes.name: PAN FRIED MUSSELS
best_dishes.summary: The mussels are cooked supple in a savoury mix of onions, curry leaves and green chillies. A play of flavours and textures, one tastes the toasty lilt of the curry leaves, the bite of the onions and gentle heat of the pepper.

best_dishes.name: TAMARIND FISH
best_dishes.summary: This Paragon creation teases the senses with its medley of flavours. You taste the sourness that comes from the vinegar, the sweetness of jaggery and the lingering warmth of ginger in the sauce in which the fried kingfish is tossed.

best_dishes.name: CRAB BHUMIKA
best_dishes.summary: I love the size of these juicy sea crabs, theyre soft and one can bite into them whole to relish the flavours of the dish. You taste the sweetness of the crab meat, the freshness of the ingredients, coriander, green chillies, ginger, garlic and the sour twang of lime.

best_dishes.name: AVOLI MOILEE
best_dishes.summary: The delicate white pomfret is the perfect accomplice to the mellow, soothing flavours of this creamy coconut stew, punctuated with the notes of kokum, curry leaves and green chilli. Enjoy this with a lacey appam.

best_dishes.name: MANGO FISH CURRY
best_dishes.summary: Another popular dish here, the ayakora or kingfish has imbibed the sour notes of the raw mango. The shallots add a robust bite and the heat from slivers of ginger contrasts with the slightly sour notes of this curry.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON VARTIYATHU
best_dishes.summary: A mutton preparation thats rich in flavour and texture. The meat, onions, tomatoes and spices have been slow-cooked for a few hours to come together in a lush gravy.

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN BIRIYANI
best_dishes.summary: The biriyani here is plated in a layered mound, milky white grains of the mildly aromatic kaima rice or jeerakasala rice sit at the crest, followed by a layer of masala-stained rice, a savoury ribbon of masala and fried onions separating the two.

Paragon Restaurant.summary: Paragon Restaurant in Kozhikode, Kerala, is a culinary institution known for its delicious Kerala cuisine. Established in 1939, it has gained popularity both within Kerala and internationally. The restaurant's Chicken Biryani is a must-try, made with fragrant rice, spices, and tender chicken. Other popular dishes include Prawn Dry Fry, Crab Bhumika, and Mango Fish Curry, each showcasing the unique flavors of Kerala. Paragon Restaurant offers a true taste of Kerala's rich culinary heritage. The highlight is the Paragon Chicken Biryani, made with a unique blend of spices and layered for a flavorful experience

Ravi Gobi.title: Exploring Bengaluru’s Love For The GOBI MANCHURIAN AT RAVI GOBI | Vegetarian Street Food
Ravi Gobi.address: Bindu Chinese Center, 1162, 22nd Main Rd, Siddanna Layout, Banashankari Stage II, Banashankari, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070

Babycorn Fry & Manchurian.summary: Crispy baby corn coated in a savory Manchurian sauce

Cauliflower Manchurian.summary: Crispy cauliflower florets coated in a savory Manchurian sauce

Ravi Gobi.summary: This video is about Ravi Gobi, a street food vendor in Bengaluru, India, who is famous for his delicious Gobi Manchurian. Ravi learned the recipe for his crowd-pleasing Manchurian sauce from a Chinese cook when he was 16 years old. He started out selling Gobi Manchurian from his auto 21 years ago, and he has been serving up delicious food to happy customers ever since. The video highlights Ravi's dedication to using fresh ingredients and making each dish to order. He offers a variety of Manchurian dishes, including cauliflower, cabbage, baby corn, mushroom, and potato. The host tries several of Ravi's dishes and gives them high ratings. The video also provides information on the location, timings, and price range of Ravi Gobi. Unique highlight:  Ravi's dedication to using fresh ingredients and making each dish to order makes his food stand out, evident by the long lines of customers

Ramesh Chit Chat.title: This Man ‘Invented’ The WHITE PAANI PURI! Tasting BANGARPET CHAAT At Ramesh Chit Chat In Bangarapet
Ramesh Chit Chat.address: Vijayanagar Road, near nandhi medical, Vivekanand Nagar, Bangarapet, Karnataka 563114

White Paani Puri.name: White Paani Puri
White Paani Puri.summary: A simple assemblage of green peas, onions, carrots and coriander, stuffed in a semolina and flour puri, topped with the potent ‘white paani’. The spiciness of paani though is toned down by the creaminess of the peas and the crunch of the onions. A simple, clean flavoured paani puri that allows one to appreciate every component singularly, as well as in its completeness.

Special Dahi Puri.name: Special Dahi Puri
Special Dahi Puri.summary: Embellished with rose petals, this chaat is a riot of flavours and textures. The crispiness of the chaat components and the spice of the masala play second fiddle to the creamy, sweet richness of the yoghurt that is fortified with Horlicks, milk powder and sugar.

Floating Paani Puri.name: Floating Paani Puri
Floating Paani Puri.summary: The floating paani puri is a spicy affair, the spicy white paani goes into the puri and also floats the puri. The moist crispness of the puri is endearing as is the crunch of the spiced peanuts and the sev, despite the fresh crunch of the onion, cucumber and tomato, there is no getting away from the chilli heat of the sea of white paani.

Tikki Masala Bangarpet.name: Tikki Masala Bangarpet
Tikki Masala Bangarpet.summary: A take on the Bengaluru masala puri, this is puri topped with spicy chutney, sweet chutney, peas, garam masala, squeeze of lime, onions, carrots, coriander, sev and puffed rice. It has all the components that you would expect to find in a chaat without being overdressed!

Special Sev Puri.name: Special Sev Puri
Special Sev Puri.summary: The flat papdi base for this chaat is fried in ghee which gives it a rich, ‘biscuity’ bite embellished with the nuttiness of sesame seeds. You can taste the edge of garlic in the chutney that the fresh ingredients are tossed in.

Ramesh Chit Chat.summary: This video features Ramesh Chit Chat in Bangarapet, Karnataka, known for its unique white paani puri. The owner, Ramesh, continues his family legacy of serving delicious chaat and innovating new dishes. The highlight is the white paani, a clear liquid with a surprisingly spicy kick.  The video showcases a variety of chaat options, including their famous White Paani Puri, Special Dahi Puri, Floating Paani Puri, and more. Each dish is described in detail, highlighting its unique flavors and textures. The reviewer particularly enjoys the Special Dahi Puri and the innovative Pizza Paani Puri. Ramesh's passion for his craft and his dedication to serving delicious and affordable food shine throughout the video.

Kaveri Godavari Foods.title: Blockbuster KGF - KAVERI GODAVARI FOODS | Tasty Curries, Dosa, Parotta Cooked In Wood Pressed Oil!
Kaveri Godavari Foods.address:
Location 1 (6pm to 10pm) Kaveri Godavari Foods, Next to Yellow Mart, PWD Road, Gurureddy Layout, Akash nagar, B. Narayanapura, Mahadevapura, Bangalore 560 016; 
Location 2 (1030pm to 2am) Kaveri Godavari Foods, Pai Layout (Behind VFM Honda showroom), Swami Vivekananda Road, KR Puram, Bangalore 560 016

best_dishes.name: Mutton Brain Fry
best_dishes.summary: Tava-fried with eggs in an aromatic, homemade masala, this is the dish to taste if you love brain meat; it quite simply melts in the mouth. The eggs also help make more of the dish that is perfect, mopped up with some parotta.

best_dishes.name: Kuzhambu Kalakki
best_dishes.summary: A Salem egg staple, egg cooked skilfully such that it encloses within its folds a gooey, spicy egg mixture. Traditionally, this is eaten at the end of a non-vegetarian meal in Salem.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Kari Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A fluffy dosa topped with coarse mutton mince, eggs and served with a spicy curry, this is the sort that makes for a satisfying one-dish meal or a big late-night snack.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: Goat chops cooked in a gravy rich in the flavour of dark-roasted spices, this is a dish that will bring me back to KGF. The meat is the sort that peels away from the bone in a juicy, peppery bite. Order a plain dosa to soak up the curry.

best_dishes.name: Podi Dosa
best_dishes.summary: One can smell the nutty aroma of the peanut oil that this dose has been roasted in. The dosa is smeared with an Andhra podi whilst being fried to a near crisp. A dose that goes ‘crunch’ from the first bite to the last, with a slightly tangy edge.

Kaveri Godavari Foods.summary: Kaveri Godavari Foods is a food truck located in East Bengaluru, serving up traditional Tamil Nadu cuisine with influences from Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. The food is cooked in wood-pressed oils extracted in the family’s oil mill, adding to the authenticity of the dishes. Some of their must-try dishes include the Mutton Brain Fry, Kuzhambu Kalakki, Mutton Kari Dosa, and Mutton Chops. What makes this food truck unique is that all the dishes are prepared at the owner's home and cooked in wood-pressed oils.

Kaveri Godavari Foods.title: Blockbuster KGF - KAVERI GODAVARI FOODS | Tasty Curries, Dosa, Parotta Cooked In Wood Pressed Oil!
Kaveri Godavari Foods.address:
Location 1 (6pm to 10pm) Kaveri Godavari Foods, Next to Yellow Mart, PWD Road, Gurureddy Layout, Akash nagar, B. Narayanapura, Mahadevapura, Bangalore 560 016; 
Location 2 (1030pm to 2am) Kaveri Godavari Foods, Pai Layout (Behind VFM Honda showroom), Swami Vivekananda Road, KR Puram, Bangalore 560 016

best_dishes.name: Mutton Brain Fry
best_dishes.summary: Tava-fried with eggs in an aromatic, homemade masala, this is the dish to taste if you love brain meat; it quite simply melts in the mouth. The eggs also help make more of the dish that is perfect, mopped up with some parotta.

best_dishes.name: Kuzhambu Kalakki
best_dishes.summary: A Salem egg staple, egg cooked skilfully such that it encloses within its folds a gooey, spicy egg mixture. Traditionally, this is eaten at the end of a non-vegetarian meal in Salem.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Kari Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A fluffy dosa topped with coarse mutton mince, eggs and served with a spicy curry, this is the sort that makes for a satisfying one-dish meal or a big late-night snack.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: Goat chops cooked in a gravy rich in the flavour of dark-roasted spices, this is a dish that will bring me back to KGF. The meat is the sort that peels away from the bone in a juicy, peppery bite. Order a plain dosa to soak up the curry.

best_dishes.name: Podi Dosa
best_dishes.summary: One can smell the nutty aroma of the peanut oil that this dose has been roasted in. The dosa is smeared with an Andhra podi whilst being fried to a near crisp. A dose that goes ‘crunch’ from the first bite to the last, with a slightly tangy edge.

Kaveri Godavari Foods.summary: Kaveri Godavari Foods is a food truck located in Bangalore that serves traditional Tamil Nadu cuisine with influences from Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. The food is cooked in wood-pressed oils extracted in the family's oil mill. Some of the must-try dishes include the Mutton Brain Fry, Kuzhambu Kalakki, Mutton Kari Dosa, Mutton Chops, and Podi Dosa. The highlight of this food truck is that all the dishes are prepared at the owner's home and cooked in wood-pressed oils extracted in the family’s oil mill.

Swad - n - Swad.title: SWAD - N - SWAD | This RAJASTHANI Couple Is Serving Delicious, HOME-COOKED Traditions Of Their Land!
Swad - n - Swad.address: No 1/108, RKR Complex Kaggadasapura main road, opposite 16th Cross, Kaggadasapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560093

best_dishes.name: Tandoori Chicken Tangdi
best_dishes.summary: Chicken legs marinated for hours in a spice mix, deep-fried and then fire-cooked with some ghee and spices

best_dishes.name: Lahsuni Bhindi Fry
best_dishes.summary: Bhindi fry cooked with plenty of browned garlic, green chillies

best_dishes.name: Sev Tamatar
best_dishes.summary: Spicy sev (chickpea fritters)  cooked in a tangy, thick tomato gravy

best_dishes.name: Besan Gatta
best_dishes.summary: Spiced chickpea dumplings boiled and then cooked in a creamy, mild and slightly tangy, yoghurt based gravy

best_dishes.name: Malai Chicken
best_dishes.summary: Chicken, slow cooked with spices in milk that eventually thickens to cream (malai) and hence its name. The thick gravy is fortified with cashew nut paste, and smoked just before serving

best_dishes.name: Rathodi Chicken Curry
best_dishes.summary: A simple everyday sort of chicken curry with coriander and the sweet aroma of the whole spices

best_dishes.name: Junglee Maas
best_dishes.summary: The meat removed before the stock is added to make the gravy. The meat is rich in the near caramelised sweetness of the onions, the warming heat of the mathania chillies and the aromatic spices

best_dishes.name: Laal Maas
best_dishes.summary: Similar in flavours to the junglee maas but fortified with meat stock, this curry may get its colour from the Mathania chilli, but it is quite gentle on the palate

best_dishes.name: Kheer
best_dishes.summary: Kheer

Swad - n - Swad.summary: Swad - n - Swad is a small eatery in Kaggadasapura, Bengaluru, run by Jithender and Renuka Tak, a couple from Rajasthan. They serve delicious home-cooked Rajasthani food, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian. The highlight of their eatery is that it is a family-run operation with their children lending a hand in the chores.  They had started this food venture after they had to shut down their shop. This eatery is a testament to their never-give-up attitude.

Gopaljee Caf\u00e9.title: GOPALJEE CAFÉ | She Quit Her Job To Bring Authentic DELHI Style CHOLE BHATURE To BENGALURU!
Gopaljee Caf\u00e9.address: 17/1,chandra mansion, Marathahalli - Sarjapur Rd, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102

best_dishes.name: Chole Bhature
best_dishes.summary: The bhatura is light and puffy yet with a bit of strength, to match the tenacity of the 56-spice blend masala that is delicately warming yet has enough depth to linger on the palate. The chickpeas, cocooned in the flavour of the masala, a seasoning of oil, chilli and spices, are stained deep brown by some amla and cooked such that they retain their shape yet yield in a creamy texture to the bite. The mandatory topping of dry, spiced aloo (potatoes) adds a slightly tangy flavour to the dish. If you like it spicy, go for generous bites of the green chilli pickle in between mouthfuls of the chole bhature. If you like paneer, opt for the paneer chole bhature, which arrives with a paneer and coriander mince, stuffed into the bhaturas, and also atop the chole.

best_dishes.name: Lassi
best_dishes.summary: The lassi is thick and creamy, garnished with nuts, and also provides cooling respite if you have ingested more of the green chilli than you can handle.

best_dishes.name: Gulab Jamun
best_dishes.summary: The way to end your meal if you have a sweet tooth is with their perfectly browned gulab jamuns.

Gopaljee Caf\u00e9.summary:
Suvigya Bansal, a former corporate executive, quit her job to bring the authentic taste of Delhi chole bhature to Bengaluru after she and her husband were unable to find any restaurants that lived up to their standards.  They hired experienced cooks from Delhi and source the right size chickpeas to complement their 58-spice masala. Despite facing challenges due to the pandemic, Gopaljee Café remains committed to serving delicious and authentic Delhi-style chole bhature.  

Highlight: The highlight of Gopaljee Café is their dedication to recreating the exact flavors of Delhi street food, using a complex blend of spices and carefully sourced ingredients.

New Gowda\u2019s Fried Chicken.title: Move Over ‘KFC’, Krishnappa Gowda’s Fried Chicken (GFC) Is Here! NEW GOWDA’S FRIED CHICKEN Bangalore
New Gowda\u2019s Fried Chicken.address: No.52, 2nd Main, Mysore Rd, New Timberyard Layout, Narsimayya Colony, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560026

best_dishes.name: Gowda’s Fried Chicken
best_dishes.summary: Tender chicken, marinated for six hours in an aromatic, secret spice mix, Gowda’s Fried Chicken is the sort that is tantalisingly tasty. The masala serves to coat the kebab with a delicately spiced crust and seal its juicy bite; the chicken is cooked perfectly down to the bone. This is the sort of kebab that needs no accompaniment in the form of a chutney or onions.

best_dishes.name: Chicken 65
best_dishes.summary: A tasty kebab in itself, slightly spicier when compared to the GFC. The masala has formed a bit of a thick crust in parts as the chicken is fried, which lends a spicy kick. And then there are those parts where it is the juiciness of the bird that gushes through the palate.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: The biryani here, made of basmati and kollam rice is served in a sumptuous portion, and is rich in the flavour of the masala when hot. Some pieces of the meat are soft and slide off the bone, and ribboned in rich fat, yet others with a bit of bite. As the biryani cools down, the savoury fat-laden flavour of the meat takes over.

New Gowda\u2019s Fried Chicken.summary: This video is about Gowda's Fried Chicken (GFC) located on Mysore road, Bangalore. The restaurant is run by Krishnappa Gowda who earlier had a vegetarian eatery for 35 years. The highlight of this place is their fried chicken made with a secret recipe influenced by his Mandya roots.  The chicken is marinated for six hours in a special spice mix which gives it a unique taste.

Mamatha Hotel.title: Best HOMESTYLE GOWDA Lunch at Hassan’s Popular MAMATHA HOTEL | Ragi Mudde, Mutton Korma, Katla Fry
Mamatha Hotel.address: Bangalore - Mangalore Rd, Beside Bhanu Theater, Karigowda Colony, Rangoli Halla, Hassan, Karnataka 573201

best_dishes.name: Katla Fry
best_dishes.summary: Coated in a delicious spiced batter that complements the earth flavours of the freshwater fish, the katla fry is a popular dish here for all the right reasons. The crispened skin and the masala work well to cradle the fleshy fish.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Korma
best_dishes.summary: Notwithstanding bits of fat ribboned through it, the juicy chunks of meat have a bit of a bite. And as you chew on it, you are rewarded with the robust flavours of the curry. This is the sort of delicious mutton curry you would taste in a Gowda home in the area. Makes for a great accompaniment to the ragi mudde and steamed rice.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Leg Piece
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is tender and juicy, the masala has penetrated deep into the meat that is cooked through to the bone. The spicy batter that crumbs the chicken has depth of flavour that is quite endearing.

Mamatha Hotel.summary: This popular eatery in Hassan, located 210 km from Bengaluru, offers a memorable dining experience with its rustic, homestyle Gowda cuisine. The highlight of the meal is undoubtedly the delicious and authentic Gowda dishes, which are sure to tantalize your taste buds and leave you craving for more.

KAKINADA SUBBAIAH GARI HOTEL.title: Flavours of East Godavari At KAKINADA SUBBAIAH GARI HOTEL Bangalore | 30-Dish Vegetarian Andhra Meal
KAKINADA SUBBAIAH GARI HOTEL.address: 1, ITPL Main Rd, MLayout, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

best_dishes.name: Special Vegetarian Meal
best_dishes.summary: A special 30-dish Andhra Bhojanam with sweets like annavaram prasadam, poornam boorelu, junnu, savoury fries, curries, lentils, rice preparations like pullihora, panasa mukkala biryani and chutneys

best_dishes.name: Butta Bhojanam
best_dishes.summary: A takeaway meal bundle that will feed 4 to 6 diners

best_dishes.name: Single Meals
best_dishes.summary: A limited selection of dishes

best_dishes.name: Curries
best_dishes.summary: Available per portion

KAKINADA SUBBAIAH GARI HOTEL.summary: This video is about KAKINADA SUBBAIAH GARI HOTEL in Bangalore, a popular Andhra restaurant serving a 30-dish vegetarian meal. The restaurant is known for its traditional flavours of the North Godavari region, generous use of ghee and old-fashioned hospitality. The video highlights the special vegetarian meal, which includes a variety of sweets, fries, curries, lentils, rice preparations and chutneys. The meal is priced at Rs. 250. The unique aspect of the restaurant, as highlighted in the video, is its commitment to serving honestly-priced, traditional Andhra food with warm hospitality, reminiscent of its humble beginnings as a small mess in Kakinada in 1950.

Northwest Kebab & Curryhouse.title: This New NORTHWEST KEBAB & CURRYHOUSE Serves Tasty Kebabs And Curries Beyond The Usual North Indian!
Northwest Kebab & Curryhouse.address: No 99, 2nd Floor, 5th Cross Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 095

Mewe Aur Subz Ki Seekh.name: Mewe Aur Subz Ki Seekh
Mewe Aur Subz Ki Seekh.summary: A delicately spiced kebab that offers the richness of reduced milk solids, dry fruits and the freshness of vegetables that intermingles with the gentle spice of chillies.

Paneer Parathdar.name: Paneer Parathdar
Paneer Parathdar.summary: Marinated paneer, that is soft and creamy to the bite, stuffed with a slightly spicy, tangy paste of sun dried tomatoes.

Teekhi Machli.name: Teekhi Machli
Teekhi Machli.summary: A dish that is a confluence of the North, in the mustard oil, and the South, toasted curry leaves and tamarind, that go to flavour the masala that the tilapia is tava-fried in.

Tabak Maaz.name: Tabak Maaz
Tabak Maaz.summary: Tender lamb that is braised in saffron, spices and milk, and then finished with ghee. At Northwest Kebab & Curry House, the braised meat is then coated in a light batter and fried. The juicy succulence of the fat and the ghee is what one tastes on the palate as the meat peels away from the bone.

Chicken Behari/ Mutton Behari.name: Chicken Behari/ Mutton Behari
Chicken Behari/ Mutton Behari.summary: A moist and gently flavoured grilled morsel of meat with none of the heavy handed spicing that one would associate with a North Indian Kebab. My vote though goes to the mutton version of this kebab where the tenderiser has imparted a creamy texture to the smokey flavours of the meat.

Bhindi Musallam.name: Bhindi Musallam
Bhindi Musallam.summary: Slit and spiced tender ladyfingers that are fried and topped with a rich musallam gravy of almonds and heavy cream, and garnished with beaten silver, rose petals and saffron oil.

Methi Malai Kofta.name: Methi Malai Kofta
Methi Malai Kofta.summary: Paneer and potato dumplings stuffed with prunes and nuts, cooked in a tomato and cream based gravy laced with the slightly bitter edge of fresh fenugreek.

Murg Shinwari Karahi.name: Murg Shinwari Karahi
Murg Shinwari Karahi.summary: A rustic preparation that one would perhaps encounter on a highway stop in the NorthWest, one tastes the untamed flavours of ginger, green chillies, coriander seeds in this chicken dish that is prepared and served in cast iron karahi

Nalli Rogan E Nishat.name: Nalli Rogan E Nishat
Nalli Rogan E Nishat.summary: If you are a mutton lover, this is a must-order dish here. The curry bears the lip-smacking goodness of tender meat and bone marrow, the meat the sort that not just slides off the bone but almost melts away when placed in the mouth.

Northwest Kebab & Curryhouse.summary: Northwest Kebab & Curryhouse is a casual dining restaurant in Koramangala, Bengaluru, serving North West Frontier cuisine. The restaurant is run by Chefs Sanjay Tyagi and Shyam Sundar Bhaskaran, both seasoned culinary professionals who have worked in top Indian kitchens in the country and overseas. The restaurant aims to not only serve delicious food but also provide livelihoods to chefs and F&B professionals who lost their jobs during tough times. Northwest Kebab & Curryhouse offers a unique menu with dishes that go beyond the usual North Indian fare.  The restaurant is relatively new but worth checking out for its delicious and different take on North Indian cuisine.

THE HIGHER TASTE.title: Exploring SATTVIC Cuisine At THE HIGHER TASTE, ISKCON TEMPLE | Food That Satisfies The Soul!
THE HIGHER TASTE.address: The Higher Taste, Inside ISKCON, Hare Krishna Hill, Chord Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560010

best_dishes.name: Nuggekai Rasam
best_dishes.summary: A flavorful and aromatic rasam with the sweet taste of fennel, warmth of pepper, and richness of lentils and drumstick pulp. The floating drumstick kernels add to the appeal of this nourishing broth.

best_dishes.name: Multani Paneer Tikka
best_dishes.summary: Paneer stuffed with cream and nuts, marinated in yogurt and saffron, and cooked in a tandoor. The peppers provide a satisfying crunch, and the chaat masala cuts through the richness, refreshing the palate.

best_dishes.name: Potato Milagu Fry
best_dishes.summary: Baby potatoes tossed in a lively spice mix with pepper, chili flakes, cumin, crunchy fried curry leaves, and fresh lime juice.

best_dishes.name: Mango Rasgulla Chaat
best_dishes.summary: Imagine a chatpata paapdi chaat where soft rasgullas replace the paapdi, immersed in sweet mango pulp. A perfect start for those who relish sweet and spicy flavors.

best_dishes.name: Raja Bhojanam
best_dishes.summary: Paneer, peas, and nuts cooked in a rich cashew, cream, and ghee-laden curry, topped with saffron. This indulgent curry is best enjoyed with soft, layered warki paratha. For an extra kick, try it with chilli cheese naan.

best_dishes.name: Vazhaipoo Murungakai Kozhambu
best_dishes.summary: A coconut-based curry with fried banana blossoms and drumstick segments. The drumsticks add a slight fiber, while the banana blossoms offer a crispy texture. This rich curry pairs well with rice.

best_dishes.name: Vetrilai Thakkali Satham
best_dishes.summary: A unique rice dish that balances the sharp flavors of betel leaves with tomatoes. The fresh tomatoes counterbalance the astringency of the betel leaves for a harmonious blend.

best_dishes.name: Elaneer Payasam
best_dishes.summary: A delightful payasam made with tender coconut, coconut milk, and thickened milk for sweetness. A perfect way to end your meal at The Higher Taste.

best_dishes.name: Paan Ice Cream
best_dishes.summary: A creative dessert where sweet paan is blended into homemade ice cream, offering a unique twist on the traditional beeda.

THE HIGHER TASTE.summary: This video takes viewers on a culinary journey to The Higher Taste, a fine-dining restaurant in Bengaluru's ISKCON Temple, showcasing the restaurant's unique Sattvic cuisine.  The host highlights that the food is not just about nourishment but a divine blessing,  showcasing the depth of traditions and diverse flavors that satisfy the soul.  The video provides a detailed overview of the menu, highlighting dishes like Nuggekai Rasam, Multani Paneer Tikka, and Raja Bhojanam, emphasizing their unique ingredients and flavors.  The experience is described as a unique presentation of temple fare elevated to a culinary experience that appeals to all. The Higher Taste offers a unique dining experience that nourishes both body and soul.

Hotel Diana.title: Tasting The Must-Try World Famous Hotel Diana Gadbad & Veg Cutlet In Udupi | A Legacy Of 60 Years!
Hotel Diana.address: Opp Big Bazar Ajjarkad, Udupi, Karnataka 576101

best_dishes.name: Vegetable Cutlet
best_dishes.summary: A potato and beetroot patty that is flavoured with a seasoning of curry leaves, lentils and spices, this cutlet is a delicious medley of flavours and textures. The accompanying homemade chutney and sauce make for worthy companions to this Diana classic.

best_dishes.name: Diana Gadbad
best_dishes.summary: A layered creation with strawberry ice cream, eight types of dry fruits, fresh fruits, a special ‘Horlicks’ cake, vanilla cake, no two spoonfuls of this delicious dessert are the same.

Hotel Diana.summary: This video is about the legendary Hotel Diana in Udupi, Karnataka, and two of their signature dishes: the Vegetable Cutlet and the Diana Gadbad.  Established over 60 years ago, Hotel Diana has become a beloved institution, renowned for its simple yet incredibly flavorful vegetarian fare. The video begins with the history of the restaurant, which started as a humble shop selling cool drinks and ice cream.  When these items failed to gain traction in the then-sleepy town, the Pai family, the founders, decided to introduce snacks, beginning with their now-iconic vegetable cutlet. This unique dish, a blend of potato and beetroot seasoned with curry leaves, lentils, and spices, took nearly half a decade to win over the local palate, ultimately becoming a testament to the family's perseverance and culinary ingenuity.  The Diana Gadbad, a serendipitous creation, emerged from a happy accident.  When a large group of customers arrived unexpectedly, the restaurant’s founder, Mohandas Pai, improvised a dessert using limited quantities of three different ice creams, topping it with cashew nuts. Named ‘Gadbad,’ meaning ‘hurry’ in Kannada, this delightful concoction, featuring layers of strawberry and vanilla ice cream, a variety of dry and fresh fruits, and a special ‘Horlicks’ cake, has become synonymous with the restaurant itself.  The video provides viewers with a glimpse into the making of both dishes, showcasing the fresh, high-quality ingredients and the care taken in their preparation. The host then indulges in both dishes, vividly describing their flavors and textures. He praises the cutlet for its crispy exterior, its soft, flavorful interior, and the delicious accompaniments of homemade chutney and sauce. He marvels at the Gadbad, highlighting the unique experience of encountering different flavors and textures with every bite, from the sweetness of the fruits to the crunch of the nuts and the creaminess of the ice cream and cake. The video concludes with a heartfelt tribute to the enduring legacy of Hotel Diana. Highlighting that the restaurant's popularity stems not just from the delicious food but also from the warm memories associated with it. The host emphasizes the importance of appreciating the history behind iconic dishes like the Gadbad and the cutlet, acknowledging the effort and innovation that went into their creation. The video is a celebration of simple, well-crafted food and the power of culinary tradition to create lasting memories.

Polamma\u2019s Mess.title: POLAMMA’S MESS | This Eatery Serves Tasty, Affordable ANDHRA FOOD & Memories Of A Grandmother’s Love
Polamma\u2019s Mess.address: 67/1, 2nd Cross Rd, Chikku Lakshmaiah Layout, Adugodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560029

best_dishes.name: Veg Meals
best_dishes.summary: A simple yet satisfying meal of rice served with nutritious and creamy 'thottakoora' pappu, vegetable of the day, sambar, rasam, yoghurt and the staple condiments of pappula podi, ghee and ghongura chutney. It reflects the essence of a typical Andhra home meal.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Roast
best_dishes.summary: Double-cooked chicken, first in a flavorful masala and then roasted with curry leaves and spices. It's moist inside with a slight roasted crunch, perfect for those who prefer their chicken spicy and flavorful.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Polamma
best_dishes.summary: This chicken fry is enriched with cashew paste and red chili powder, a preparation that might make you sweat if you're not used to chili heat.

best_dishes.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A Friday special, this biryani is enough for one or two people. It boasts plenty of masala and moist, juicy chicken, made in the kacchi akhni style. A recipe owner Jagadeesh picked up during his time in Hyderabad.

Polamma\u2019s Mess.summary: Polamma’s Mess, a humble eatery in Bengaluru, is a tribute to owner Jagadeesh Reddy’s late grandmother. This heartwarming story highlights the eatery's struggle during the pandemic.  Known for its simple yet delicious Andhra vegetarian bhojanam and tasty meat dishes, Polamma’s Mess offers a taste of home-style Andhra cuisine.  What makes this eatery special is Jagadeesh's dedication to keeping his grandmother's memory alive through the food he serves.

Machali Restaurant.title: Lunch At Mangalore’s Most Popular SEAFOOD Restaurant, MACHALI | Crab Ghee Roast Prawn Fry Fish Curry
Machali Restaurant.address: Behind Ocean Pearl, Sharada Vidyalaya Rd, Kodailbail, Mangalore, Karnataka 575003

Fish Thaali.name: Fish Thaali
Fish Thaali.summary: A standard Mangalore fish meal experience, on the plate there is a fish curry with a small piece of fish, some dry vegetables on the side, boiled rice, shrimp chutney, fried sandige and pickle. Servers walk along ladling more fish curry, a simple Konkani style lentil preparation, daali thove, and rasam out of buckets.

Taru Buthai.name: Taru Buthai
Taru Buthai.summary: Tiny sardines, fried to delicious scrumptiousness, the sort that you eat whole.

Prawn Fry.name: Prawn Fry
Prawn Fry.summary: A robustly-flavoured fresh prawn preparation crusted in a Konkan koliwada masala. Once you get past the spices, you can taste the sweet lilt of the prawns.

Boneless Crab Ghee Roast.name: Boneless Crab Ghee Roast
Boneless Crab Ghee Roast.summary: Perfect for those who love crab but dont want to go through the hassle of de-shelling one. The lush ghee roast masala packs a punch more so against the mild flavours of the crab, the buttery fervour of the ghee brings the spices and the crabmeat together.

Squid Ghee Roast.name: Squid Ghee Roast
Squid Ghee Roast.summary: The squid was cooked to the texture that yielded quite gently to the bite.

Alle Piyao.name: Alle Piyao
Alle Piyao.summary: A flavourful Konkani curry made of ginger, onions and fresh coconut. The onions, starring both in the masala and the seasoning, are quite pronounced on the palate, as is a tinge of turmeric and the warmth of the ginger.

Anjal Tava Fry.name: Anjal Tava Fry
Anjal Tava Fry.summary: A plump piece of fish, flakey and pristine in its freshness, crusted with a punchy masala. You can taste the red chilli spice the moment you place the fish in your mouth, but the meaty character of the anjal balances against the spicy hit.

Pomfret Tava Masala.name: Pomfret Tava Masala
Pomfret Tava Masala.summary: The pomfret is burdened under the weight of a flavourful masala that has notes of savouriness, heat and sourness, owing to the onions, curry leaves, chillies and tamarind. The fish is moist, poached in a turmeric curry first, before being slathered with the masala in a pan.

Machali Restaurant.summary: Machali is a popular seafood restaurant in Mangalore, known for its delicious and affordable seafood dishes. The restaurant has a busy dining hall vibe and is frequented by locals and tourists alike. The owner, Vicky Pai, was inspired to open the restaurant to provide tasty, homestyle food at affordable prices.  The menu features a variety of seafood dishes, including curries, fries, and thaalis. Some of the must-try dishes include the Fish Thaali,  Prawn Fry, Boneless Crab Ghee Roast, and Anjal Tava Fry. The restaurant is known for its generous portions and quick service. What makes this restaurant unique is its commitment to serving high-quality seafood at affordable prices, making it accessible to a wide range of customers.

Swathi Delicacy.title: Breakfast Stop At The Very Popular SWATHI DELICACY On The Bangalore Mangalore Highway, NH 75 Kunigal

Idli Vada.name: Idli Vada
Idli Vada.summary: Steaming hot idlis with a grainy texture, served with flavourful sambar, crispy vada, and spicy green chilli chutney.

Kesari Baath.name: Kesari Baath
Kesari Baath.summary: A relatively simple kesari baath with a comforting semolina taste, enhanced by pineapple, cashew nuts, and raisins.

Butter Masala Dose.name: Butter Masala Dose
Butter Masala Dose.summary: Crispy and filling masala dosa with spicy red chutney, a generous amount of butter, and flavourful potato palya.

Open Butter Masala Dose.name: Open Butter Masala Dose
Open Butter Masala Dose.summary: Fluffy and thick open dosa with a sweet and spicy powdery-crunchy podi, creamy potato topping, and a generous amount of butter.

Grilled Vegetable Cheese Sandwich.name: Grilled Vegetable Cheese Sandwich
Grilled Vegetable Cheese Sandwich.summary: Toasted bread filled with crunchy vegetables and plenty of cheese.

Coffee.name: Coffee
Coffee.summary: Exceptional filter coffee that is a must-try.

Swathi Delicacy.summary: This video is a review of Swathi Delicacy, a popular vegetarian restaurant located on the Bangalore-Mangalore Highway. The restaurant is known for its tasty and hygienic food, clean environment, and quick service. The reviewer tries a variety of dishes, including idli vada, kesari baath, butter masala dosa, open butter masala dosa, grilled vegetable cheese sandwich, and coffee. He highly recommends the coffee and describes it as exceptional.  The unique highlight of the restaurant, as mentioned by the reviewer, is its ability to provide consistently delicious and satisfying food in a clean and efficient manner, making it a perfect stop for travelers.

Shri Janardhan Hotel.title: World Famous MYSORE PAK At SHRI JANARDHAN HOTEL, Ramnagar | Made To A 100-Year-Old Recipe Tradition!

Mysore Pak.summary: Drenched in ghee, the mysore pak is meltingly soft, and dissolved when placed in the mouth. The sweetness of the sugar is balanced by the weight of the gram flour and the buttery fervour of the tuppa in this dessert! A mysore pak worth its weight in gold!
Mysore Pak.price: Rs. 40 (usd 0.5) per plate (50 gm); Rs. 800 (usd 10.8) per kg

Badam Halwa.summary: Lush and gooey, one tastes the richness of khoa and the grainy bite of almond.
Badam Halwa.price: Rs. 40 (usd 0.5) per plate (50 gm); Rs. 800 (usd 10.8) per kg

Shri Janardhan Hotel.summary: This video is about the legendary Shri Janardhan Hotel in Ramnagar, Karnataka, a culinary landmark famous for its Mysore Pak. Established in 1926, the hotel boasts a 100-year-old recipe tradition for this iconic South Indian sweet, passed down through three generations. The current owners, Prashant and Gayathry, continue to use the same time-honored recipe, resulting in a Mysore Pak so delectable that people flock from far and wide to experience its melt-in-your-mouth texture and perfectly balanced sweetness. The highlight of the video is the detailed review of their Mysore Pak, praised for its melt-in-your-mouth texture and the perfect balance of sweetness, ghee, and gram flour.

Prasad Hotel.title: ORIGINAL MULBAGAL DOSA | PRASAD HOTEL | The Famous, Roasted & Steamed Dosa Of This Temple Town!
Prasad Hotel.address: Mulbagal Dosa Prasad Hotel, #87, Indra Nilaya, Tathipalya, Mulbagal, Karnataka 563 131

best_dishes.name: Special Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A unique dosa that is both roasted and steamed, giving it a crispy and fluffy texture. It is served with a flavorful red onion chutney and lentil chutney.

best_dishes.name: Masala Vada
best_dishes.summary: A crispy and flavorful vada that is a perfect sidekick to the dosa.

best_dishes.name: Special Plain Dosa
best_dishes.summary: This dosa highlights the unique texture of the Mulbagal dosa without any potato stuffing.

best_dishes.name: Onion Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A thick and fluffy dosa with the delicious flavor of caramelized onions.

Prasad Hotel.summary: This video features Prasad Hotel in Mulbagal, Karnataka, known for its unique Mulbagal Dosa. The dish is made differently than other dosas, using a combination of roasting and steaming, resulting in a crispy and fluffy texture. The restaurant, started by Rajendra Prasad, has gained popularity for its delicious dosas and chutneys. The video highlights the Special Masala Dosa, Masala Vada, Special Plain Dosa, and Onion Dosa, all highly recommended.  The unique aspect of this restaurant is its unique method of preparing the dosa making it crispy and fluffy at the same time

Hao Hao.title: Tasting INDIAN CHINESE Traditions At HAO HAO, Mangalore’s Oldest & Most Popular Chinese Restaurant
Hao Hao.address: Basement floor Essel Wilcon, Below Radha Medical, Father Muller's Rd, Kankanady, Mangalore, Karnataka 575002

best_dishes.name: Crunchy Fried Chicken
best_dishes.summary: A tasty duet of spicy chicken supremes encased in crisp, crunchy threads. Alongside a tangy, piquant dipping sauce, this makes for an interesting play of flavours and textures on the palate, not surprising then that this is “the most ordered dish” here.

best_dishes.name: HongKong Soup
best_dishes.summary: A nourishing, delicately flavoured chicken broth that is topped with ‘clouds’ of eggs whipped into a soft meringue. There’s tiny diced of vegetables to give the chicken company with some soft noodles.

best_dishes.name: Chicken, Mushrooms & Bamboo Shoots Stir Fry
best_dishes.summary: A wholesome assemblage of veggies - chinese cabbage, peppers, beans, onions, bamboo shoots - tossed with chicken in a light soya sauce. The garlic is quite pronounced, in the flavour of the dish, and also on the bite with whole cloves that are stir-fried into the noodles.

best_dishes.name: Honey Spiced Chicken WIngs
best_dishes.summary: Fried chicken wings, tossed with a potent dark honey-soy-chilli-garlic sauce and sprinkled over with toasted sesame and spring onions. The chicken is crunchy and moist, only wish the sauce had seeped all the way into the wings.

best_dishes.name: Roasted & Fried Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is cooked twice, first roasted, allowed to rest before being tossed in a hot wok with soy, chillies, ginger, garlic, spring onions… rendering the meat the sort that pulls away from the bone effortlessly. Although spicy, the chilli heat is balanced against the umami flavours of the dish. There are also bits of chicken skin in the dish that provides a lovely flavour burst.

best_dishes.name: Shin Min Rice
best_dishes.summary: A one-dish meal of soy prawns, sweet garlic chicken, fried rice topped with an egg sauce that coats every grain of rice in its moist custardy texture. The chicken is slightly sweetesh with a prick of pungency from the garlic, the shrimps are a tad overwhelmed by the soy and batter.

best_dishes.name: Dragon Noodles
best_dishes.summary: My favourite of the two main courses, this has chicken in a savoury sauce tossed with plenty of veggies, served with noodles - fried and soft, topped with an egg sauce.

Hao Hao.summary: This video is a review of Hao Hao, Mangalore’s oldest and most popular Chinese restaurant. The restaurant is run by Louis and Rosy Wong, who are second or third generation immigrants to India. The reviewer highlights that the restaurant serves Indian Chinese cuisine which is a unique blend of Indian and Chinese flavors. He recommends dishes like Crunchy Fried Chicken, Hongkong Soup, Chicken, Mushrooms & Bamboo Shoots Stir Fry and Roasted & Fried Chilli Chicken

Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals.title: HOTEL THIMMAPPA, Udupi’s Most Popular FISH FRY & Meals | A 50-Year Tradition That Began In A Home
