Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals.address: Near Karavali Junction, Malpe Road, Adi-Udupi, Udupi, Karnataka 576102

Fish Meal.name: Fish Meal
Fish Meal.summary: A simple, satisfying and affordable fish meal with rice, curry made with small fish, a vegetable and pickle

Kane Rava Fry.name: Kane Rava Fry
Kane Rava Fry.summary: Plump lady fish coated in semolina and fried, resulting in a crunchy texture and perfectly spiced flavor

Disco Fish.name: Disco Fish
Disco Fish.summary: A budget-friendly fish fry option with meaty and flavorful fish coated in a delicious masala

Prawn Ghee Roast.name: Prawn Ghee Roast
Prawn Ghee Roast.summary: Prawns cooked in a rich and robust masala with a hint of sweetness, complemented by the flavor of ghee

Fish Kebab.name: Fish Kebab
Fish Kebab.summary: Kingfish deep-fried in a spicy Koliwada batter, offering a taste of the Konkan coast

Pomfret Fry.name: Pomfret Fry
Pomfret Fry.summary: Pomfret fish fried with masala, resulting in a crispy crust and moist, meaty flesh

Prawn Pepper Fry.name: Prawn Pepper Fry
Prawn Pepper Fry.summary: Prawns deep-fried with pepper, enhancing their sweetness, and seasoned with curry leaves for a savory note

Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals.summary: Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals, a renowned eatery in Udupi, boasts a 50-year legacy of serving delectable and budget-friendly seafood.  Started by Thimmappa and his wife, this humble establishment gained popularity for its exceptional fish fry made with a secret masala recipe. Today, their son, Sathish Kotian, continues the tradition, offering a wide array of seafood delicacies. From the simple yet satisfying Fish Meal to the flavorful Kane Rava Fry and the budget-friendly Disco Fish, there's something to please every palate. The Prawns Ghee Roast, Fish Kebab, Pomfret Fry, and Prawn Pepper Fry are also highly recommended. Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals is a must-visit for seafood enthusiasts seeking an authentic and affordable culinary experience in Udupi. What makes Hotel Thimmappa Fish Meals unique is its enduring legacy, started by a couple in their home and passed down through generations, all while maintaining the original charm and flavors that have captivated locals for decades.

Akki Roti Hotel Anemahal.title: Tasty VILLAGE MEALS Cooked Over A Wood Fire At This FARMER’S AKKI ROTI HOTEL | Needs No Sign Board!
Akki Roti Hotel Anemahal.address: Akki Roti Hotel Anemahal,, NH-48, Bengaluru-Mangaluru Highway, Anemahal, Sakleshpur, Rural, Mangalore, Karnataka 573134

best_dishes.name: Akki Rotti
best_dishes.summary: Malenadu style akki rotties are served hot and puffy with homemade butter that makes for a simple yet delicious accompaniment to the toasty crackle of the rotti. A tasty vegetable saagu, curry made of raw banana and bengal gram, helps one make a sumptuous meal of these rotties. There’s a spicy green chilli chutney completes the plate.

best_dishes.name: Meals
best_dishes.summary: Choose from rice or raagi mudde served with a delicious homestyle sambar and a fingerlicking rasam that’s a flavourful play of spicy, sour and sweet on the palate. A dry vegetable for the day adds to the tasty nutrition of this meal, and there’s some homemade curd, buttermilk, happala and pickle to round off the meal.

Akki Roti Hotel Anemahal.summary: This video is about a simple and rustic eatery located on the Bengaluru-Mangaluru Highway called Akki Roti Hotel Anemahal.  The eatery is run by Balwant and his wife, Girija, who started it sixteen years ago as a tea shop. The highlight of this eatery is its delicious Malenadu style Akki Rotti served with homemade butter, vegetable saagu and green chilli chutney. They also serve meals with rice or raagi mudde, sambar, rasam and other accompaniments.  What’s unique about this place is that it doesn’t have a sign board yet people find it easily on Google Maps and through word of mouth, drawn in by the tasty, homely food.

Sri Shiva Darshana Shashi Thatte Idli Ho.title: The Most Popular BIDADI THATTE IDLI At Sri Shiva Darshana Shashi Hotel | Bangalore Mysore Highway

best_dishes.name: Thatte Idli
best_dishes.summary: Pillowy soft idli that breaks under gravity, best enjoyed with butter, chutney, and potato saagu. A must-try dish!

best_dishes.name: Masala Vada
best_dishes.summary: Savory vada that complements the idli, offering a break from the spicy chutney.

best_dishes.name: Extra Butter
best_dishes.summary: Highly recommended to enhance the flavor of the idli

Sri Shiva Darshana Shashi Thatte Idli Ho.summary: This video features Sri Shiva Darshana Shashi Thatte Idli Hotel, a popular eatery on the Bangalore Mysore Highway known for its iconic Bidadi thatte idli. Established in the 1950s, the restaurant has been serving this local delicacy for over five generations. The thatte idli is praised for its incredibly soft and airy texture, best enjoyed with their flavorful chutney, potato saagu, and a generous serving of butter. The masala vada provides a savory counterpoint to the spicy chutney.  What makes this place unique is its legacy and commitment to serving authentic Bidadi thatte idli.

SVS MESS.title: Exploring 25 Years And 3 Generations Of RURAL Culinary Traditions At SVS MESS, Kolar

best_dishes.name: Paya Soup
best_dishes.summary: A gentle and nourishing soup with the warming touch of pepper, an appetising start to the meal.
best_dishes.price: Rs. 10 (USD 0.1) for a cup of soup; Rs. 180 (USD 2.5) with two trotters

best_dishes.name: Fish Kebab
best_dishes.summary: A fish fry that’s best savoured hot, the flesh is moist with the skin crispened. The masala is flavourful and thankfully does not overpower the earthy flavours of the fish.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A biryani that is mellow in flavours, subtle nuances of the aromatic spices are all that one detects in the rice, a combination of seeraga samba and the bullet variety. The meat is tender and moist, effusive in its flavour with a slightly salty edge of sheep meat.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Kheema Unde
best_dishes.summary: Handground by the ladies of the house, one can discern the grainy texture of the coarse kheema on the bite and the warming notes of ginger. The kheema unde is soft and flavourful.

best_dishes.name: Boti Fry
best_dishes.summary: The boti is cleaned well and cooked with tender hithikabele (peeled hyacinth beans) which helps in toning down some of the ‘funky’ flavours of the boti.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: A loaded chop, plenty of meat and some fat, that stands testament to the fact that SVS knows how to cook its meat. Absolutely delicious, the meat peels away from the bone, yet has a bit of a bite.

SVS MESS.summary:
This rustic eatery in Kolar, Karnataka, is a family-run establishment serving traditional non-vegetarian dishes for over 25 years.  The food is cooked on a wood-fired stove using recipes passed down through three generations.  Highlights include the Paya Soup, Fish Kebab, Mutton Biryani, Mutton Kheema Unde, Boti Fry, and Mutton Chops.  The restaurant is popular among locals and is located within a two-hour drive from Bengaluru. 

**Unique Highlight:** The restaurant's unique use of a wood-fired stove for cooking, preserving the traditional methods for 25 years.

Fish N Dish.title: This Humble FAMILY Eatery Is Serving Honestly-Priced, Delicious COASTAL MANGALORE Food | FISH N DISH
Fish N Dish.address: Jambunagar 1st cross. Jambusavari dhinne, Near Bus Stand, J P Nagar 8th Phase, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 076

Lady Fish Rawa Fry.name: Lady Fish Rawa Fry
Lady Fish Rawa Fry.summary: A delicate crust conceals the lady fish, smeared with a gentle masala that’s seasoned to perfection. The fish is fresh and flakey, the perfect size to peel away at its flesh, definitely a fry to order when here

Prawn Sukka.name: Prawn Sukka
Prawn Sukka.summary: The coconut is the perfect sponge to soak up the flavours of the masala and also the slight sweetness of the prawns. The coconut masala, toasted curry leaves, ginger garlic and green chilli combine supremely with the prawns that have been cooked to just the right texture.

Squid Ghee Roast.name: Squid Ghee Roast
Squid Ghee Roast.summary: The ghee roast masala is warming and ‘kadak’ in its punch and laced with the generous ‘butteriness’ of ghee. Would order the ghee roast here again, but perhaps with fish or chicken.

Mackerel Fry (Green Masala).name: Mackerel Fry (Green Masala)
Mackerel Fry (Green Masala).summary: You can taste the fresh herbaceousness of coriander combined with the zing of mint and the spicy heat of green chillies. It’s a masala that’s robust enough to take on the strong flavours of the mackerel.

Mackerel Tawa Fry (Red Masala).name: Mackerel Tawa Fry (Red Masala)
Mackerel Tawa Fry (Red Masala).summary: A deep-coloured masala that greets you with its spicy punch and has seeped into the core of the fish.

Fish Thaali.name: Fish Thaali
Fish Thaali.summary: A complete meal that includes a mackerel curry, mackerel fry, some vegetable, pickle, rice and neer dosa, guaranteed to satisfy, taste-wise and also fill you up.

Silverfish Curry.name: Silverfish Curry
Silverfish Curry.summary: A gentle curry with the creaminess of coconut milk and mild flavours of the fish, the fish is the sort that one can devour completely, bone and all. A traditional silver fish curry would also have a bit of tartness that I missed in this preparation.

Mackerel Pullimunchi.name: Mackerel Pullimunchi
Mackerel Pullimunchi.summary: The curry is nice and thick, however to a Mangalorean, it may seem a trifle compromised on the chilli and tamarind punch that one would expect to find in a traditional Puli (sour) Munchi (chilli).

Fish N Dish.summary: Fish N Dish is a small, family-run Mangalorean coastal restaurant located in JP Nagar, Bengaluru.  This humble eatery is run by Harish and Prema Shetty who moved from Mangalore to Bengaluru with their son. They serve delicious, home-style Mangalorean food at honest prices. The restaurant is popular for its fresh seafood dishes, including fish fry, fish curry, prawn fry, prawn curry, and ghee roast.  A must-try dish is the Lady Fish Rawa Fry.  The restaurant has only four tables, so it is recommended to call ahead to make a reservation.

Taj Biryani Paradise.title: Famous RAMANAGARA Biryani Ritual | TAJ BIRYANI PARADISE | Mysore Highway Mutton Biryani, Chicken
Taj Biryani Paradise.address: B.M. Road, National Highway 275, Ramanagara, Karnataka 562159

best_dishes.name: Chicken Al Faham
best_dishes.summary: The meat, especially the leg piece, is moist and juicy, the masala has permeated all the way into the meat. The chaat masala sprinkled over the bird is a tad overpowering, all in all a tasty preparation, provided it’s served hot.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: The biryani is stained saffron yellow, the rice fluffy, moist and flavourful and seemingly mellow when it greets your palate first with the aromas of the seasoning spices like cardamom. Golden fried onions, brishta, lend to the flavour of the biryani, however a few bites in one can detect the mild burn of red chilli spice on the lips. But that’s quickly assuaged when the rice is tasted with the juicy, fat-lined plump pieces of meat in the biryani. The meat is intense in its ‘meaty’ flavour, slides off the bone, and definitely the sort that leaves an impression on the palate.

Taj Biryani Paradise.summary: Taj Biryani Paradise is a popular biryani spot on the Bengaluru Mysuru highway, known for its quick and satisfying biryani. The restaurant is always bustling with customers. The Chicken Al Faham features moist and juicy meat with a flavorful masala, though the chaat masala can be a bit overpowering. The Mutton Biryani is the star attraction, with fluffy, flavorful rice, tender mutton pieces, and a perfect blend of spices.  What makes this place unique is its location on the highway making it an ideal stop for travellers.

Thotada Mane.title: Tasty, Traditional Fare Served By VILLAGE HOUSEWIVES | THOTADA MANE | FARM DINING At Srirangapatna
Thotada Mane.address: Survey No.294, Near Water Treatment Plant Pandavapura Road Darasaguppe, Srirangapatna, Karnataka 571438

best_dishes.name: Mint Lime
best_dishes.summary: A refreshing drink.

best_dishes.name: Special Bhajji
best_dishes.summary: A tasty bhajji platter, the crunch of tomatoes, onions and coriander add an element of ‘freshness’ to a deep-fried indulgent snack.

best_dishes.name: Rotti Platter
best_dishes.summary: A wholesome plate of three rotties, rice, spinach and raagi, topped with a generous dollop of butter and served with a niger seed chutney, uchilu pudi and curd combo, and a knock-your-socks-off spicy village condiment of green chillies, mensu.

best_dishes.name: Meals
best_dishes.summary: The sort of traditional meal you would taste perhaps if you were invited to a home in Srirangapatna. A sumptuous thaali weighed down by a dry palya for the day, saagu, sambhar, rasam, puri, homemade yoghurt and rice.

Thotada Mane.summary: Thotada Mane, a unique farm garden dining experience in Srirangapatna near Mysore, offers traditional vegetarian cuisine in a rustic garden setting.  The restaurant is run by Guru Dutt Bharadwaj, who quit his IT job to pursue his passion for cooking and provide an authentic village dining experience. The highlight of Thotada Mane is its all-women team of village housewives who prepare and serve traditional family recipes with a twist.

Babu Hotel.title: Delicious VILLAGE Tradition, CHIBLU IDLIS Steamed In Bamboo Over Wood Fire | BABU HOTEL Halaguru

Chiblu Idli.name: Chiblu Idli
Chiblu Idli.summary: Aromatic and steaming hot idli steamed in bamboo baskets over wood fire, served with a dollop of butter and alongside palya and red chilli chutney. The idli is soft, porous and carries a tart edge from the fermentation, that the butter helps balance against.

Tuppa Dose/ Bene Dose/ Masala Dose.name: Tuppa Dose/ Bene Dose/ Masala Dose
Tuppa Dose/ Bene Dose/ Masala Dose.summary: The dose is crisp to the touch and fried to an appealing golden brown. Makes for a simple but satisfying tiffin with the palya and chutney. The masala dose is similar but stuffed with palya and larger in size, with twice the amount of butter.

Babu Hotel.summary: This video takes us on a culinary journey to Babu Hotel in Halaguru, a small village 80 kilometers from Bangalore,  to experience the traditional Chiblu Idli.  This unique idli is steamed in bamboo baskets called ‘chiblus’ over a wood fire, a method rarely seen today. The video highlights the soft, aromatic texture of the idli, complemented by butter, palya, and a spicy red chilli chutney.  The host also recommends trying the Tuppa Dose, Bene Dose, and Masala Dose, all crispy and delicious.  A visit to Babu Hotel is a trip back in time, savoring authentic flavors and traditional cooking methods.

Hari Super Sandwich.title: Tasting The HINDUPUR Sandwich Tradition At HARI SUPER SANDWICH | Secret Recipes, Cheese & Chocolate!
Hari Super Sandwich.address: 121/A, 8th Main Road, Jayanagar, 3rd Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011

best_dishes.name: American Corn Sandwich
best_dishes.summary: A texture-rich sandwich with the sweet pop of the corn and the moist crunch of capsicum and onion. The bread is toasted just right to hold within it the creaminess of the cheese and the stuffing. You can taste the aromatic flavour of the spice powder mix and the fervour of garlic.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Cheese Toast Sandwich
best_dishes.summary: Fresh green chillies are grated onto a bed of cheese, the cheese helps tone down the chilli kick for sure.

best_dishes.name: Chocolate Cheese Sandwich
best_dishes.summary: A combination that sounds unusual to the ear, but works well on the palate. The chocolate is not as smooth as silk, but is complemented by the creamy saltiness of the cheese and butter. It tastes almost like a chocolate waffle.

best_dishes.name: Hari Special Sandwich
best_dishes.summary: A loaded vegetable sandwich, inspired by the Bombay sandwich. You bite into the crispness of the vegetables, onion, tomato and cucumber, and taste the warmth of the chipotle laced mayo.

best_dishes.name: Capsicum Onion Sandwich
best_dishes.summary: You can taste the full-on vegetal notes of capsicum in this one, appealing if you like peppers, not otherwise.

Hari Super Sandwich.summary: This video explores the unique Hindupur sandwich tradition at Hari Super Sandwich in Bengaluru. The video highlights the special spicy chutney and secret spice mix used in their sandwiches, which are a derivative of the Mumbai bread and veggies affair. The host tries five of their popular sandwiches, including the American Corn Sandwich, Chilli Cheese Toast Sandwich, Chocolate Cheese Sandwich, Hari Special Sandwich, and Capsicum Onion Sandwich. The highlight of Hari Super Sandwich is their use of  a special spicy chutney and secret spice mix, which they guard zealously, adding a unique flavor to their sandwiches.

The Coorg Food Company.title: Authentic KODAVA Fare At THE COORG FOOD COMPANY | A Kodava Couple Share Their Culinary Heritage
The Coorg Food Company.address: 2nd Floor, Masand Esquire, Hennur Main Road, HRBR, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 043

Pandhi Curry.summary: A signature dish, the pandhi curry is stained dark with the kartha masala and the kachampuli, and the sort that breaks down in a hurry the moment you bite on it releasing the flavours of the masala laden with the fat of the meat.

Pandi Bhartad.summary: A preparation that breaks down readily in the mouth, releasing the flavours of the deep roasted Kodava ‘kartha’ masala. The fat has a deliciously jammy, sticky texture and has rendered well into the dish.

Koli Curry.summary: A delicious, homestyle chicken curry, the coconut milk in this preparation ensures the flavours are gentle and calming, quite unlike the robust pork dishes.

The Coorg Food Company.summary: The Coorg Food Company, owned by Pavith Ponnappa and Pavitha Poonacha, is a culinary tribute to their Kodava heritage. The restaurant, located in Bengaluru, offers authentic Kodava cuisine using family recipes and ingredients sourced from their estates in Coorg.  Gourmet On The Road host, Kripal Amanna, highly recommends their signature dish, the Pandhi Curry, a flavorful and tender pork curry made with kartha masala and kachampuli. The restaurant also boasts other Kodava specialties like Pandi Bhartad, Koli Curry, and a delightful Tender Coconut Pudding. The highlight of The Coorg Food Company is its commitment to preserving and showcasing the rich culinary traditions of Coorg through authentic flavors and dishes.

Naidus Chats.title: NAIDUS ‘Hygienic’ CHAATS | An Engineer & Accountant Transform Their Father’s 35-Year-Old CHAAT Cart!
Naidus Chats.address: 651, 8th Main Road, 3rd Block, Basaveshwara Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560079

best_dishes.name: Masala Puri
best_dishes.summary: Bengaluru’s popular ‘local’ chaat offering is served in an avatar that is spicy but doesn't subdue the aroma and warming spices of the ‘masala’ that is at the heart of this concoction. The masala has depth of flavour, this chaat can be a filling snack with the white peas.

best_dishes.name: Sev Puri
best_dishes.summary: Not a Mumbai version with potatoes, but topped with onions, spiced peanuts, chilli powder, seasoning, chutneys and sev, this chaat is a riot of textures. From the crispy crunch of the papri to the moist crunch of the onions and the spicy nutty bite of the peanuts, laced with the chilli-coriander-mint green chutney balanced with the tangy sweetness of the jaggery-tamarind chutney.

best_dishes.name: Dahi Puri
best_dishes.summary: The dahi puri is burdened with potatoes, white peas, peanuts, chutneys and the aromatic masala before being topped with yoghurt, sev and boondi. A sumptuous chaat if you are looking for one.

best_dishes.name: Paani Puri
best_dishes.summary: The paani puri is light and chatpata, not too spicy or the sort that will singe your palate. The potatoes and chickpeas, just enough to give it a creamy bite.

Naidus Chats.summary: This video is about Naidus Chats, a food truck in Bengaluru, India, run by two brothers, Gokul and Sarvan, who transformed their father's 35-year-old chaat cart into a hygienic food truck. They serve authentic chaats made with their father's age-old recipes and almost every component is prepared by them with the assistance of their mother. The video highlights the cleanliness and hygiene of their operation, which is what sets them apart from other street food vendors.

Hotel Dwarka.title: Bengaluru's Favourite KHAALI DOSA At 50-Year HOTEL DWARKA | The Dosa That Changed An Eatery’s Name
Hotel Dwarka.address: 7th Cross Rd, NR Colony, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560019

best_dishes.name: Khaali Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A pair of soft and spongy dosas, served with chutney and potato palya. Best enjoyed hot with a generous smear of butter.

best_dishes.name: Tomato Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A flavourful dosa enriched with tomato, onions, coriander, and ginger. Served with vegetable saagu and chutney.

best_dishes.name: Carrot Halwa
best_dishes.summary: A rich and sweet carrot halwa, best enjoyed as a dessert.

Hotel Dwarka.summary: Hotel Dwarka, a culinary landmark in South Bangalore, has captivated taste buds for nearly five decades with its iconic Khaali Dose.  While the name 'Khaali' translates to 'empty' in Kannada, the dosa is anything but, representing a symphony of textures and flavours. This episode delves into the magic behind Dwarka's renowned dish, showcasing its simplicity and the culinary expertise that goes into creating this South Indian delicacy.  The highlight, undoubtedly, is the Khaali Dosa, a testament to the fact that sometimes, the most basic things done right can be extraordinary.

Basaveshwara Khanavali.title: Authentic NORTH KARNATAKA Jolada Rotti Meals At BASAVESHWAR KHANAVALI | At Dharwad Hubli Since 1963
Basaveshwara Khanavali.address: 1st floor ,No 81,8th cross, Dattatreya temple street, 8th Cross Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 003

best_dishes.name: Jollada Rotti Meal
best_dishes.summary: A nutritious, tasty, and diverse meal. The jolada rottis are light and fluffy, pairing perfectly with the chutneys, kempu chutney, shenga chutney, and guralu, especially with some yogurt. The rotti, wrapped with jhunka, salad, and eggplant gravy, offers a burst of flavors and textures. The pulses, moth bean, and sprouted mung are fulfilling, while the badanekayi enngayi and dhonne menasinkayi will have you craving more. A meal that truly celebrates the vegetarian flavors of North Karnataka.

best_dishes.name: Shenga Hollige
best_dishes.summary: Served with a generous drizzle of ghee, the hollige has a sticky texture and a delightful nutty crunch from the peanuts.

Basaveshwara Khanavali.summary: This video explores Basaveshwara Khanavali, a restaurant serving authentic North Karnataka cuisine in Bengaluru.  The video highlights the restaurant's history, tracing its roots back to a small student mess opened in Dharwad in 1963. The family-run establishment is known for its delicious jolada rotti oota, a traditional North Karnataka meal. The video showcases the making of this meal, highlighting its various components and flavors.  The unique aspect of Basaveshwara Khanavali lies in its commitment to preserving the authenticity of North Karnataka cuisine while offering a taste of home-style cooking.

Eat Raja.title: EAT RAJA ‘India’s 1st Zero-Waste’ JuiceBar | FRESH JUICES In FRUIT SHELLS! No Paper Or Plastic Used!
Eat Raja.address: No.320/2, 14th cross, Sampige Rd, Kodandarampura, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003

best_dishes.name: Waterless Watermelon Juice
best_dishes.summary: Refreshingly thick juice, unfiltered and sweetened with the natural sugars of the fruit.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Guava Juice Shots
best_dishes.summary: The best seller at Eat Raja, pink guava that’s juiced and served in its shell with a chilli-salt rim that contrasts sharply against the sweetness of the fruit. You are served five shots to a portion, and the bonus here, you get to relish the juice and eat the fruit too!

best_dishes.name: Muskmelon Banana Juice
best_dishes.summary: Served in a muskmelon cup, the tropical notes of the muskmelon pairs deliciously with the ripe sweet ripeness of the Chandrabaley banana. The flavours of this delightful combination linger long on the palate even after you have finished drinking the juice.

best_dishes.name: Cucumber Lime Detox
best_dishes.summary: Raja’s “inside the fruit” thinking manifests itself in a “healthy-tasting” puree of cucumber spiked with lime that’s served in the shell with a chilli-salt rim. Whilst the salty rim didn’t appeal to my palate in this combination, this certainly is a juice that would be great on a hot summer’s day.

best_dishes.name: Banana Beetroot Juice
best_dishes.summary: A thick and creamy concoction that’s served in a banana skill shell! The banana dominates on the palate, with a touch of sugar, the beetroot whispers its faint earthiness.

Eat Raja.summary: Eat Raja is the fascinating story of an engineer turned radio jockey who gave up his career to help his mother look after the family juice shop upon the untimely passing of his father a couple of years ago. Along the way, he elevated it from a mere juice shop to the country’s first zero waste juice bar.  The highlight of this juice bar is that there is no plastic, no paper used, and imaginative juice concoctions are served in vestibules fashioned out of fruit shells, highly instagrammable, that after serving their purpose are then gathered to be fed to cows.

Treat.title: This Popular FAMILY-RUN Neighbourhood Eatery, TREAT, Has Been Serving KEBABS & CURRIES For 27 Years!
Treat.address: 7/1, Ground Floor, G.J. Complex, opposite Toit, Indira Nagar 1st Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

best_dishes.name: Ajwaini Tandoori Machhi Tikka
best_dishes.summary: The seer fish kebab is fresh and flakey to the touch, and despite being cooked in the searing heat of the tandoor, is moist and juicy. The seasoning has penetrated all the way in, making for a flavourful tikka till the very last bite.

best_dishes.name: Tandoori Chicken
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is spiced gently but with a depth of flavour that comes from the bird being marinated for a while. You can taste the pungent lilt of mustard oil straddling the warming spices.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Barra Kebab
best_dishes.summary: The meat is cocooned in a translucent jacket of melting fat that imparts its deep flavours.

best_dishes.name: Baingan Bartha
best_dishes.summary: The deep smokiness of the eggplant in this homestyle Punjabi dish that’s nuanced in its flavours.

best_dishes.name: Dal Makhani
best_dishes.summary: NA

best_dishes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
best_dishes.summary: A spirited slow-cooked mutton preparation that ticks all the right boxes, in the intense fervour of the gravy, the savoury sweetness of the onions and the unctuous, slightly fatty flavour of the meat that still retains its bite.

Treat.summary: This video is about a popular family-run neighbourhood eatery, Treat, that has been serving delicious Punjabi food for 27 years. The restaurant is located in Indiranagar, Bengaluru and is run by Pramod Chaudhry and his family. The video highlights the Ajwaini Tandoori Machhi Tikka, a must-try dish at the restaurant.

Bobby Da Dhaba.title: BOBBY DA DHABA | This Popular Punjabi Dhaba Began As a Service to Devotees Visiting The Gurdwara!
Bobby Da Dhaba.address: #502, 12th Main MSR Enclave, Yeshwantpur Hobil, near Nagasandra Metro Station, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560073

best_dishes.name: Sweet Lassi
best_dishes.summary: Thick and creamy lassi that can easily fill you up.

best_dishes.name: Aaloo Paratha
best_dishes.summary: Spicy parathas dripping with butter.

best_dishes.name: Dal Makhani
best_dishes.summary: Creamy dal makhani with a bit of a bite,fiery chilli tadka

best_dishes.name: Paneer Bhurji
best_dishes.summary: Tangy paneer bhurji with a spicy kick

best_dishes.name: Choley Masala
best_dishes.summary: Homestyle choley masala with the flavors of coriander powder and ginger.

best_dishes.name: Palak Paneer
best_dishes.summary: Mildly flavored palak paneer, perfect for those who prefer less spice.

best_dishes.name: Phulka
best_dishes.summary: Soft and fluffy phulkas

Bobby Da Dhaba.summary: Bobby Da Dhaba, a popular Punjabi vegetarian restaurant in Bengaluru, serves authentic homestyle food. The restaurant has a heartwarming backstory, originating from a family's service to devotees visiting the Gurdwara.  Highlights include their aaloo paratha, dal makhani, paneer bhurji, and their especially popular lassi. The food is praised for its rustic and wholesome flavors, generous use of makhan, and reasonable pricing.  A unique aspect of this restaurant is its origin story, beginning as a humble service for devotees and evolving into a beloved eatery known for its home-style Punjabi food.

KABAB KORNER.title: Bengaluru’s Most Popular Drive-In ROOMALI ROLLS At KABAB KORNER | Chicken Roomali Roll, Malai Kebab
KABAB KORNER.address: 22, St Marks Rd, Near Ice & Spice, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Chicken Roomali Roll
best_dishes.summary: Served in a soft roomali roti with enough shredded chicken tikka and plenty of onions tossed with spices, the kabab korner chicken roomali roti still makes for a satisfying snack.

best_dishes.name: Malai Kebab
best_dishes.summary: The kebab is moist and juicy, when savoured steaming hot.

best_dishes.name: Hariyali Kebab
best_dishes.summary: You can taste the freshness of the coriander and mint in the green marinade, and the spicy kick of chilli too. The marinade though hasn't penetrated into the meat, making for a bland third or fourth chew of the kebab.

KABAB KORNER.summary:
This video is a review of Kabab Korner, a drive-in restaurant in Bangalore, India. The reviewer recommends the chicken roomali roll, malai kebab, and hariyali kebab.  

**What's unique?** Kabab Korner was once a popular late-night spot in Bangalore, known for its quick service and delicious food served directly to your car.

Purnabramha.title: PURNABRAMHA Maharashtrian Vegetarian Cuisine| A Woman’s Tribute To Authentic Flavours Of Her Land
Purnabramha.address: VCR Stone Corner, 780, 17th Cross Road, Opp Pappu Chaywala, 1st Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102

Modak.summary: Lord Ganesha’s favourite sweet, Purnabramha’s modak is a must-order. Within the austere exterior of the modak lurks a caramelised, coconutty mixture, fortified with reduced milk, that will sing to your palate.

Puran Poli.summary: Purnabramha has sold 750,000 of these, and for good reason. Jaggery-sweetened chickpea paste flavoured with a touch of nutmeg and rolled in a wheat dough, this is the sort of dessert that’s best enjoyed with plenty of thup (ghee)!

Combo Main Course Platter.summary: A great plate to taste the depth and variety of Maharashtrian cuisine in dishes that aren’t commonplace. The spicy rasa grips you by the throat, the soft and wholesome tandala chi bhakri (rice rotti) helps tone down the spicy fervour of the rasa. The maaswadi, a vegetarian’s imaginative take on the bone and marrow concept, is an interesting play of flavours and textures - smooth, spicy chickpea paste that’s stuffed with a mixture that comprises sesame seeds, coconut, peanuts, etc. if you like it spicy, combine the bhakri with the chilli thecha and onions. The bharleli vangi offers a flavourful bite, swathed in a nutty peanut based gravy

Vada Pav.summary: The vada pav here is served in the traditional Maharashtrian style, a lightly flavoured batata vada in a laadi pav with a generous rub of kanda-lehsun chutney, choora, fried batter pearls for crunch, and lavangi, salted and fried green chillies.

Purnabramha.summary: This video is about Purnabramha, a popular Maharashtrian vegetarian restaurant founded by Jayanti Kathale, a lady entrepreneur. Inspired by her mission to promote authentic Maharashtrian vegetarian cuisine, she started this venture.  The restaurant offers a variety of dishes, from traditional vada pav and sabudana vada to unique dishes like maaswadi rassa from Narayangaon. The video highlights the making of maaswadi rassa, a unique dish from Narayangaon.

Mallika Biriyani.title: Tasting East Bengaluru’s Insanely Popular  MALLIKA WOOD-FIRED BIRYANI | Mutton Curry, Chicken Fry
Mallika Biriyani.address: Bileshivale Main Rd, Near SSR College, Essel gardens, Bileshivale, Karnataka 560077

best_dishes.name: Mutton Curry
best_dishes.summary: A pleasing homestyle mutton preparation thats cooked slowly on a wood fire, the fat in the meat renders into the gravy giving the curry a lip-smacking unctuous richness. The meat slides off the bone, the curry is a great combination with the rice and raagi mudde. If you need one reason to make the trip to Mallika, this would be it!

best_dishes.name: Chicken Fry
best_dishes.summary: Made in a flavour coriander-greenchilli-coriander masala, this is a zesty chicken dish. The meat is cooked perfectly down to the bone.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Seven or eight pieces of meat in a mutton biryani at Rs. 230 makes it great in terms of value, and perhaps also lends to its mass appeal. The spicing and masala is identical to the chicken version, but the character of the mutton, with a bit of fat, imbues the biryani with a mellow, warming flavour note thats more rounded on the palate. The meat is juicy, and has a bit of a bite. If you like your flavours a bit punchy, taste it with the sherva, the gravy of the mutton curry.

Mallika Biriyani.summary: Mallika Biriyani in Kothanur, East Bengaluru is a bustling biryani destination run by Venkatesh, a former computer engineer. This eatery is famous for its wood-fired biryani, available in both chicken and mutton varieties. The mutton biryani, in particular, stands out for its generous portions, flavorful meat, and affordable price, making it a popular choice among locals.  What makes Mallika Biriyani unique is its use of a wood-fired cooking method, adding a distinct smoky flavor to its biryani.

Koshy\u2019s.title: MY LAST MEAL At KOSHY’S BENGALURU | Fish Biryani, Kerala Prawn, Tomato Cheese Toast, Mutton Omelette
Koshy\u2019s.address: Koshy’s Parade Cafe, No. 39, St Marks Road, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Tomato Cheese Toast
best_dishes.summary: Crisp tomato dices and sauteed pulpy bits with thick sauce slathered over thick toast of Koshy’s homemade bread and cheese shavings.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Omelette
best_dishes.summary: Simple omelette, beaten egg rolled around mutton mince seasoned sparingly. Best enjoyed with toast and butter.

best_dishes.name: Fish Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Plump steaks of kingfish, fried, cooked in a gravy and then topped with basmati rice.

best_dishes.name: Kerala Prawn Fry
best_dishes.summary: Tiny fried chemeen prawns that offers a taste of the sweetness of the prawns juxtaposed against the toasty herbaceousness of the curry leaves, the singe of pepper, the lilt of coriander and other spices.

best_dishes.name: Plum Cake
best_dishes.summary: Subtle sweet and slightly bitter-edged plum cake thats not as heady and alcohol-laced as some traditional cakes.

Koshy\u2019s.summary: This video is a food review of Koshy’s, an iconic eatery in Bengaluru that dates back to pre-independence times. The reviewer tries some of their popular breakfast dishes like the Tomato Cheese Toast and Mutton Omelette, as well as their famous Fish Biryani and Kerala Prawn Fry. He also takes a look at how they tried their best to keep serving customers during the pandemic. The video highlights the restaurant’s rich history and its commitment to serving delicious food.  A must-try for anyone looking for a taste of old Bangalore.

Koshy\u2019s Parade Cafe.title: KOSHY’S BEST BREAKFAST DISHES| Mutton Cutlet, Appam Stew, English Brekkie... Exclusive KITCHEN TOUR
Koshy\u2019s Parade Cafe.address: No. 39, St Marks Road, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: MUTTON CUTLET
best_dishes.summary: Hot and crisp to the touch. A delicious mutton cutlet, the crumbed exterior holds that flavourful spiced mutton mince. A textbook mutton cutlet. Old fashioned, like mum would make.

best_dishes.name: SPANISH OMELETTE
best_dishes.summary: This old-fashioned omelette is a big, protein-packed meal in itself, especially with the fries. This is a loaded omelette. It's cheesy; it has the meaty bite of the chicken, a salty hit from the bacon, and a crunch from the peppers.

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN LIVER TOAST
best_dishes.summary: A must-try dish for liver lovers! There’s very little that gets in the way of the rich deep flavour of the liver. The peppers pick up the flavour. The thick soft bread has absorbed liver gravy.

best_dishes.name: APPAM AND MUTTON STEW
best_dishes.summary: Traditionally only served on a Sunday. The mellow, creamy coconut milk has a hint of whole spices. The meat has soaked in the flavours of the stew but the flavour of the meat itself shines through.

Koshy\u2019s Parade Cafe.summary: Koshy’s is a landmark establishment in Bengaluru that has been around since the 1950s, popular for its old world charm and vintage decor. Food Lovers’ Editor Kripal Amanna, meets with Mr. Prem Koshy, third generation co-owner of this hallowed institution to discover its surprisingly humble origins. He savours some of the most popular breakfast items from their expansive menu, including the homemade Baked Beans on Toast, Chicken Liver on Toast, Club Sandwich and of course, their signature Appam and Stew, a signature dish that is served only on Sunday!  The highlight of Koshy's is its old-world charm and vintage decor.

Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery.title: Exploring Bengaluru’s Timeless IYENGAR BAKERY Tradition At 60-Year-Old Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery
Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery.address: No.1, Lal Bagh Main Rd, Srinivas Colony, Sudhama Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560027

Benne (butter) Biscuit.name: Benne (butter) Biscuit
Benne (butter) Biscuit.summary: The sort of cookie that’s crumbly, fragile and almost melts in the mouth.

Vegetable Puff.name: Vegetable Puff
Vegetable Puff.summary: Bite into the airy crunch of layers of pastry that traps within its folds a flavourful vegetable stuffing. A popular snack anytime of the day.

Egg Puff.name: Egg Puff
Egg Puff.summary: One you get past the airy crunch of the pastry layers, you taste the creamy egg bhurji that's fortified with half a boiled egg. Reason why these outsell the vegetable puff in a traditionally vegetarian establishment.

Khara Bun.name: Khara Bun
Khara Bun.summary: A generous hit of curry leaf and green chilli in a spice mix stains this popular bun a yellowish green and also gives it a spicy bite. The savoury notes of toasted onions and a smidgen of sugar rounds off the flavours on the palate.

Aloo Bun Congress.name: Aloo Bun Congress
Aloo Bun Congress.summary: Picture a soft bun stuffed with a creamy, lightly tempered potato mash. Slice it open and slather on a generous helping of spiced peanuts. That’s the ABC for you. Soft and creamy with the toasty, spicy crunch of peanuts, delicious down to the last bite.

Bun Butter Jam.name: Bun Butter Jam
Bun Butter Jam.summary: A sweet, raisin speckled bun sandwich slathered with salted butter and Sri Jayalakshmi’s homemade mixed fruit jam, on the palate it evokes memories of a comforting bread, butter jam sandwich packed in a school snack box.

Dilpasand.name: Dilpasand
Dilpasand.summary: Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery’s most popular sweet offering is the sort of calorie-laden indulgence that helps you get past a bad day, if you are having one.Puff pastry stuffed with freshly grated coconut, raisins, glazed cherries, tutti frutti, cashew nuts and scented with cardamom! Sweet Bliss!

Honey Cake.name: Honey Cake
Honey Cake.summary: Another one for the sweet tooth, a butter sponge cake dipped in a sugary syrup and rolled over in desiccated coconut. The sweetness, though is cut, thankfully, by the acidity of the jam that’s smeared on top.

Almond Biscuit.name: Almond Biscuit
Almond Biscuit.summary: The sort that breaks off in a crisp, soft, crunch.

Salt Biscuit.name: Salt Biscuit
Salt Biscuit.summary: Initially, you taste almost nothing, but then you are surprised by its salty spike that makes a late appearance on the palate.

Khara Biscuit.name: Khara Biscuit
Khara Biscuit.summary: Flavours of the khara bun - curry leaf, chillies, onions and jeera - but in a biscuit form.

Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery.summary: This video explores the legacy of Iyengar Bakeries in Bengaluru, specifically highlighting Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery, a 60-year-old establishment. The video delves into the history of Iyengar bakeries, tracing their origins to two brothers from Hassan who brought their baking traditions to Bengaluru. It emphasizes the bakery's ability to stay true to its roots while adapting to modern times. The highlight of the video is the exploration of Sri Jayalakshmi Bakery's delectable and addictive treats, showcasing their best-selling items.

Ebony.title: LAST LUNCH At EBONY, Bengaluru’s Most Popular Multi-Cuisine Restaurant | Arcot Chops, Butter Chicken
Ebony.address: Barton Centre, 13th Floor, 84, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Nonya Crunchy Butter Prawns
best_dishes.summary: Crumbed prawns with a flavoursome buttery crunch that resonates the toasty herbaceousness of crispened curry leaves and the tingling heat of red chillies

best_dishes.name: Thai Crispy Vegetables
best_dishes.summary: Vegetables served up in a crispy batter with a honey-chilli combination

best_dishes.name: Arcot Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: A ghee laden lamb chop that is slow-cooked to juicy doneness, and then charred on a grill to form a delicious masala crust

best_dishes.name: Kakori Kebab
best_dishes.summary: Tender, rich in fat, lamb mince that is massaged with gentle spices and grilled on a skewer

best_dishes.name: Ebony’s Ultimate Butter Chicken
best_dishes.summary: Rich in the tart sweetness of the tomatoes that cradles the tandoori spiced, grilled chicken, this is a dish that is supposedly a popular order here

best_dishes.name: Malaidar Dal Makhni
best_dishes.summary: Slow cooked dal makhni allowing for the smokey, buttery flavours to develop

Ebony.summary: This video is a review of Ebony, a multi-cuisine restaurant in Bengaluru, India. The restaurant is located on the 13th floor of a high-rise building and offers stunning views of the city.  Ebony is known for its delicious food and its democratic atmosphere.  The reviewer recommends the Nonya Crunchy Butter Prawns, the Arcot Mutton Chops, and the Malaidar Dal Makhni. The restaurant is temporarily closed but is expected to reopen in September 2020.  A unique aspect of the restaurant is that it came into being quite by accident, born out of a crisis after its owner, having bought the property as an investment was unable to flip it owing to the adverse fall out of the first Gulf war

MARATHA DARSHAN.title: Karnataka Style Maratha Cuisine At MARATHA DARSHAN | Mutton Korma, Raagi Mudde, Kheema Unde, Chicken
MARATHA DARSHAN.address: Marata Darshan, Kaverappa Layout, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560051

best_dishes.name: Kheema Unde
best_dishes.summary: These mutton mince roundels, floating in a spicy broth are soft to the touch and on the palate exude only the flavour of meat punctuated with spices.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: The Maratha version, rich in tomatoes, green chilli and pepper; the chicken is moist and juicy, cooked perfectly down to the bone.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Liver Fry
best_dishes.summary: The liver has bite but is still creamy, any gaminess is offset by the flavours of the pepper that the liver is roasted in. It makes for a delicious meal with the thin chapatis served here.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Korma
best_dishes.summary: Meat that is swathed in a generous amount of fat, the meat is cooked long until soft and tender. Barring the initial bite, it breaks down in the mouth instantly. The rice and korma are the perfect match, the rice doing well to absorb the deep unctuous flavours of the curry.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A local Karnataka style biryani, the rice is moist and redolent with the flavour of mint and coriander, the meat peels away from the bone and exudes a smokey aroma. Its the sort of biryani that works well when you taste the rice and meat together, add some if you need a spicier punch.

MARATHA DARSHAN.summary: This video features MARATHA DARSHAN, a restaurant serving Karnataka style Maratha cuisine.  The dishes are a unique blend of Maratha and Karnataka flavors.  A must-try is the Mutton Korma, where the meat is cooked to perfection in a rich and flavorful gravy.

Marata Darshan.title: MARATHA STYLE NON VEGETARIAN Food | MARATA DARSHAN | Naati Koli Saaru, Mutton Chops & More!
Marata Darshan.address: Kaverappa Layout, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560051

best_dishes.name: Naati Koli Saaru
best_dishes.summary: A spicy and flavourful gravy with a chilli kick, perfect for dipping the soft, pasty ragi mudde.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: Hearty mutton curry with a mellow heat from spices like cloves and cinnamon. The meat is tender and juicy, with a good distribution of fat.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Pepper
best_dishes.summary: Chicken liberally spiced with pepper, giving it a delicious, toasty flavor. The chicken is juicy and cooked to perfection.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: A local-style chilli chicken with tender chicken that falls off the bone. The masala is made with plenty of tomatoes and green chillies, offering a fingerlicking experience.

best_dishes.name: Chicken 65
best_dishes.summary: Chicken kebab tossed in a thick gravy of yoghurt, curry leaves, dry red chillies, and spices. A unique take on Chicken 65, with a slightly tart flavor.

best_dishes.name: Kheema Unde Gravy
best_dishes.summary: Rich and flavorful gravy perfect for ladling over the unde or meatball. The gravy doesn't overpower the taste of the meat.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Liver Pepper Fry
best_dishes.summary: Tender mutton liver with a roasted pepper flavor. The pepper is strong and complements the meatiness of the liver.

best_dishes.name: Soppina Saaru
best_dishes.summary: Earthy and nourishing saaru made with a variety of greens.

best_dishes.name: Rasam
best_dishes.summary: A clear rasam with a tartness from tamarind and prominent cumin or jeera notes.

Marata Darshan.summary: Marata Darshan, established in 1989 by Shantharaj Lad, is a humble eatery in Bengaluru known for its delicious military-style food, particularly its robust mutton dishes. Run by a family passionate about preserving tradition, the restaurant’s success is attributed to Hemavathi Bai’s traditional recipes.  Their signature dish, the Mutton Chops Thali, is a must-try, served with rice or their signature Ragi Mudde. The video highlights the unique family-run aspect of the restaurant, emphasizing the use of traditional recipes passed down through generations.

Airlines Hotel.title: AIRLINES HOTEL | Bengaluru’s Most Popular Outdoor Eatery | Butter Masala Dosa, Mangalore Buns & More
Airlines Hotel.address: No 4, State Bank of India Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Mangalore Buns
best_dishes.summary: A puffed deep-fried pastry made of maida dough that’s fortified with ripe banana, yoghurt, cumin seeds, and left to ferment. The bun is a tad chewy, the banana making its presence felt on the palate and also aiding in its subtle sweetness.

best_dishes.name: Sambar Vada
best_dishes.summary: The sort of vada that one should perhaps be tasting with steaming hot idlis if one is looking for a substantial snack. The vada isn’t crisp, but then that makes it of the perfect sponge to soak up the delicious Airlines Hotel sambar!

best_dishes.name: Butter Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: Loaded with butter and the resulting calories, the dose is crackling crisp and ironically a hit with Bangaloreans for whom savouring this is a ritual after an early morning walk or jog in nearby Cubbon Park! But then, to be fair this certainly a dose that can make anyone weak. Lined with a red chutney and bearing a potato stuffing that also employs the crunch of carrots and beans, this is a dose you will love if you like it crisp.

best_dishes.name: Akki Rotti
best_dishes.summary: The akki rotti is crisp around the edges and a tad dry on the bite. However, this filling snack is redeemed by the moistness of the gentle coconut-urugadle chutney, to take the spice quotient a few notches higher, taste it with the pungent byadgi chilli-garlic chutney.

best_dishes.name: Channa Bhatura
best_dishes.summary: A popular lunch order, this isn't your typical NorthIndian style dark-coloured and deep-flavoured chole. Get over that and you will be rewarded by a tasty combination of the chickpea with a steaming hot bhatura.

best_dishes.name: Kesari Bath
best_dishes.summary: Not a lush ghee-laden version of a popular Bengaluru tiffin, the version here is rich in pineapple flavours.

best_dishes.name: Basundi
best_dishes.summary: If you enjoy dairy-richness, you will dig the lushness of this dessert, milk thickened in a pan slowly and then fortified with nuts, cardamom powder and served chilled.

Airlines Hotel.summary: Airlines Hotel, Bengaluru’s first drive-in restaurant established in 1968, is a beloved eatery known for its simple and delicious South Canara cuisine.  The restaurant's claim to fame is its wafer-crisp butter masala dosa, a local favorite.  A unique aspect of Airlines Hotel is its charming garden setting, providing a socially distanced outdoor dining experience.

Airlines Hotel.title: Epic Bangalore DOSA TRAIL Part 2 |CTR |Hanchina Mane|Airlines|Umesh Dosa|Chikkanna Tiffin|99 Variety
Airlines Hotel.address: No 4, State Bank of India Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

best_dishes.name: BENNE MASALA DOSA
best_dishes.summary: Thick yet crisp dosa roasted with oodles of ghee. Served with fresh chutney and spicy ghatti chutney

best_dishes.name: SET DOSA
best_dishes.summary: Fluffy yet crisp set dosa served with a saagu loaded with seasonal veggies.

best_dishes.name: GOLI BAJJI
best_dishes.summary: Crisp and stretchy outside, soft and porous inside. Perfect tea or coffee time snack!

Bheema's.title: Full-On ANDHRA NON-VEG Meal At BHEEMA’S | Biryani, Mutton Pepper Fry, Guntur Chicken, Chilli Chicken
Bheema's.address: 31, Asha Building, Ground Floor, Church Street, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Fish Fry
best_dishes.summary: A tasty fry, though not the sort that will blow your socks off! It’s a thin slice of fish, napped in a sprightly masala and fried crisp around the edges.

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: No Andhra non-vegetarian meal can be complete without a chilli chicken, rich in copious amounts of green chilli and pepper. The spice hit is tongue-numbing, but one that’s vicariously addictive. The chicken is nice and juicy all the way down to the bone.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Pepper Fry
best_dishes.summary: The mutton is soft and yields to a gentle bite, draped in a pepper-onion masala. The meat is sheathed in some fat, which lends it its fulsome flavour. At Bheema’s they pick their meat cuts well and certainly know how to cook it well too.

best_dishes.name: Guntur Chicken
best_dishes.summary: A chicken preparation that heroes the Guntur chilli.The creaminess of the coconut though and the acidity of tomatoes in this dish balances against the heat of this otherwise spicy Andhra chilli.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Jeera Rice Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Bheema’s ode to the local Bengaluru biryani, this one is made with the short-grained seeraga samba rice. You can taste the fervour of coriander, mint and green chillies alongside other ingredients like the marat moggu, cloves that are typically used in this one-pot rice and meat preparation. The meat slides off the bone, it is cooked as well as that!

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Bheema’s most popular dish, this traditional Nellore-style biryani is made with basmati rice. There’s flecks of pineapple that go into this biryani and you taste its acidity juxtaposed against the aromatic flavours of cloves, cinnamon and other warming spices that the chicken and rice are cooked in. The meat is soft and juicy, however it is the delicate spicing of the biryani that makes an impression on the palate and lingers long after one has finished eating.

Bheema's.summary: This video is a review of Bheema's, a restaurant in Bangalore, India that serves Andhra cuisine. The reviewer tries a variety of dishes, including fish fry, chilli chicken, mutton pepper fry, Guntur chicken, and two types of biryani. He especially enjoys the mutton pepper fry and the chicken biryani. The highlight of the video is the behind-the-scenes look at how the restaurant is preparing to serve customers during challenging times.

Maiyas.title: Tasting SOUTH BENGALURU’S Popular Vegetarian Thali & Coffee At MAIYAS | Traditions Meet Food Science
Maiyas.address: 459, 30, 30th Cross Rd, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004

best_dishes.name: Special Meals
best_dishes.summary: A satisfying and nourishing Thali that includes hot puris, creamy potato saagu, crunchy kosambri, flavourful pulao, rice, sambar, rasam and sweet payasam

best_dishes.name: Coffee
best_dishes.summary: A regular cup of coffee

Maiyas.summary: This video explores Maiyas, a popular vegetarian restaurant in South Bengaluru, praised for its commitment to serving pure, clean, and delicious food. Founded by Sadananda Maiya, whose family boasts a rich culinary legacy starting with Mavalli Tiffin Rooms in 1924, Maiyas uniquely blends South Indian culinary traditions with food science and technology, even housing a food lab on-site. The video highlights their special vegetarian thali, a wholesome meal featuring a delightful array of dishes like puris, potato saagu, kosambri, pulao, rice, sambar, rasam, and payasam. The emphasis on quality and tradition at Maiyas makes it a must-visit for an authentic South Indian vegetarian dining experience

Lapis, The Oberoi Bengaluru.title: Hyderabadi, Karnataka, Italian & Dessert | FIVE STAR DINING In The New Normal | THE OBEROI BENGALURU
Lapis, The Oberoi Bengaluru.address: 37-39, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Yellappa Garden, Yellappa Chetty Layout, Sivanchetti Gardens, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001

best_dishes.name: Brulée Of Goat Cheese And Herbs
best_dishes.summary: This dainty brulée of goat cheese, crested with a passion fruit vinaigrette and basil seeds, is lusciously creamy with a smokey edge and contrasts sharply with the pickled beetroots served on the plate. The pistachio granola chip provides sweet relief to complement the fat and acidity of the dish.

best_dishes.name: Inside-out Karari Roomali Roti
best_dishes.summary: A conversation starter of a dish, the humble roomali roti is roasted on a ulta tawa until crisp and slathered with a heavy hand of spiced butter. The trio of yoghurts, a puckeringly tart kairi (raw mango), beetroot and a savoury masala dip, served alongside elevates the status of the roti from being a mere nibble to that of a palate-teaser.

best_dishes.name: Hyderabadi Lamb Keema Tikki
best_dishes.summary: A kacche kheeme (raw mince) ki tikki, the charred crust of which yields to the juiciness of the meat and the fresh crunch of onions on the bite. The flavours hark to a Hyderabadi pathar ka gosht, a possible inspiration behind the spices in this delicious lamb appetiser.

best_dishes.name: Peri Peri Cauliflower Deep Dish Pizza
best_dishes.summary: A perfectly executed Chicago style deep dish pizza, the pie is crunchy at the base and that helps hold within itself its weighty stuffing of peri peri spiced cauliflower, jalapeno and cheese.

best_dishes.name: Organic Kale And Ragi Millet Soup
best_dishes.summary: There’s a nutty bitterness to this soup, the sort that tastes healthy. Not a soup that’s designed to pander to your taste buds, the rajira (amaranth) and millet help in adding a touch of texture.

best_dishes.name: Pan Seared Kolkata Bekti
best_dishes.summary: The sea bass is cooked to the perfect, crisp sear yet moist inside. The wilted spinach works well as a foil to the sweetness of the mild Creole sauce with its slightly bitter, savoury notes.

best_dishes.name: Karnataka Lasooni Panchkuta Saag
best_dishes.summary: Five varieties of greens go into the making of this saag thats topped with roasted garlic and a generous dollop of white butter.

best_dishes.name: The Unbelievable Apple
best_dishes.summary: This striking dessert layers apple jelly, cinnamon mousse and spiced, stewed apple core into a clever take on the apple crumble.

best_dishes.name: Pot Of Gold
best_dishes.summary: A vegan assemblage of pink guava jelly, almond milk cream and berry compote

Lapis, The Oberoi Bengaluru.summary: This video is a review of the dining experience at Lapis, the all-day dining restaurant at The Oberoi, Bengaluru. The reviewer highlights the safety measures taken by the hotel in light of the COVID-19 pandemic, such as sanitization protocols and restaurant modifications for social distancing and airflow management. The video showcases a variety of dishes, from a creamy goat cheese brulee to a flavorful Hyderabadi lamb tikki, a peri peri cauliflower deep dish pizza, and a unique apple dessert.  The reviewer praises the restaurants attention to detail and the overall quality of the food. The highlight of the review is the emphasis on the safety measures, indicating a unique selling point for the restaurant in the current climate.

Royanna Military Canteen.title: LOCAL Military Style OOTA Takeaway| ROYANNA MILITARY CANTEEN| Khaali Palav, Chicken Kebab Mutton Fry
Royanna Military Canteen.address: St Patricks Complex, unit 9, Brigade Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Bengaluru, 560025

best_dishes.name: Chicken Liver Fry
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is perfectly cooked to a creamy texture, its deep flavours complemented by the pepper laced green masala.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Pepper Fry
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is moist and napped in a flavourful masala rich in onions, tomatoes, coriander and curry leaf. The onions have been roasted to a deep brown.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Fry
best_dishes.summary: The meat has a bit of a bite, the buttery, unctuous flavour of the fat that straddles the meat makes for a lush mouthfeel. The spicing is gentle and warming as opposed to the fiery chilli hit one sometimes encounters when dining local style.

Royanna Military Canteen.summary: Royanna Military Canteen is a relatively new restaurant in Bangalore that serves military-style South Indian cuisine. The restaurant prides itself on its sanitized and family-friendly take on this traditional food.  The dishes are generally flavorful and well-prepared, with highlights being the Chicken Liver Fry, Chicken Pepper Fry, and Mutton Fry. However, some dishes, like the Curry Leaf Chicken and Mutton Palav, may not be as bold or as spicy as one might expect from a military hotel. Overall, Royanna Military Canteen offers a decent dining experience with its unique take on military-style cuisine.

Dindigul Thalappakatti.title: A Taste of Dindigul in Bangalore | DINDIGUL THALAPPAKATTI BIRYANI Making | Mutton, Chicken & More...
Dindigul Thalappakatti.address: 88, Marathahalli - Sarjapur Outer Ring Rd, Kasavanahalli Village, Marathahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

Kola Urundai.name: Kola Urundai
Kola Urundai.summary: Spiced roundels of mutton mince, its unassuming form doesnt reveal the flavourful rush of spices it delivers on the palate.

Mutton Chukka.name: Mutton Chukka
Mutton Chukka.summary: Tiny morsels of meat, soft and yielding, with a springy bite. You can taste the grainy crunch of the coconut and the pepper hit, the perfect snack to accompany an evening tipple.

Peri Peri Chicken Chops.name: Peri Peri Chicken Chops
Peri Peri Chicken Chops.summary: The smokey, spiciness of the peri peri masala certainly perks things up on the palate alongside a zing of acidity, perhaps from some vinegar. The mayo helps assuage the spicy assault of the peri peri chicken.

Kuchi Mutton.name: Kuchi Mutton
Kuchi Mutton.summary: Tender goat ribs, braised in a deep-roasted masala. The meat is soft and tender, encased in a thin veil of fat which adds to the flavour. The parotta makes for a handy bread to mop up the masala, this is a dish that epitomises the way in which DT cooks its mutton! A must-have!

Kodaikanal Chicken Kozhambu.name: Kodaikanal Chicken Kozhambu
Kodaikanal Chicken Kozhambu.summary: The chicken is moist and calming in its flavours, the spicing is mellow and cradled in creamy coconut milk. You bite into flecks of coconut as you savour this kozhambu.

Vegetable Biryani.name: Vegetable Biryani
Vegetable Biryani.summary: The seeraga samba rice heroes the Dindigul biryani powder that makes for the masala, the vegetables, beans, carrots and cauliflower, have been roasted in the masala thus imbuing in them the flavour of the biryani.

Chicken Biryani.name: Chicken Biryani
Chicken Biryani.summary: The rice is flavoursome and the chicken definitely benefits when savoured in its company. Taste it with the biryani gravy and its endearing tomato-acidity if you like to moisten things up on the palate. The boiled egg helps stretch the protein component on the plate.

Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani.name: Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani
Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani.summary: This is the biryani that’s synonymous with Dindigul Thalappakatti, and therefore it is no surprise that they do it extremely well. The seeraga samba has not just trapped the flavour of the spices, but also the smoky aromas of the meat. The meat is soft, tender and moist. This is the sort of deep-flavoured, satisfying biryani that needs no accompaniment, either the gravy or the raitha. A must-order if you’re a biryani buff.

Dindigul Thalappakatti.summary: This video is about the Dindigul Thalappakatti restaurant in Bangalore, India. The video starts with a brief history of the restaurant, which was founded in 1957. The host then takes us to the kitchen where we see the chefs preparing the biryani. The biryani is made with small-grained seeraga samba rice and a variety of spices. The host then takes us to one of the restaurants in Bangalore where we see the different dishes that are available. The video ends with the host recommending the Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani. Highlight: The unique thing about Dindigul Thalappakatti is that they use a unique recipe for their biryani that was created by the founder's wife.

The seeraga samba has not just trapped the flavour of the spices, but also the smoky aromas of the meat. The meat is soft, tender and moist. This is the sort of deep-flavoured, satisfying biryani that needs no accompaniment, either the gravy or the raitha. A must-order if youre a biryani buff.

Dindigul Thalappakatti.summary: This video is about Dindigul Thalappakatti, a restaurant chain famous for its Dindigul style biryani. The video highlights the history of the restaurant, tracing its roots back to 1957 Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. The unique element highlighted is the restaurants origin story, starting from a small shop named Anandha Vilas, owned by Nagasamy Naidu, who was always seen with a turban (thalappa) tied (katti) on his head, leading to the name Thalappakatti. The video showcases the making of their biryani with seeraga samba rice and features a visual tour of their signature dishes like Kola Urundai, Mutton Chukka, Peri Peri Chicken Chops, and their best-selling Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani.

Dindigul Thalappakatti.title: A Taste of Dindigul in Bangalore | DINDIGUL THALAPPAKATTI BIRYANI Making | Mutton, Chicken & More...
Dindigul Thalappakatti.address: 88, Marathahalli - Sarjapur Outer Ring Rd, Kasavanahalli Village, Marathahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

Kola Urundai.summary: Spiced roundels of mutton mince, it’s unassuming form doesn't reveal the flavourful rush of spices it delivers on the palate.

Mutton Chukka.summary: Tiny morsels of meat, soft and yielding, with a springy bite. You can taste the grainy crunch of the coconut and the pepper hit, the perfect snack to accompany an evening tipple.

Peri Peri Chicken Chops.summary: The smokey, spiciness of the peri peri masala certainly perks things up on the palate alongside a zing of acidity, perhaps from some vinegar. The mayo helps assuage the spicy assault of the peri peri chicken.

Kuchi Mutton.summary: Tender goat ribs, braised in a deep-roasted masala. The meat is soft and tender, encased in a thin veil of fat which adds to the flavour. The parotta makes for a handy bread to mop up the masala, this is a dish that epitomises the way in which DT cooks its mutton! A must-have!

Thalappakatti Boneless Mutton Biryani.summary: This is the biryani that’s synonymous with Dindigul Thalappakatti, and therefore it is no surprise that they do it extremely well. The seeraga samba has not just trapped the flavour of the spices, but also the smoky aromas of the meat. The meat is soft, tender and moist. This is the sort of deep-flavoured, satisfying biryani that needs no accompaniment, either the gravy or the raitha. A must-order if you’re a biryani buff.

Dindigul Thalappakatti.summary: This video is about Dindigul Thalappakatti Biryani, a popular biryani restaurant chain in India. The video starts with the history of the restaurant, which was founded in 1957 in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. The founder, Nagasamy Naidu, started selling biryani made to his wife's unique recipe.  The video then moves on to show the making of their famous biryani. The biryani is made with small-grained seeraga samba rice and a blend of spices. The video also shows the different types of biryani that Dindigul Thalappakatti offers, including mutton, chicken, and vegetable biryani.  The video then highlights some of the other popular dishes, such as Kola Urundai, Mutton Chukka, Peri Peri Chicken Chops, Kuchi Mutton, and Kodaikanal Chicken Kozhambu.  The video ends with a call to action, encouraging viewers to visit Dindigul Thalappakatti and try their biryani.  Highlight:  What makes Dindigul Thalappakatti Biryani unique is the use of seeraga samba rice and their special blend of spices. The biryani is cooked in a traditional method, which gives it a unique flavour and aroma

Gajalee.title: Best TANDOORI CRAB, BOMBIL (BOMBAY DUCK) FRY, FISH CURRY & More At GAJALEE Seafood Restaurant MUMBAI
Gajalee.address: Kadamgiri Complex Hanuman Road, next to Icici Bank, Vile Parle East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400057

best_dishes.name: PRAWNS KOLIWADA
best_dishes.summary: These sea prawns are fresh, well seasoned and encrusted in a crunch rice flour batter. Smother it with the ginger garlic chutney if you like it spicy.

best_dishes.name: STUFFED BOMBIL FRY
best_dishes.summary: If you were to try only one dish at Gajalee, this would be it. The delicate, watery bombay duck is rolled around a spicy shrimp mixture, dipped in a batter and fried. The fish retains its moistness despite being fried and the shrimp adds flavour.

best_dishes.name: Bombil Fry
best_dishes.summary: The Bombay Duck is simply seasoned, dredged through a rice batter and fried. Yet another dish to try here. You can quite literally taste the ocean in this preparation.

best_dishes.name: TANDOORI CRAB
best_dishes.summary: It’s a bit of a splurge, but you definitely get the ‘meatiest’ bang for your buck! The crab was fresh and plump in its meat. I was worried that the tandoori masala would overpower the flavour of the crab, but that wasn’t the case. You could taste the sweetness in the flesh, and the gentle edge of the tandoori marinade.

best_dishes.name: Rawas Curry
best_dishes.summary: A creamy Malwan style curry, flavoured with the sour twang of kokum. The rawas or Indian salmon was soft and had absorbed the flavour of the curry. Best eaten with the ghavne, lacy pancakes made with a runny rice batter.

Gajalee.summary: Gajalee is a very popular seafood restaurant in Mumbai. Some of their must-try dishes include the stuffed bombil fry, prawns koliwada, plain bombil fry, rawas curry, and the splurge-worthy tandoori crab.  What makes their food unique is the freshness of the seafood and the use of authentic recipes and flavors

White House Restaurant.title: Juicy LAHM (Mutton) MANDI, 14-Dish PRAWN CURRY MEAL, KERALA | WHITE HOUSE RESTAURANT Wayanad
White House Restaurant.address: Wayanad Road, Near Odungakadu Makham, Engapuzha, Puduppadi, Kerala 673586

best_dishes.name: TAWA FISH
best_dishes.summary: Kingfish marinated in a coconut milk based masala with coconut flakes.

best_dishes.name: PRAWN CURRY MEALS
best_dishes.summary: Fresh prawn curry with the head cooked with drumsticks, served with rice and 13 other dishes including beans poriyal, bitter gourd, fish pickle, red chilli chutney and paruppu payasam.

best_dishes.name: PIDHI KOZHI PORICHATHU
best_dishes.summary: Juicy deep fried chicken served with mutta (egg) and fried curry leaves.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON MANDI
best_dishes.summary: Traditional mutton mandi cooked in a brick-lined pit oven. The dish features tender mutton with flavorful fat, and rice infused with meat juices and saffron.

White House Restaurant.summary: White House Restaurant, situated on the Wayanad-Kozhikode route, is a must-visit for its traditional Kerala cuisine and Arabian dishes like Mandi, all cooked in wood-fired stoves and brick pits. The restaurant offers an array of flavorful dishes, with the standout being the Prawn Curry Meal, a 14-dish feast that includes fresh prawns cooked with drumsticks, served alongside rice and a medley of sides. Other must-tries include the Tawa Fish with its delicate coconut flavor, the crispy Pidhi Kozhi Porichathu, and the succulent Mutton Mandi. The restaurant's commitment to traditional cooking methods and fresh ingredients shines through in every dish, making it a true culinary gem for food enthusiasts.

Street Storyss.title: TASTY VEGETARIAN TWIST | Parmesan KHICHDI, Avocado PAPDI, HALWA Mousse, Coffee MALAI| STREET STORYSS
Street Storyss.address: 3155, Srinivasan Towers, Indiranagar Double Rd, opp. Thomsun music, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

best_dishes.name: Avocado Mousse
best_dishes.summary: A papdi with Western aspirations, the desi yoghurt makes way for the creamy avocado mousse. The chutneys are replaced by piquant raw mango salsa and a refreshing tomato salsa.

best_dishes.name: Tibetan Laping Roll
best_dishes.summary: These translucent noodle rolls deliver batons of pickled cucumber and watermelon in a chilled sweet and sour crunch, swathed with the nuttiness of sesame soy and the warming heat of ginger.

best_dishes.name: Bangkok Stir Fry
best_dishes.summary: This is a dish that seems atypical for an eggplant preparation. Bite into its deep-fried crunchy texture to savour its soft and mushy insides. Tossed in a chilli garlic sauce, this is certainly a dish that’s made for the spice-loving palate.

best_dishes.name: Warm Mushroom Salad
best_dishes.summary: A dish with banging umami flavours, the shiitake has been poached with aromats rendering it soft and gentle on the bite. The cooked watermelon provides a fruity contrast to the star anise scented notes of the mushrooms.

best_dishes.name: Frozen Coffee Malai
best_dishes.summary: This is the dessert to try if you like a milky dessert and coffee. Smooth in its consistency, its flavour harks back to a cardamom-scented kulfi or rabri, condensed milk.

Street Storyss.summary: Street Storyss is a vegetarian restaurant in Indiranagar, Bengaluru that offers a unique twist on street food from around the world. Chef Nishant Choubey elevates popular dishes with unique dimensions. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including Avocado Mousse, Tibetan Laping Roll, Thai Corn Cake, Bangkok Stir Fry, Warm Mushroom Salad, Burmese Khow Suey, Nasi Goreng, Rajma Ghee Khichdi, Coconut Pancake with Besan Halwa Mousse, and Frozen Coffee Malai. The highlight of the restaurant is its unique and flavorful vegetarian dishes that are inspired by street food from around the world.

Hot Momos Darjeeling Style.title: Tasting HOT & SPICY DARJEELING STYLE MOMOS | Chicken, Paneer, Vegetarian | STEAMED, FRIED & SZECHUAN
Hot Momos Darjeeling Style.address: 46, 4th B Cross Rd, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095

best_dishes.name: Steamed Vegetable Momo
best_dishes.summary: Stuffed with a cabbage, carrot, bean and capsicum filling thats enlivened with a ginger-garlic and green chilli paste, this is a savoury momo, quite flavourful for a veggie option.

best_dishes.name: Steamed Paneer Momo
best_dishes.summary: Stuffed with soft paneer and slivers of green chilli. Flavourful enough to be eaten on its own minus the chutney.

best_dishes.name: Fried Chicken Momos
best_dishes.summary: These deep-fried momos are crispy and crunchy outside and doughy inside. An interesting contrast of textures that makes for an interesting bite.

best_dishes.name: Fried Chicken Momos in Szechuan Sauce
best_dishes.summary: The Szechuan style spicy momo tops the fiery chart here and is certainly not for the faint-hearted. All that you taste here is tonnes of chilli spice, the momo ends up being just a dumpling that has surrendered to the assault of the spicy sauce.

Hot Momos Darjeeling Style.summary: This tiny dim sum shop in Bengaluru serves momos with a difference. The owner, Dawa Lepcha, a migrant from Darjeeling, says they are steamed fresh with the filling raw, which makes them juicier than other momos.  The steamed vegetable momo, filled with cabbage, carrot, bean and capsicum, is flavourful and savoury. For those who like it spicy, the chilli sauce is a must-try. The steamed paneer momo, stuffed with soft paneer and green chilli, is surprisingly good and can be enjoyed even without chutney. While the steamed chicken momo lacked flavour, the fried chicken momos offered an interesting contrast of textures with their crispy exterior and doughy interior. However, the chaat masala sprinkled on top was a bit overwhelming. The star of the show is the Szechuan style spicy momo, not for the faint-hearted, this momo is an explosion of chilli spice. Overall, this place is a must-visit for momo lovers looking for something different. Highlight - The momos are steamed fresh with the filling raw, which makes them juicier than other momos.

Kothanur Kitchen.title: Spicy KONGUNADU VILLAGE STYLE Tamil Food | KOTHANUR KITCHEN Bangalore |MUTTON URUNDAI, NETHLI KURUMA
Kothanur Kitchen.address: Sy. No. 28/3 & 28/4, K Narayanapura Road, Kothanur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560077

best_dishes.name: Mutton Kola Urundai
best_dishes.summary: Spiced mutton mince balls, it's got a bit of a crunch as you bite into it but is yielding inside. The meat hasn’t been ground to a paste, and the spicing is gentle, leaves behind a happy warmth on the palate.

best_dishes.name: Nethli Kozhambu
best_dishes.summary: This Sunday special fish curry combines the humble nethili fish with the puckeringly sour raw mango in a curry pot that’s cooked slowly over a wood fire.

best_dishes.name: Kothu Parotta
best_dishes.summary: This parotta that has soaked up the egg masala and chicken sherva will transport you to the street stalls of Salem.

Kothanur Kitchen.summary: Kothanur Kitchen in North Bengaluru offers authentic Kongunadu and Salem-style non-vegetarian Tamil cuisine. They are known for their wood-fired cooking and use of fresh ingredients. Some of their must-try dishes include Mutton Kola Urundai, Egg Boti Fry, and Nethli Kozhambu. The restaurant prides itself on its rustic and flavorful dishes, offering a unique taste of Tamil Nadu's culinary heritage.

best_dishes.summary: A popular Indian street food dish consisting of a crispy potato patty served with chutney.

best_dishes.summary: A crispy, deep-fried pastry filled with a spicy onion filling.

best_dishes.name: Dal Kachori
best_dishes.summary: A crispy, deep-fried pastry filled with a spiced lentil filling.

best_dishes.name: Gond Ke Ladoo
best_dishes.summary: Sweet and nutty ladoos made with edible gum, nuts, and jaggery.

best_dishes.name: Kulhad Chai
best_dishes.summary: Traditional Indian tea served in earthen clay cups.

Diggi Palace Kitchen.summary: The Diggi Palace Kitchen sets up a pop-up chaat and chai shop during the Jaipur Literature Festival, offering authentic local dishes. The highlight of this eatery is its simple yet flavorful menu featuring dishes like aloo tikki, kachori, gond ke ladoo, and kulhad chai. This spot is popular among the festival attendees.

Hotel Fishland.title: Bangalore’s ‘Oldest’ SEAFOOD Spot, HOTEL FISHLAND | KONKANI, MANGALOREAN Fish, Prawn FRY, Crab CURRY
Hotel Fishland.address: 1st Cross Rd, Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 009

best_dishes.name: Special Limited Fish Thaali
best_dishes.summary: A satisfying fish meal with fish curry, fish fry, vegetable of the day, rice, buttermilk and yoghurt. Let down by the kingfish fry that wasn't fresh.

best_dishes.name: Bangude Fry
best_dishes.summary: Fresh, plump and juicy mackerel. Fried with masala that has a spicy and sour taste.

best_dishes.name: Prawns Fry
best_dishes.summary: Fresh, springy prawns with a robust masala coating fried to a delightful crust.

best_dishes.name: Marvai Sukka
best_dishes.summary: Clams wanting in flavor, masala is the only taste.

best_dishes.name: Crab Masala
best_dishes.summary: Delicious, plump crab with briny-sweet flavored flesh. The curry also carries the crab sweetness.

Hotel Fishland.summary:
Hotel Fishland, a 38-year-old establishment in Bengaluru, is a seafood haven specializing in Konkani and South Canara coastal cuisine.  The star attraction is their seafood thaali. While the Special Limited Fish Thaali, priced at Rs. 320, promises a hearty meal, the kingfish fry lacked freshness. The Bangude Fry (Rs. 160) and Prawns Fry (Rs. 295) receive high praise for their freshness and flavorful masala coating. Avoid the Marvai Sukka (Rs. 160) as the clams lack flavor.  The Crab Masala (Rs. 275), however, is a must-try, with its delicious, briny-sweet crab meat.  

**Unique Highlight:** Established in 1982, Hotel Fishland stands as one of Bangalore’s oldest seafood restaurants, keeping the traditional Konkani and Mangalorean coastal cuisine alive.

Gangotree Chaats and Sweets.title: TOP 9 CHAATS At Bangalore’s Oldest Chaat Shop GANGOTREE | KING OF Tasty KOLKATA, North INDIAN CHAATS
