best_dishes.summary: Super crunchy puri that holds together the spiced potato and bengal gram mix topped with the sweet, tangy paani

best_dishes.name: Jhal Mudi
best_dishes.summary: True to its Kolkata roots, mustard oil is the hero in this concoction of puffed rice, potatoes, onions and peanuts

best_dishes.name: Aloo Tikki Chola
best_dishes.summary: The aloo tikki, stuffed with green peas and grated coconut, has a nice crust. Topped with the hot chickpea gravy

best_dishes.name: Masala Cola
best_dishes.summary: A concoction of Indian cola served up with spices, it's the perfect thirst quencher to refresh the palate

best_dishes.name: Rasagoola Chaat
best_dishes.summary: A unique creation here, the ‘dissolve-in-the-mouth’ rasagoola chaat appears quite bewildering. But the mild sweetness of the rasagoola seems to work with the sweet and spicy hit of chutneys, yoghurt and the crispy texture of sev

best_dishes.name: Sev Puri
best_dishes.summary: The sev puri here plays ode to Mumbai’s streetfood with its perfect play of textures and tastes. There’s the crisp crunch of the papdi, the juicy crunch of onions and the cold creaminess of potatoes

best_dishes.name: Channa Moth Chaat
best_dishes.summary: Made sans any fried ingredients, you need to specify this when you order, the channa moth chaat is a chatpata indulgence for the health conscious

best_dishes.name: Malai Ladoo
best_dishes.summary: Rasagoola topped with reduced milk and saffron, this is a rich and indulgent dessert

Gangotree Chaats and Sweets.summary: This video is about the oldest chaat shop in Bangalore, Gangotree Chaats and Sweets, serving delicious Kolkata and North Indian chaats since 1986. Some of their popular dishes include Muesli Chat, Jerk Spiced Paneer Tikka, Bharwan Mushroom Ghee Roast, Dahi Ke Kebab, Madras Curry Spiced Lamb, and Kheema Ghotala. The highlight of the restaurant is its unique take on Indian cuisine, incorporating influences from different regions and adding a modern twist to classic dishes

The Raviz Kadavu.title: LOCAL Chef Prepares His FAMILY'S FAVE Kerala FISH CURRY + GreenPepper Mackerel Fry| The Raviz Kadavu
The Raviz Kadavu.address: The Raviz Kadavu, NH 17, Bypass, Road, Azhinjilam, Kozhikode, Kerala 673632

best_dishes.name: AYALA VALLI KURUMULAGU
best_dishes.summary: This delightful twice-cooked fish is moist and flavoursome.  The tartness of the lime, the whisper of the cheriya pepper, sweetness of the shallots and the flavour of the fish  that rounds off everything. Eat with the pumpkin leaves if you're looking to get some fiber into your system.

best_dishes.name: AVOLI VARUTHARACHA CURRY
best_dishes.summary: The fish has soaked up the robust flavours of roasted, hand-ground masala, you can taste the toasty, creamy notes of the coconut, the earthy flavours of the coriander and the sharp edge of the tamarind. The poricha pathiri makes for a scrumptious accompaniment to this delicious fish curry, as would some local boiled rice.

The Raviz Kadavu.summary: This video is about a traditional Kerala fish curry recipe. The video features Chef Arun Ramanunni Nair of The Raviz Kozhikode, who prepares a delicious sour and spicy fish curry with black pomfret. The curry is called Avoli Varutharacha Curry and is served with Poricha Pathiri and boiled rice. Chef Nair also prepares a unique mackerel fry called Ayala Valli Kurumulagu. The highlight of the dish is the use of green pepper pearls, which give the dish a unique flavor.

Adaminte Chayakkada.title: This TEA SHOP Serves Up AMAZING Local Flavours With A DELICIOUS TWIST! ADAMINTE CHAYAKKADA Calicut
Adaminte Chayakkada.address: Beach Rd, opp. Kozhikode Corporation Office, Mananchira, Kozhikode, Kerala 673032

best_dishes.name: Kidilan Chemeen Fry
best_dishes.summary: Tiger prawns cooked in the skin are juicy and moist despite being charred. The prawns certainly hold their own against spicy assault of the red chilli aided by the toasty notes of coconut oil.

best_dishes.name: Kitabilee Kozhi Porichathu
best_dishes.summary: A chicken dish that will certainly hold your attention with its hot and spicy kick, If you’re faint-hearted, you may want to tame the chilli in this satay with a squeeze of lime.

best_dishes.name: Kallumakaya Nirachathu
best_dishes.summary: A popular Kozhikoden snack, this dish of mussels stuffed with rice flour and then deep-fried with spices is a fixture on almost every restaurant menu.

best_dishes.name: KUnzhi Kozhi Nirachathu
best_dishes.summary: This roasted spring chicken, stuffed with mutta (egg) and masala made of loads of onions, thick coconut milk and cashew paste, makes for a rich bite, one that’s worthy of being served as a traditional first breakfast to a groom after the wedding.

best_dishes.name: Elaneer Chicken
best_dishes.summary: Thickened with tender coconut and garnished with slivers of fresh coconut, this chicken stew is an ode to the versatility of the fruit of the cocos nucifera. There’s a gentle sweetness to this velvety stew and the gentle warmth of ginger and green chilli.

best_dishes.name: Mapranam Fish Curry
best_dishes.summary: A vivacious curry that reflects typical toddy shop fare. The sour notes of the kokum dominate this ayakora or kingfish curry, followed by the heat of red chillies and the pungency of garlic. Savour this with boiled rice.

best_dishes.name: Chatti Choru
best_dishes.summary: Basically, the equivalent of a sadhya served in a claypot (chatti). Work the choru (rice) with the smorgasbord of dishes in the chatti, be it the dry shrimp chutney, the fried fish, aviyal or the fish thiyal, or coriander fish curry.

best_dishes.name: Parotta Kizhi
best_dishes.summary: A weighty dish of three parottas drenched in coconut milk and wrapped around chicken masala and steamed in a banana leaf bundle. A sumptuous one-dish meal.

best_dishes.name: Avil Milk (Calicut Falooda)
best_dishes.summary: AC’s spin on the Malabar staple, avil milk, is loaded with calories but sinfully delicious!

best_dishes.name: Chilli Horlicks
best_dishes.summary: Sweet Horlicks spiked with chilli flakes and pepper! Perfect for a cold night, if ever Kozhikode has one.

Adaminte Chayakkada.summary: Adaminte Chayakkada is a must-visit destination for Malabari food with a twist.  This restaurant is the brainchild of investment banker turned restaurateur Aneez Adam. Being a food lover, he wanted to present the traditional Mappila cuisine in a modern way.  A highlight of the restaurant is their unique dish, Chilli Horlicks.

Novotel Hyderabad Convention Center.title: HYDERABADI Chef Cooks MOST FAMOUS Hyderabad Vegetarian Dish | NIZAMI HANDI Recipe| Novotel Hyderabad

best_dishes.summary: A mixed vegetable curry enriched with cashew paste, cream and gently flavoured with whole spices

Novotel Hyderabad Convention Center.summary: This video is about making Nizami Handi, a popular Hyderabadi vegetarian dish. The dish is a rich and creamy curry made with mixed vegetables, cashew paste, and a blend of spices. The video highlights the use of a traditional ‘Handi’ for cooking, which gives the dish its unique flavor and aroma.

Novotel Hyderabad Convention Center.title: Making of Traditional PATTHAR KA GOSHT at Novotel Hyderabad Convention Centre | MUTTON KEBAB RECIPE

best_dishes.name: Patthar Ka Gosht
best_dishes.summary: A traditional Hyderabadi dish with royal origins, made by grilling marinated mutton slices on a hot granite slab or pan until they form a brown crust. The meat is infused with a blend of aromatic spices, ginger-garlic paste, and papaya puree for a unique flavor.

Novotel Hyderabad Convention Center.summary: The video showcases the making of Patthar Ka Gosht, a traditional Hyderabadi dish, at the Novotel Hyderabad Convention Center. Chef Mohammed Iqbal demonstrates the art of preparing this flavorful dish, believed to have originated from the royal kitchens of the Nizam. The highlight of the dish is the unique cooking technique where mutton is grilled on a hot granite slab, giving it a distinctive smoky flavor and tender texture.

Bombay Hotel.title: Popular MALABAR Snacks At 70-Year-Old BOMBAY HOTEL Calicut | UNAKAYA, ELANCHI, ELADA, BIRYANI CHAI..

best_dishes.name: BIRYANI CHAI
best_dishes.summary: A gimmicky tea poured skilfully into a glass such that the milk and tea liquor hold their own in a dancing swirl! Fancy name aside, and there are no biryani spices in this, the tea makes for a punchy companion to the loaded desserts and savouries here.

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN PUFF
best_dishes.summary: A deep-fried maida puff stuffed with chicken, onions green chillies and turmeric, this snack makes for a delicious accompaniment to some hot chai!

best_dishes.name: MUTTON CUTLET
best_dishes.summary: A filling cutlet of meat and onions flavoured with ginger.

best_dishes.name: ERACHI PATHIRI
best_dishes.summary: This stuffed pathiri is generous on the onions, but a trifle sparing on the meat, which in itself has a bit of a bite.

best_dishes.name: CHEMEEN CAKE
best_dishes.summary: a cake with a difference, this savoury steamed cake comprises of spiced shrimp sandwiched between layers of the soft cake. On the palate, I detect a hint of sweetness which contrasts with the mildly spicy shrimp. You can definitely taste the shrimp flavour in this!

best_dishes.name: ELANCHI
best_dishes.summary: A moist wobbly pancake that’s stuffed with ripe banana, fresh coconut, sugar and nuts. The tart sweetness of the banana combined with the juicy bite of the coconut is endearing, clearly a dessert that’s a must-try here.

best_dishes.name: MUTTAPOLA
best_dishes.summary: egg white and ripe banana steamed cake is a taste to be acquired.

best_dishes.name: SP UNNAKAYA
best_dishes.summary: A sticky maida fritter with a coconut, banana and egg filling.

best_dishes.name: ELADA
best_dishes.summary: A gooey steamed rice cake stuffed with coconut, banana, some lentils and jaggery, best eaten with a spoon. The rice casing is slightly mushy in texture, but the hero of this treat is certainly the banana.

best_dishes.name: LEMON TEA
best_dishes.summary: the lemon tea helps reset your palate and appetite if you want to dive back into some of the delicacies at bombay hotel.

Bombay Hotel.summary: Bombay Hotel in Kozhikode is a landmark establishment that has been serving Malabari snacks for 70 years.  They are known for their wide variety of Moplah snacks, including elanchi, chemmeen cake, and biryani chai.  The restaurant is popular for its affordable prices and its commitment to preserving the flavors of traditional Malabar cuisine.

Strawberry Milkshake.summary: A delicious, tart, sweet, and thick strawberry shake.

Custard Apple Milkshake.summary: A refreshing and flavorful milkshake with the ripe sweetness and grainy bite of custard apple. This shake can even be a meal replacement.

Avocado Milkshake.summary: A tasty and healthy milkshake with the sweet and buttery mouthfeel of avocado, perfect for getting your daily dose of superfoods.

Jai Bhuvaneshwari Miltry Hotel.title: Visiting JAI BHUVANESHWARI Miltry Hotel For A MEATY BREAKFAST | Srirangapatna | MUTTON CHOPS| KHEEMA
Jai Bhuvaneshwari Miltry Hotel.address: T Narasipura - Srirangapatna Rd, Baburayanakoppal, Karnataka 571807

MUTTON CHOPS.name: MUTTON CHOPS
MUTTON CHOPS.summary: A thick gravy preparation that comes with a generous piece of Bannur mutton. The meat is pink encased in a thin sheath of fat and cooked to soft juicy perfection. You taste the robust meaty flavours in the gravy and the green chilli heat that slowly creeps up on you. Don't forget to suck on the bone for a generous slurp of the marrow.

KHEEMA UNDE.name: KHEEMA UNDE
KHEEMA UNDE.summary: As you break into these, you notice only the tender pink of the meat. The mutton in this unde is coarsely ground giving it a delicious texture. This meatball is all about the meat and the warm spices in the gravy.

LEG SOUP.name: LEG SOUP
LEG SOUP.summary: The gelatin in the trotter has rendered well into the nourishing soup, lending it a gamey savouriness that’s offset by the spices in this soup. This dish will definitely warm you up from within!

THATTE IDLI.name: THATTE IDLI
THATTE IDLI.summary: On the Bangalore-Mysore highway, the Thatte Idli rules and i had to order some to savour with my meaty sides! The idli served steaming hot is super soft. With the mutton chops gravy it just melts in the mouth. No chewing at all, it just disintegrates leaving behind the savouriness of the spices and meaty flavour.

Jai Bhuvaneshwari Miltry Hotel.summary: Jai Bhuvaneshwari Miltry Hotel is a 40-year-old eatery in Srirangapatna on the Bangalore-Mysore Highway, known for its robust, meaty, village-style breakfast.  The restaurant is popular for its Mutton Chops, Kheema Unde, and Paya Soup,  best enjoyed with steaming hot Thatte Idli. The highlight of the restaurant is its use of traditional recipes and fresh, local ingredients, resulting in a truly authentic and flavourful dining experience.

best_dishes.name: NAATU KOZHI BRIYANI
best_dishes.summary: Similar to the mutton biryani but without the fattiness, this biryani features flavorful country chicken with a bit of bite.

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN LEG PIECE
best_dishes.summary: Deep-fried chicken leg marinated and fried to crispy perfection. Retains juicy moistness inside. Served with crispy, herbaceous curry leaves.

best_dishes.name: VANJARAM FRY
best_dishes.summary: Seer fish fry coated in a robust masala with fenugreek notes. Curry leaves and lime add savouriness and acidity. The fish is fried to a satisfying crisp.

Spicy Venue.summary: This video is about the top 5 restaurants in Hyderabad, India. The host, Kripal Amanna, takes viewers through his five favorite restaurants/ cafes to eat at based on his culinary trail in the city. He starts with Bawarchi Restaurant, which is known for its Hyderabadi biryani. He then visits Cafe Nimrah, which is known for its cookies and Irani chai. The Spicy Venue.title: Tasting Traditional TELUGU DELICACIES At THE SPICY VENUE | Hyderabad | VEG THALI| MLA POTLAM BIRYANI
The Spicy Venue.address: No. 265/S, Road Number 10, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500033

best_dishes.name: MLA POTLAM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: A unique surf and turf style biryani. The signature of this dish is the thin, veil-like omelette in which the fresh water shrimp and mutton mince biryani is wrapped!  The rice has a mellow spicing. The shrimp has a mild saline flavour yet is deliciously sweet.

best_dishes.name: VEGETARIAN THALI
best_dishes.summary: This thali is complete with traditional telugu delicacies, all vegetarian! From a slightly tart and wholesome dosakaya pappu, to a crunchy bendakaya vepudu, to potatoes roasted with cashew - bangaladumpa vepudu, pesara pulusu, a tart drumstick ulavacharu and more, these dishes can be savoured with piping hot rice and loads of ghee!

best_dishes.name: KODI IGURU
best_dishes.summary: This chicken dish has a rich, savoury onion base that also has a certain sweetness to it. Toasted cashews and curry leaves further intensify the savoury notes in the preparation.

best_dishes.name: SPECIAL CHEPA VEPUDU
best_dishes.summary: This is the traditional andhra fish fry. Coated in a mellow, roasted masala the fish is moist in every bite. A simple dish made well.

best_dishes.name: KAKINADA  PEETHALA IGURU
best_dishes.summary: The kakinada sea crab is sweet, juicy and has absorbed all the deep roasted masala. There’s a slight pepperiness that balances wells against the sweetness of the crab. Delicious!

best_dishes.name: NELLORE CHEPALA PULUSU
best_dishes.summary: This andhra delicacy is made using the local korameenu or murrel fish cooked in a tomato and onion gravy. The curry also has a puckering sourness from the use of tamarind and raw mango. This is balances out when eaten with that fleshy fish!

best_dishes.name: NAATU KODI PULUSU
best_dishes.summary: A traditional homestyle curry made with country chicken. The aromatic masala base has a prominent fennel flavour. The naatu kodi is cooked pink and juicy!

best_dishes.name: LOOSE PRAWNS
best_dishes.summary: A popular appetiser at the spicy venue. The prawns are delicately flavoured with pepper, fresh coriander and chillies.

best_dishes.name: APRICOT DELIGHT
best_dishes.summary: The spicy venue’s take on the classic qubani ka meetha. A pudding made with a biscuit base, layered with sponge cake, apricot jam and topped with custard.

The Spicy Venue.summary: This video is a food review of The Spicy Venue restaurant in Hyderabad, India. The restaurant serves traditional Andhra and Telugu cuisine. The reviewer recommends the Vegetarian Thali, which features a variety of Andhra dishes, and the MLA Potlam Biryani, a unique biryani dish with fresh water shrimp and mutton mince wrapped in a thin omelette. The reviewer also tries and enjoys several other dishes, including Kodi Iguru, Special Chepa Vepudu, Kakinada Peethala Iguru, Nellore Chepala Pulusu, Naatu Kodi Pulusu, Loose Prawns, and Apricot Delight. The highlight of the restaurant is its unique take on traditional Andhra cuisine, particularly the MLA Potlam Biryani.

best_dishes.name: Prawn Fry
best_dishes.summary: These tiny freshwater shrimp are cooked to a tender bite. The masala is deep roasted, one with onions, chilli, curry leaf and a slightly coconutty note.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Fry
best_dishes.summary: The masala coating that chicken is finger licking good. The chicken cooked to absolute perfection has absorbed all those spices! You taste that flavour of the roasted masala right away, in the very first bite.

best_dishes.name: Omelette
best_dishes.summary: This is an omelette that’s simply done. It’s got the tasty crunch of the onions and the spice of green chilli.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Curry
best_dishes.summary: This is a homestyle chicken curry made using a family secret spice mix that is hand ground fresh! This is an assertive masala that takes over your palate with each bite.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Fry
best_dishes.summary: The rich masala is a result of deep roasted onions and spices that lends this dish an irresistible savoury flavour. The texture of the mutton is almost velvety!

Sri Kakatiya Deluxe Mess.summary: Sri Kakatiya Deluxe Mess, a renowned eatery in Hyderabad’s Ameerpet, is a local favorite for its delectable Andhra cuisine. This no-frills restaurant prioritizes quick service and offers authentic vegetarian meals complemented by flavorful seafood and meat options. The highlight of the restaurant is its commitment to providing a homestyle Andhra dining experience.

Bawarchi Restaurant.title: Making of The ORIGINAL BAWARCHI BIRYANI In Hyderabad | Tasting MUTTON DUM BIRYANI |CHICKEN BIRYANI
Bawarchi Restaurant.address: Plot No. 44, RTC Cross Rd, Opposite Sandhya Theatre, Chikkadpally, New Nallakunta, Hyderabad, Telangana 500020

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: This biryani has an alluring aroma. every grain of rice and the succulent chicken has absorbed the aromatic, gently spiced masala. the sherva made with chilli powder and a base of sesame seeds helps moisten the biryani also lending it a layer of flavour.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: This dish is comforting and flavourful thanks to the dum style of cooking. the rice and meat are cooked to perfect doneness. the succulent mutton lends the rice its meaty flavour. this is an expertly crafted biriyani.

Bawarchi Restaurant.summary: This video is about the making of the original Bawarchi Biryani in Hyderabad. The video starts with an introduction to Bawarchi Restaurant and its popularity. It then shows the process of making the biryani from scratch, followed by a tasting of the Chicken Dum Biryani and the Mutton Dum Biryani. The highlight of the video is the exclusive demonstration of how the iconic biryani is made from scratch.

Nimrah Cafe and Bakery.title: NIMRAH CAFÉ | Hyderabad’s Most Popular IRANI CHAI & Osmania Biscuits |CHARMINAR|Making Of Irani Chai
Nimrah Cafe and Bakery.address: #20-4-1238/39, Beside Mecca Masjid, Charminar, Ghansi Bazaar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500002

best_dishes.name: Osmania Biscuit
best_dishes.summary: A biscuit with a delicate crust. It is soft and crumbly with a salty sweet flavour. Perfect to snack on with a cup of chai!

best_dishes.name: Rusk Toast
best_dishes.summary: The rusk is studded with tutti frutti and nuts which give it a sweet bite as well as texture. Its dry and crunchy with a sticky, gooey inside.

best_dishes.name: Pista Biscuit
best_dishes.summary: One crumbly cookie that just about holds together before disintegrating in your mouth! Its studded with the pistachio which gives it a signature green tint.

best_dishes.name: Coconut Dry Fruit Biscuit
best_dishes.summary: These cookies are light, porous, and carry the light toasty notes of coconut. They have a restrained sweetness to them, reason why youll keep going back for another!

best_dishes.name: Irani Chai
best_dishes.summary: The potent decoction cooked and reduced down for hours makes this chai unlike any other! You first taste the mildly bitter, tannic notes of the brew that catches hold of your palate, followed by the creamy milk. The sugar plays the second fiddle. This tea makes the perfect complement to osmania biscuits.

Nimrah Cafe and Bakery.summary: This video is about the iconic Nimrah Cafe and Bakery in Hyderabad, known for its Irani chai and Osmania biscuits. Food Lovers Kripal Amanna takes us through a delightful tasting of their best biscuits like the Cherry Coconut, Osmania, Star Cashew, Fruit, Pista, and Coconut Dry Fruit. He raves about the buns and rusk toast, praising their freshness and flavor. The highlight is undoubtedly the Irani Chai, described as a potent decoction with a unique flavor that perfectly complements the biscuits.  Nimrah Cafe and Bakery, a must-visit for anyone looking for an authentic Hyderabadi culinary experience.

Chutneys.title: BEST Andhra Breakfast |Chutneys Hyderabad|LONGEST 70MM DOSA|Babai Idli| CHIRANJEEVI DOSA| 6 CHUTNEYS
Chutneys.address: Hi-tech City, Main Road, Beside @Home, Surya Enclave, Kothaguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081

best_dishes.name: 70MM DOSA
best_dishes.summary: This 70mm dosa is 4 feet long, thick in its texture with a slightly tart edge. Tasting this dosa with the six different chutneys, from the spicy and sweet ginger and jaggery, grainy lentil chutney to the sweet kobari chutney is a treat to the senses!

best_dishes.name: CHUTNEYS
best_dishes.summary: each of these chutneys holds it own in its flavours. the kobari lausu is simple, you taste the coconut and a light sweetness. the coconut and peanut chutney has an endearing spicy edge while the putnalu chutney has that wholesome grainy texture from the lentils. The tomato and corn chutney dabbles in fusion! Another favourite here is the tangy, sweet and spicy allam bellam or ginger and jaggery chutney.

best_dishes.name: BABAI IDLI
best_dishes.summary: these steaming hot idlis topped with a dollop of butter are super soft! the white butter melts into the idli making it all the more crumbly! the chutneys give every bite a different dimension of flavour.

best_dishes.name: GUNTUR IDLI
best_dishes.summary: smeared with a mixture of the guntur chilli podi mixed with ghee, this is a spicy idli! The chutneys help mellow the spice in the podi.  the Andhra style sambar is lusciously thick and great accompaniment.

best_dishes.name: CHIRANJEEVI DOSA
best_dishes.summary: This thick dosa is steamed and uses absolutely no oil! This is a spongy dosa with a crunchy crust. It is served with a cheruku panakam or sugarcane syrup that is intensely sweet, perfect to be lapped up with this thick dosa.

best_dishes.name: MLA PESARATTU
best_dishes.summary: A green gram pancake stuffed with upma. A unique dish.  you taste the crunch of the onion, cashew and the spice from the green chilli. grainy crunch of the pesarattu and the soft upma give this dish a contrast in its textures.

best_dishes.name: MANGO UTHAPPAM
best_dishes.summary: A raw mango paste mixed with red chilli powder is smeared on top of this thick uthappam. you taste the tanginess that kicks in at the end of each bite.

Chutneys.summary: This video is a food review of Chutneys, a popular South Indian vegetarian restaurant in Hyderabad, India. The reviewer tries a variety of dishes, including their famous 70mm dosa, Babai Idli, and a variety of chutneys. He highly recommends the food, praising the flavors and textures of each dish. The highlight of the restaurant is its extensive chutney selection, with each chutney offering a unique flavor profile.

Bombay Brasserie.address: #2989/B, 12th Main Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008

best_dishes.name: Chilli Cheese Kulcha
best_dishes.summary: A modern Indian take on the classic Kulcha, paired with Hopper Witbier.

best_dishes.name: Kashmiri Kebab
best_dishes.summary: A flavorful kebab dish, paired with Hopper Blonde beer.

best_dishes.name: Aam Papad Paneer
best_dishes.summary: A unique dish featuring Aam Papad (mango leather) and Paneer, paired with Hopper Blonde beer.

Bombay Brasserie.summary: This video reviews the special Hoppetizer menu at Bombay Brasserie in Indiranagar, Bangalore, curated in partnership with Hopper Authentic Belgian Craft Beer. The menu features modern Indian cuisine with dishes paired with two of Hopper's beers - the Blonde Belgian Lager and the Hopper Witbier. The host recommends the Chilli Cheese Kulcha paired with the Hopper Witbier, Kashmiri Kebab with the Hopper Blonde, and Aam Papad Paneer also with the Hopper Blonde.  The unique highlight of this experience is the specially curated menu blending modern Indian cuisine with Belgian craft beers.  The promotion offers a free Hoppetizer for every two bottles of Hopper Beer purchased and is available until January 31st, 2020.

Murugan Idli Shop.title: Tasting Famous Podi Idli At MURUGAN IDLI SHOP | Krishnagiri | GHEE MASALA DOSA | PONGAL |JIGARTHANDA
Murugan Idli Shop.address: S.NO.36/3, Binappalli Village, Near Arabic College Bangalore Selam Highway, NH 44, Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu 635001

best_dishes.name: Ghee Podi Idli
best_dishes.summary: A softer idli with a springy texture. Slathered with ghee and doused in a spirited, spicy podi. The heat of the podi is tamed when eaten with the creamy lentils in the sambar.

best_dishes.name: Ghee Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A crisp and translucent dosa with a creamy, almost pate-like potato filling. The dosa batter doesn't interfere with the flavors of the soft mash and retains its crunch despite being dunked into the sambar.

best_dishes.name: Onion Uthappam
best_dishes.summary: An uthappam loaded with roasted onions, offering a delicious caramelized note. The thick uthappam cradles all the delicious textures and flavors, with the chutney providing a nice break.

best_dishes.name: Special Sweet Pongal
best_dishes.summary: A pongal dish laden with ghee, but not overly sweet. Toasted cashews add a nice bite and cut through the dairy richness of the ghee.

Murugan Idli Shop.summary: This video is a review of the Murugan Idli Shop in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu. The reviewer highlights the restaurant's signature dishes, including the Podi Idli, Masala Dosa, Pongal, and Jigarthanda. He praises the Ghee Podi Idli for its soft and springy texture, the Ghee Masala Dosa for its crispiness and flavorful filling, and the Onion Uthappam for its abundance of caramelized onions. He also enjoys the Special Sweet Pongal, noting the balance of sweetness and the crunchy cashews. The unique aspect highlighted is the delicate crunch of the dosa, even after being dipped in sambar, resembling a puff pastry.

Ti Amo.title: Tasting GARLIC PRAWNS, PATATA BRAVAS, CHICKEN PAPRIKA At TI AMO, Bengaluru| The Hoppetizer Trail
Ti Amo.address: 25/3, Kensington Rd, Someshwarpura, Halasuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008

best_dishes.name: Gumbass al Ajillo
best_dishes.summary: Garlic Prawn dish.

best_dishes.name: Prawn Popcorn
best_dishes.summary: Prawn Popcorn with Chipotle spice

best_dishes.name: Chicken Paprika
best_dishes.summary: moist Chicken Paprika

best_dishes.name: Falafel
best_dishes.summary: Falafel served with Pita and a medley of pickled vegetables

Ti Amo.summary: Ti Amo at The Conrad, Bengaluru is an al fresco dining Mediterranean restaurant. The menu, designed by Chef Ameet Rane, features dishes like the Gumbass al Ajillo (Garlic Prawn), Prawn Popcorn with Chipotle spice, moist Chicken Paprika, and Falafel served with Pita and pickled vegetables. The restaurant has partnered with Hopper Authentic Belgian Craft Beer to offer The Hoppetizer Trail, a special menu designed to pair with Hopper’s Blonde Belgian Lager and Hopper Witbier. The Hoppetizer Trail at Ti Amo is priced at Rs 1110 ++, inclusive of one appetizer and two Hopper beers.  The promotion runs until January 31st, 2020. best_dishes.name: Luru Prawns
best_dishes.summary: Prawns cooked with local Bangalore flavors

best_dishes.name: Magic Mushrooms
best_dishes.summary: Unique mushroom dish with a twist

best_dishes.name: Mushroom Pepper Fry
best_dishes.summary: Classic South Indian style pepper mushroom fry

Social.summary: This video is about the launch of the Hoppetizer Trail at Social in Bengaluru, India, in partnership with Hopper Authentic Belgian Craft Beer.  The trail features a special menu curated to pair with Hopper’s Blonde Belgian Lager and Hopper Witbier. Food Lovers Editor Kripal Amanna explores the menu, which includes Gunpowder Baby Potatoes, Chicken Magic Kebabs, Luru Prawns, Magic Mushrooms, and Mushroom Pepper Fry. The unique element of this is that each dish is paired with a specific Hopper beer.  The promotion runs until January 31, 2020, and offers one free Hoppetizer with every two bottles of Hopper Beer purchased.

Karavalli.title: Tasting 14 COASTAL DELICACIES At KARAVALLI Bengaluru |LOBSTER, CRAB, PRAWN, OCTOPUS, POMFRET & More!
Karavalli.address: Ground Floor, The Gateway Hotel, Residency Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025

best_dishes.name: BABY LOBSTER JIREM MIREM
best_dishes.summary: Chunky baby lobster meat marinated and cooked in a cumin (jirem) and fresh pepper (mirem) masala. you taste the byadgi chilli as opposed to the pepper in this warming masala.

best_dishes.name: KOONDAL PORICHATU
best_dishes.summary: The batter-fried masala coated squid is cooked to springy perfection and the masala has penetrated all the way through. the fresh acidity of a squeeze of lime cradles that gentle spicing of the squid. this is the sort of dish that would make for a very happy bar snack.

best_dishes.name: WHOLE SILVER POMFRET RECHEADO
best_dishes.summary: This dish of whole fried silver pomfret is a taste of goa! liberally coated in the sweet, tart and hot goan recheado masala, both inside and out, you taste notes of the goan palm vinegar and the aggressive punch of chilli as you devour the dish.

best_dishes.name: TIGER PRAWN MALABAR STYLE
best_dishes.summary: A signature dish at karavalli i keep returning for! these meaty tiger prawns are first fried to perfect scrumptiousness and then tossed in a vivacious masala of shallots, tomatoes and pepper.

best_dishes.name: SEA CRAB GHEE ROAST
best_dishes.summary: These meaty sea crabs, cooked in a ghee roast masala are divine! i love the mild sweetness of that crab meat (tastes just like the ocean!). the butteriness of that well rounded masala embraces the natural flavours of the crab.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON STEW
best_dishes.summary: This is a textbook syrian christian stew with the mellow coconut base carrying just the subtlest hint of spicing. the meat is soft, you taste its nourishment in every strand.

best_dishes.name: PRAWN CALDEEN
best_dishes.summary: This goan-style curry is a pleasant melange of flavours. you taste the freshness of the coriander, the spice of the green chilli, raspy bite of the ginger and the creaminess of the coconut in the sauce. the prawns are juicy having absorbed all that goodness.

best_dishes.name: ALAPPUZHA MEEN CURRY
best_dishes.summary: The deep, spice notes in this alleppey fish curry catches hold of your palate from the first bite. the seer, a meaty fish, is the right medium to convey and carry these bold flavours of coconut, ginger and raw mango.

best_dishes.name: DODOL
best_dishes.summary: My favourite way to end a meal at karavalli is with the dodol, a goan dessert made with rice flour that has been well roasted with palm jaggery and loads of butter! it is rich and dark, each bite is lush, buttery yet dry.

Karavalli.summary: Karavalli at The Gateway Hotel Bengaluru is a fine dining restaurant that specializes in South West Coastal cuisine. They host an annual seafood festival called Aquafest, which features a variety of dishes such as baby lobster, octopus, squid, pomfret, tiger prawns, and crab. The restaurant also serves other dishes such as chicken, mutton stew, and fish curry. Karavalli is known for its authentic flavors and its commitment to using fresh, high-quality ingredients.  The unique highlight of this restaurant is their annual seafood festival called Aquafest which has been running since the inception of the restaurant.

Hotel Original VINAYAKA MYLARI.address: Shop No, 79, Nazarbad Main Rd, Doora, Mysuru, Karnataka 570010

best_dishes.name: Idli
best_dishes.summary: These woodfire steamed idlis are soft, fluffy, aromatic and slightly tart. saagu is robustly flavoured, with a coriander accent. the vegetables still have their crunch intact.

best_dishes.name: Masala dosa
best_dishes.summary: This dosa is unbelievably soft and fragile. Holds together just enough to contain the vegetable saagu. After the initial crunch, the dosa dissolves in the mouth! The chutney adds a touch of freshness and spice.

best_dishes.name: Kashi Halwa
best_dishes.summary: it's not overly sweet and is cooked down just right to a jammy consistency with an endearing stickiness

Hotel Original VINAYAKA MYLARI.summary: This video is about the famous Mylari Dosa from Hotel Original Vinayaka Mylari in Mysuru. The host, Kripal Amanna, takes us through the making of these soft, melt-in-the-mouth dosas, cooked on a massive iron tawa over a hot wood fire. He also samples the Idlis and the Kashi Halwa. The highlight of the video is the unique way the dosas are cooked on a wood fire, giving them their signature soft and melt-in-the-mouth texture.

Hotel RRR.title: MYSURU’S favourite Andhra-Style BIRYANI At HOTEL RRR | Chilli Chicken |Mutton Pepper Fry | Biryani
Hotel RRR.address: Gandhi Square, Near, Mahatma Gandhi Statue, Lashkar Mohalla, Chamrajpura, Mysuru, Karnataka 570 001

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: The chicken is tender and juicy, having soaked up that fiery chilli gravy. A squeeze of lemon helps tone down the spice slightly.

best_dishes.name: Mutton pepper fry
best_dishes.summary: This masala is well-roasted, with toasty notes of onion and pepper. The meat has its bite intact. there’s bits of organ meat, and the kidney especially has a nice, briny, meaty flavour that goes well with the masala.

best_dishes.name: Chicken biryani
best_dishes.summary: Fragrant biryani studded with flecks of tomato and chilli slices. every grain of the basmati rice has soaked in the spice and flavour of the chicken. the slightly tart gravy on the side helps transform the flavours of this mellow biryani.

best_dishes.name: Mutton biryani
best_dishes.summary: Has similar spicing to the chicken biryani but feels a little more moist thanks to the juices of the mutton! every bite is flavourful. You can taste the flavour of the tender meat and the fat that has rendered into the rice.

Hotel RRR.summary: This biryani establishment in Mysuru has been serving classic Andhra-style fare for over 40 years.  Hotel RRR is best known for robust, flavourful dishes like biryani, chilli chicken, and mutton pepper fry. The highlight of this restaurant is its commitment to authentic Andhra flavors and the use of high-quality ingredients.

Tegu Mess.title: Local-Style Non-Vegetarian Meals At TEGU MESS In Mysuru | IDLI | PEPPER CHICKEN | MUTTON CURRY
Tegu Mess.address: Adipampa Road, 6th Cross Rd, Vani Vilas Mohalla, Mysuru, Karnataka 570 002

best_dishes.name: Idli with Gravy
best_dishes.summary: Steaming hot and fluffy idlis. can be savoured with a chicken gravy or a robust mutton gravy that packs heaps of flavour.

best_dishes.name: Paya
best_dishes.summary: Has a nourishing, delicate flavour with a hint of pepper and fresh herby zing of coriander. the gelatinous trotter just melts in your mouth!

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: A light, delicate stew cooked with mild spices allowing the meat flavour to be most dominant. The mutton is soft and peels effortlessly off the bone!

best_dishes.name: Pepper Chicken
best_dishes.summary: This is a delicious gravy. notes of pepper and fenugreek give it a deep flavour. the chicken is lushly flavoured with that masala, and is tender and juicy in every bite.

best_dishes.name: Ghee Rice
best_dishes.summary: A staple here made with long grain rice. its aromatic on its own but can also be paired with the delicious meaty sides!

best_dishes.name: Chilli Chicken
best_dishes.summary: Loaded with tomatoes and coriander this gravy has a gentle, roasted red chilli heat. it is very different from the green chilli heat that one is used to. the curry also has a certain smokiness to it.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Liver
best_dishes.summary: Made in green masala made that is loaded with fresh coriander. works well with the earthy, meaty, irony notes of the liver. the liver has a slight bite but yields quickly.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Curry
best_dishes.summary: A superb curry! The mellow spicing allows the meat to shine. all the flavour of the meat is in the gravy. the sort of dish your grandmother would cook for you.

Tegu Mess.summary: Tegu Mess in Mysore is a hole-in-the-wall eatery that has been serving local-style non-vegetarian food for almost 50 years.  Known for its wholesome meat dishes, each item is made with unique masalas ground in-house by the family. The restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  A highlight of Tegu Mess is their commitment to using family recipes and freshly ground spices, giving their dishes a home-cooked taste.

Hotel Hanumanthu.title: Tasting & Watching The Making Of Mysuru’s Most Popular MUTTON PULAV At Hotel Hanumanthu|Mysore Trail
Hotel Hanumanthu.address: Hotel Hanumanthu Original 1930, 1720, Akbar road, Mandi Mohalla, Mysuru, Karnataka 570001

best_dishes.name: Mutton Pulav
best_dishes.summary: A fragrant biryani with perfectly cooked pieces of mutton, intensified with organ meat and fat.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: Prepared to highlight the flavour of the meat, the gravy carries the taste of fat and meat.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Boti
best_dishes.summary: Tender and flavorful liver, intestines, and offal meat in a thick, creamy gravy that complements the meat without overpowering it.

Hotel Hanumanthu.summary: This video takes you on a culinary journey to Hotel Hanumanthu in Mysuru, renowned for its iconic mutton pulav. The restaurant, run by a father-son duo, preserves tradition by cooking on firewood. The highlight is the detailed showcasing of the mutton pulav preparation, its aromatic spices, and tender mutton. Food Lovers’ Editor Kripal Amanna also recommends the flavorful mutton chops and the rich mutton boti, praising the tenderness and taste of the meat in each dish.  The restaurant's dedication to quality and tradition makes it a must-visit for an authentic taste of Mysore’s culinary heritage.

Gayathri Tiffin Room.title: Visiting GAYATHRI TIFFIN ROOM For The BEST TIFFIN/ BREAKFAST In Mysore! GTR Masala Dose |Kesari Bath
Gayathri Tiffin Room.address: 2954, 1, NS Road, near Ramachandra Agrahara, Chamundipuram, Ramachandra Agrahara, Mysuru, Karnataka 570004

best_dishes.name: GTR Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A delightful crunchy dosa with a soft interior. It has a nice buttery flavour. The potatoes are soft, creamy and have a generous amount of onion and fresh coriander for that sprightly freshness. The dosa itself is quite thick. Served with a fresh spicy chutney.

best_dishes.name: Idli
best_dishes.summary: The idli has a grainy texture and a mildly vegetal flavour that suggests it may have been steamed in a leaf. The spicy chutney has the fresh flavour of coconut and body from the ground lentils. The sambar has a gentle sweetness typical of a South Canara sambar.

best_dishes.name: Green Dosa
best_dishes.summary: The heavy texture and thickness is reminiscent of an uthappam. Nicely roasted at the bottom. Served with a tasty vegetable saagu and a spicy chutney to lift all the flavours. Theres a mild lingering flavour of dill.

best_dishes.name: Open Butter Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: Slightly thick, well-roasted dosa. The podi has a hint of sweetness and a bit of spice that is mellowed out by the butter. The palya is creamy and soft. The chutney helps lift the flavours of everything on the plate.

best_dishes.name: Uppitu
best_dishes.summary: Very gentle delicate flavour of tomato, fried lentils, and curry leaves. Theres the soft grainy texture of semolina with a hint of spice and onion for crunch.

best_dishes.name: Kesari Bath
best_dishes.summary: Reminiscent of a badam halwa in terms of texture. silky, velvety with barely any graininess. Restrained sweetness with the occasional gentle pop of raisins. The ghee makes it lush and seductively delicious. Kesari bath at a whole new level! Definitely one of the best

best_dishes.name: Filter Coffee
best_dishes.summary: Nice and frothy on top. Sort of coffee that makes you happy!

Gayathri Tiffin Room.summary: Join us on Gourmet On The Road as we visit Gayathri Tiffin Room, or GTR, a Mysore institution known for its delectable South Indian breakfast and tiffin. For over half a century, GTR has been delighting patrons with its variety of dosas, especially the GTR Masala Dosa.  Unlike a typical Mysore Masala Dosa, the GTR Masala Dosa boasts a thick, crispy exterior and a soft, fluffy interior. The highlight is their unique take on the masala dosa,  a must try for anyone looking for authentic Mysore flavors

Mangalore Pearl.title: Affordable, Fresh & Delicious SEAFOOD At MANGALORE PEARL | PRAWN GHEE ROAST | KANE FRY | CRAB & More
Mangalore Pearl.address: 2nd Floor, 5/1, Assaye Road, Skywalk Building, Assaye Rd, next to YMIA or BodyCraft, Ulsoor, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560042

PRAWN GHEE ROAST.name: PRAWN GHEE ROAST
PRAWN GHEE ROAST.summary: Soaking in oodles of ghee this is one of the best prawn ghee roasts. The prawns are plump and fresh, being coated in all that roasted masala that does not overpower its sweet flavour. The neer dosa serves as the perfect combination to this dish. The beautiful balance of spice, toasty flavour notes of coconut oil, rich ghee and divine prawns will keep you coming back for this dish!

POMFRET STEW CURRY.name: POMFRET STEW CURRY
POMFRET STEW CURRY.summary: The spicing in this masala is mellow and refreshing and just right, allowing the flavours of the pristine, fresh pomfret to shine. This stew curry goes deliciously well with mangalore rice.

KANE TAWA FRY.name: KANE TAWA FRY
KANE TAWA FRY.summary: This fish is as fresh as it gets! So delicates that the meat just flakes apart effortlessly. The pullimunchi masala gives off a warming note o f the byadgi chilli and also a slight tartness from vinegar. The fish has absorbed the masala, yet retains its unique flavour. Be mindful of the tiny pin bones though!

BANGUDE FRY.name: BANGUDE FRY
BANGUDE FRY.summary: The butterflied mackerel allows for the masala to penetrate the deep flavours of this fish. Notwithstanding this, the mackerel asserts its strong flavour from the word go despite being fried in a spicy masala.

CRAB MASALA.name: CRAB MASALA
CRAB MASALA.summary: Tossed in a semi-dry onion and tomato masala that complements the mildly sweet, flesh of this dotted sea crab dont forget to suck on the crab meat!

KHUBEY MOOTLIEN.name: KHUBEY MOOTLIEN
KHUBEY MOOTLIEN.summary: This dish deserves attention when being savoured, especially when picking on the tiny yet sweet and mildly briny clam flesh. The rice dumpling has a sticky, slightly slimy texture that goes very well with the thick, velvety coconut based gravy. The flavour of the clams in this dish is reminiscent of the ocean.

Mangalore Pearl.summary: Mangalore Pearl in Bengaluru is a popular spot for Mangalorean Catholic-style seafood. Established by Steven Pinto, the restaurant is known for its flavorful seafood dishes and Mangalorean classics.  The host tries a variety of dishes, including the highly recommended Prawn Ghee Roast, Pomfret Stew Curry, and Kane Tawa Fry. The seafood is fresh, the masalas are well-balanced, and the overall dining experience is delightful.  What makes this restaurant unique is its dedication to serving authentic Mangalorean cuisine, using fresh seafood and traditional recipes.

SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.title: Exciting Street Food Trail VV Puram PT 2 | AVAREKALU VADA, OBBATTU, Badam Milk, FIRE PAAN & More
SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.address: 78 3rd block 5th main road thyagarajnagar bull temple road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560028

best_dishes.name: AVAREKALU VADA
best_dishes.summary: This vada is every fried food lovers delight! Made using a mixture of water hyacinth bean, dill, gram flour and aromats like onion, ginger, garlic, chilli and coriander this is as delicious and nutritious as a vada can get. In short, hot, crunchy and mouthwatering!

SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.title: Exciting Street Food Trail VV Puram PT 2 | AVAREKALU VADA, OBBATTU, Badam Milk, FIRE PAAN & More
SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.address: 78 3rd block 5th main road thyagarajnagar bull temple road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560028

best_dishes.name: AVAREKALU VADA

best_dishes.name: PADDU
best_dishes.summary: An enriched dosa batter that is cooked on a tava speckled with spherical cavities. It has a slight sour twang coupled with the crunch of the onions and freshness of the dill. Delicious when eaten with coconut, chana dal and green chilli chutney.

SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.summary: Kripal Amanna explores the best street food in Bengaluru, India, at VV Puram Food Street (Thindi Beedi). He recommends the Avarekalu Vada at SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI, describing it as a must-try for fried food enthusiasts. He also suggests the Avarebele Akki Rotti at SRI VASAVI MANE THINDI, highlighting the crunchy crust and soft interior of the akki roti. At SRI GURU DEV IDLI MANE, the Mini Idlis are highly praised. For a sweet treat, Amanna recommends the Plain Obbattu and Kai Obbattu at IDLI MANE. The Mumbai Badam Milk at MUMBAI BADAM MILK AND LASSI CENTER and the Gulkand Ice Cream at SHIVANNA GULCAN ICE CREAM CENTER are also highly recommended. To aid digestion, Amanna suggests trying the unique Fire Paan at PAAN POINT.  A highlight of the video is the emphasis on the variety and deliciousness of vegetarian street food available at VV Puram Food Street in Bengaluru.

SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.title: Exciting Street Food Trail VV Puram PT 2 | AVAREKALU VADA, OBBATTU, Badam Milk, FIRE PAAN & More

SRI VASAVI VAISISTA THINDI.summary: Join Food Lovers Editor, Kripal Amanna, on a final street food adventure through VV Puram's Thindi Beedi. He indulges in local favorites like the crispy Avarekalu Vada and hearty Avarebele Akki Rotti. A visit to the 45-year-old Guru Idlis for their famous Mini Idlis is a must. Sweet treats like Holiges, Badam Milk, and the iconic Gulcan Ice Cream provide a delightful end to the journey. And to aid digestion after 21 dishes, Kripal tries the fiery Fire Paan.  The highlight of this culinary journey is the sheer variety of vegetarian dishes available at Thindi Beedi, showcasing the rich culinary heritage of Bengaluru.

VB BAKERY.title: Bengaluru’s Popular VV PURAM FOOD STREET PT 1 | VB BAKERY, Mosaru Kodubale, Bajji Chaats Chai & More
VB BAKERY.address: No.20, Sajjan Rao Cir, Vishweshwarapura, Shankarapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004

best_dishes.name: KHARA BUTTER AND CONGRESS KADLEKAI BUN
best_dishes.summary: The first flavour to hit your palate is the savouriness of the curry leaves. you taste the buttery goodness, followed by the chilli and the crunch of the peanuts! this could very well be the Iyengar version of the peanut butter sandwich!

best_dishes.name: BUN BUTTER JAM
best_dishes.summary: This special bun is made with milk powder and has some raisins in it too. slathered with a generous lashing of butter and mixed fruit jam, this dish is a slice of nostalgia packed in a bun!

best_dishes.name: HONEYCAKE
best_dishes.summary: made with pure coorg honey, this honeycake is dense and sticky. the top is light, airy and spongy but the bottom is where the sugary attack of the honey hits you.

Their signature KBC or Khara Butter Bun Congress is a must-try, with its unique blend of curry leaves, butter, chilli, and peanuts. For those who prefer something sweeter, the Bun Butter Jam and Honeycake are excellent choices.

VB BAKERY.summary: This video is about street food in Bengaluru, India, specifically in the VV Puram area. The video highlights the variety of vegetarian street food available, including bajji, chaat, and kodubale. The video also provides a glimpse into the local culture and the passion that people have for food in Bengaluru.

VB BAKERY.title: Bengaluru’s Popular VV PURAM FOOD STREET PT 1 | VB BAKERY, Mosaru Kodubale, Bajji Chaats Chai & More
VB BAKERY.address: No.20, Sajjan Rao Cir, Vishweshwarapura, Shankarapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004

best_dishes.name: KHARA BUTTER AND CONGRESS KADLEKAI BUN
best_dishes.summary: A savory and buttery bun with the flavors of curry leaves, chili, and crunchy peanuts, reminiscent of an Iyengar-style peanut butter sandwich.

best_dishes.name: BUN BUTTER JAM
best_dishes.summary: A nostalgic treat featuring a milk powder bun filled with raisins and generously spread with butter and mixed fruit jam.

best_dishes.name: HONEYCAKE
best_dishes.summary: A dense and sticky honey cake made with pure Coorg honey, offering a delightful contrast in textures with a spongy top and a sugary honey-infused bottom.

New Govind Rao Military Hotel.title: MUTTON PULAV, PEPPER CHICKEN, KHEEMA UNDE At New Govind Rao Military Hotel| 110-Year Military Hotel!
New Govind Rao Military Hotel.address: Opp Sudha Lodge, No 7, Cottonpet Main Road, Chickpet, Bengaluru 560 053

best_dishes.name: KHEEMA UNDE
best_dishes.summary: The unde or meat ball is made of finely minced mutton mixed with a bit of fat and sinew. you can taste the roasted gram flour/ binder in the mixture too. this takes away from the meat flavour but a tasty dish nonetheless.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON LIVER FRY
best_dishes.summary: The liver itself tastes fine, but with topped with that well roasted masala, this dish tastes robust and complete!

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN PEPPER DRY
best_dishes.summary: Chicken that is big in flavour! the pepper and roasted spice masala coating is fingerlicking good.

best_dishes.name: CHILLI CHICKEN
best_dishes.summary: This chicken is cooked tender with a nice chilli heat that’s not overpowering. a great combo with the mellow pulao.

New Govind Rao Military Hotel.summary: New Govind Rao Military Hotel in Bangalore is a legendary establishment serving authentic Bangalore Non-vegetarian cuisine for over 110 years.  The restaurant is popular for its unique Mutton Pulav where the rice is cooked in meat stock, Kheema Unde, Mutton Liver Fry and flavorful Chicken dishes.  A must-visit for anyone looking for a taste of Bangalore's rich culinary heritage.

Holiday Inn Resort Goa.title: Must Try BREAKFAST DISHES In GOA |ROS OMELETTE & POI |GOAN SAUSAGE |MOOGACHI GAATI |FISH CROQUETTES

best_dishes.name: ROS OMELETTE
best_dishes.summary: Signature Goan breakfast of a fluffy masala omelette served in a flavourful, spicy xacuti gravy. A wonderful way to enjoy your eggs. Best eaten with the dry yet pillowy poi.

best_dishes.name: MOOGACHI GAATI
best_dishes.summary: this Goan style sprouted moong curry is a great vegetarian breakfast option. Perfect to be mopped with some poi.

best_dishes.name: GOAN SAUSAGE CHILLI FRY
best_dishes.summary: gently sauteed with onions a copious amount of capsicum and chilli, this Goan sausage preparation is delicious. You taste the mellow tartness of the vinegar in this dish.

best_dishes.name: FISH CROQUETTES
best_dishes.summary: a happy surprise for breakfast, these croquettes are made with King fish that imparts a lovely flavour together with the chilli and coriander! Not greasy at all.

Holiday Inn Resort Goa.summary: Join Food Lovers’ Editor, Kripal Amanna in Goa as he explores the best breakfast dishes the region has to offer. In this video, Kripal visits Holiday Inn Resort Goa and indulges in a lavish Goan breakfast spread prepared by Chef Anthony Vaz. From the staple Ros Omelette served with classic xacuti gravy to the must-try spicy Goan Sausage, fish croquettes, and more, this video is a visual and culinary treat.  What sets this video apart is the focus on authentic Goan cuisine and the personal touch of having a food expert guide viewers through the experience.

Subhan Bakery.title: Visiting SUBHAN BAKERY For FAMOUS DUM KE ROAT| OSMANIA & CHAND BISCUITS| Popular Bakery In Hyderabad
Subhan Bakery.address: 11-6-467, Nampally Market Rd, Devi Bagh, Bazar Ghat, Lakdikapul, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001

best_dishes.name: SPECIAL DUM KA ROAT
best_dishes.summary: this rich cookie is a muharram specialty at subaan. it is soft and chewy on the inside. you taste the delicious richness of the ghee right away followed by the crunch of nuts. this is one decadent cookie!

best_dishes.name: OSMANIA BISCUITS
best_dishes.summary: a popular chai time snack, especially with the irani chai, osmania biscuits have a distinct salty-sweet flavour. the delicate crust melts on the palate giving way to buttery notes that linger.

best_dishes.name: MOON/ CHAND BISCUITS
best_dishes.summary: this cookie is as crumbly as it gets. the cardamom aroma is so gentle yet so effusive on the palate.

Subhan Bakery.summary: This video is about the popular bakery in Hyderabad, Subhan Bakery, known for its delicious baked goods. They are famous for their Muharram special Dum Ke Roat, a soft and chewy cookie with a rich ghee flavor and crunchy nuts. Other must-try items include the Osmania Biscuits, known for their salty-sweet flavor, and the crumbly Chand Biscuits with a gentle cardamom aroma. What makes this bakery unique is its traditional Hyderabadi baking, particularly the special Muharram delicacy, the Dum Ke Roat.

Hotel Nayaab.title: Feasting on NIHARI, BHEJA FRY, PAYA MASALA At HOTEL NAYAAB | TRADITIONAL HYDERABADI DELICACIES
Hotel Nayaab.address: 22-8-111 & 112, Nayapul Road, Nayapul, Nassir Complex, Charminar, Chatta Bazar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500002

best_dishes.name: Nihari
best_dishes.summary: A comforting dish perfect to be enjoyed on a nippy evening! You taste the nourishing goodness of the juices from meat bones and the warm spices. The thin veil of fat on top rounds off all flavours. The deep savouriness of fried onion and the fresh hit of coriander adds another layer to the nihari.

best_dishes.name: Malai Paya/ Paya Masala
best_dishes.summary: Definitely an indulgent take on the austere paya! The gravy is enriched with thick cream. The trotter itself is melt-in-the-mouth. Perhaps not for the purist.

best_dishes.name: Bheja Masala
best_dishes.summary: This bheja preparation is as light as air! It melts away leaving behind the delicious, custardy flavour of the brain. The masala is unctuous, smoky yet delicate in flavour.

best_dishes.name: Bheja Pepper Fry
best_dishes.summary: The gentle heat of the pepper creeps up the back of your throat. The bheja is cooked beautifully and the masala, heavy on pepper and coriander balances against the intense creamy bite of the brain.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Talahua
best_dishes.summary: The masala is reminiscent of an achari masala with its tart edge. It’s perfect to mop up with a piece of roti. The boneless mutton chunks are well cooked and have absorbed that masala.

best_dishes.name: Dal Fry
best_dishes.summary: This nourishing lentil curry is thick and rich. It is more of a south Indian style dal that is slightly tart, tempered with curry leaves and mustard.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Every grain of rice is separate and has absorbed the flavour of the meat. The meat itself has its flavour and a bit of its bite intact. One can also taste the robustness of the spices that have gone into this biryani. The salan has a mild pickling flavour note that helps break the rich spice notes of the biryani.

best_dishes.name: Qubani Ka Meetha
best_dishes.summary: This dessert is a tad syrupy. The malai with its richness helps balance out the overwhelming sweetness. The nuttiness from the apricot kernels pack twice the flavour of almonds and breaks the monotony of flavours.

Hotel Nayaab.summary: Hotel Nayaab, located in the bustling Chatta Bazaar in Old City, Hyderabad, is a culinary gem serving traditional Hyderabadi delicacies for over three decades. Highlighted dishes include their signature Nihari, a slow-simmered broth packed with flavors, and the melt-in-your-mouth Malai Paya. The restaurant prides itself on using traditional cooking methods and spices, evident in the rich aromas and robust flavors of their dishes. Hotel Nayaab offers an authentic taste of Hyderabad, making it a must-visit for food enthusiasts seeking a true culinary adventure

Food Pyramid.title: NAATU KODI PULUSU, GONGURA MUTTON, Kurnool Pot Biryani At FOOD PYRAMID | BANGALORE-HYDERABAD Highway
Food Pyramid.address: NH 44, Near Kothakota Town, Bangalore - Hyderabad Highway At 127 KM Stone towards Bangalore, Telangana 509381

best_dishes.name: NATUKODI PULUSU WITH RAAGI SANGATI
best_dishes.summary: The naati chicken is cooked to a tender texture in this hot, spicy, sour curry! you can feel the heat on the palate multiply with each bite!! the soft sangati, perfect to be drenched in this flavourful curry, makes for a wholesome accompaniment.

best_dishes.name: GONGURA MUTTON CURRY
best_dishes.summary: This is a rustic preparation that encapsulates the flavour of the region. the sour spinach or sorrel hits you right away. the meat is cooked nice and soft with generous bits of fat and has absorbed the sour punch of the gongura through and through.

best_dishes.name: KURNOOL KUNDA CHICKEN BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: This dish has a very smoky aroma, making it a tad overbearing. the rice is however, cooked beautifully with each grain separate. the chicken is soft and has absorbed all the flavor of the masala. the biryani tastes better with the accompanying salan.

Food Pyramid.summary: Food Pyramid, located on the Bangalore-Hyderabad highway, is a great place to stop for a meal.  It has a large rest area and delicious food options, with a large list of local fare to choose from. The highlight of the restaurant is its Telugu-style dishes, especially the Natukodi Pulusu, a sour and spicy chicken curry.

Hotel Shadab.title: A Taste Of Old Hyderabad | HYDERABADI DUM KA BIRYANI At SHADAB | Chicken, Mutton Biryani |Boti Kebab
Hotel Shadab.address: 21-1-140-144, Near High Court, High Court Rd, Madina Circle, Charminar, Ghansi Bazaar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500012

best_dishes.name: MUTTON BOTI KEBAB
best_dishes.summary: This chatpata boti kebab has retained its juiciness and a bit of its meaty bite, a tad overdone on the colour though.

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: The masala threading through the rice is rich and flavourful, thanks to the copious amount of fried onion. The whole spices however is a little harsh and not very rounded in its flavour.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: This biryani packs a punch. The khada masala is much more pronounced in this dish but is well balanced and fully developed in its flavour. The meat is tender and yields with the gentlest of bite.

Hotel Shadab.summary: This video is about the Authentic Hyderabadi Biryani experience at Hotel Shadab, Hyderabad. Food Lovers’ Editor Kripal Amanna along with Chef Mohammed Iqbal samples a flavourful plate of Boti Kebab and both the chicken and mutton biryanis, the chef explains the intricacies and nuances of each dish. The highlight of the video is the tasting of the flavourful dishes and the detailed explanation of the dishes by the chef.

Ulavacharu.title: Tasting POPULAR PULAOS At ULAVACHARU Hyderabad|Andhra, Telangana Food|RAJU GARI PULAO|BAMBOO CHICKEN
Ulavacharu.address: 2-1/6 & 2-1/6/A, 1st Floor, 133, Fantasy Square Building, Old Mumbai Highway, Opposite Nissan Showroom, Biodiversity Circle, Gachibowli, Jayabheri Pine Valley, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032

best_dishes.name: BAMBOO CHICKEN
best_dishes.summary: this chicken is cooked in a fresh, tangy herb marinade and steamed in a bamboo shell. the masala has penetrated all the way into the chicken. the meat is juicy but a wee bit powdery in its texture.

best_dishes.name: BANGLA KODI
best_dishes.summary: an interesting appetiser of chicken encased in a thick slice of potato that is marinated in a red spice paste and deep fried. almost resembles a mini taco! the slightly underdone potato adds a textural crunch.

best_dishes.name: RAJU GARI KODI PULAO
best_dishes.summary: this is unlike any biryani/ pulao i have ever tasted! the consistency is that of a khichdi or rice and gravy mixed together. the pulao is flavoured with pepper, whole spices and green chilli takes some getting used to, the chicken is here just to support the flavourful rice.

best_dishes.name: GUTHIVANKAYA PULAO
best_dishes.summary: a refreshing take on a vegetarian pulao or biryani. this masaledar pulao has an eggplant gravy ladled on the rice. the eggplant adds a meaty bite to the dish.

best_dishes.name: RAYALA VARI KODI PULAO
best_dishes.summary: cooked with a masala made of sorrel leaves/ sour spinach or gongura as it is popularly known in the region, this pulao is unique in its flavours. you taste the sour notes in the rich masala and chicken.

best_dishes.name: RAJAHMUNDRY ROSE MILK
best_dishes.summary: thick, rich milk infused with a sweet rose syrup. difficult to down an entire glass!

best_dishes.name: JUNNU
best_dishes.summary: this milk pudding is rich and creamy. visualise lightly sweetened khova in a custard form.

Ulavacharu.summary: Ulavacharu in Hyderabad is a popular restaurant serving Andhra, Telangana, and Rayalseema cuisine.  They are famous for their unique pulaos, with 18 varieties, each offering distinct flavors. The restaurant is praised for its unconventional dishes such as Bamboo Chicken and Bangla Kodi.  Their signature pulaos, like the Raju Gari Kodi Pulao and Rayala Vari Kodi Pulao, are highlighted for their unique flavors and use of ingredients like eggplant and gongura leaves.  Ulavacharu offers a unique dining experience with its take on traditional recipes.

G PULLA REDDY SWEETS.title: Visiting 75-Year Old G PULLA REDDY SWEETS Kurnool|MOST POPULAR SWEET SHOP Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
G PULLA REDDY SWEETS.address: G Pulla Reddy Sweets, Old Bus Stand Rd, N R Peta, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh 518001

best_dishes.name: KHOVA PURI
best_dishes.summary: This puri is flaky with layers of dough stuffed with creamy khova or cooked milk solids. The buttery goodness of the ghee makes you want to keep going back for a bite.

best_dishes.name: SUGAR POOTHAREKULU
best_dishes.summary: There’s nothing quite like this sweet creation that resembles and feels exactly like paper! These thin sheets are made of rice flour and ghee is stuffed with sugar. It disappears the minute it hits your palate!

best_dishes.name: JAGGERY POOTHAREKULU
best_dishes.summary: This version of the paper sweet is lined with bits of jaggery. Its taste has much more of an earthy sweetness. A delightful find at g pullareddy!

best_dishes.name: KHOVA
best_dishes.summary: Can taste light, toasty caramelized notes in the milk of the khova or reduced milk solids. A simply yet soul satisfying dessert.

G PULLA REDDY SWEETS.summary: This video is about the legendary G Pulla Reddy Sweet Shop in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. Established in 1948, this shop is renowned for its commitment to quality, using pure ghee in all its sweets.  The video highlights the shop's history and its most popular offerings,  praising the  Khova Puri, Mysore Pak, Badusha, and the incredibly thin Sugar Pootharekulu. The unique selling point emphasized is the shop's dedication to tradition and the use of pure ghee, resulting in rich and flavorful sweets.

Brahmin\u2019s Soda Factory.title: Mysore’s OLDEST Soda & Ice Cream Shop | 80-Year-Old Brahmin’s Soda Factory | Homemade Ice Cream
Brahmin\u2019s Soda Factory.address: Kali Temple St, Devaraja Mohalla, Mandi Mohalla, Mysuru, Karnataka 570001

ginger milk.summary: The refreshing cold milk has a touch of sweetness while the spicy warmth of the ginger envelopes your throat.

Sarsaparilla soda.summary: slightly medicinal, herbal flavour coupled with the spritzy soda. definitely an acquired taste. said to be good for the stomach and aids digestion.

lime masala soda.summary: Very refreshing combination of lime and the masala. Definitely wakes you up!

homemade vanilla ice cream.summary: The vanilla notes in this homemade ice cream is quite pronounced; texture-wise, it’s halfway between a gelato and sorbet

Brahmin\u2019s Soda Factory.summary: This video features Brahmin’s Soda Factory, a popular juice and ice cream parlor located in the heart of Mysore’s bustling market. Established in the early 1930s, this shop is known for its sodas, juices, homemade ice creams, and fruit salads. The shop's popularity is evident from the crowd it draws, especially during summer. A highlight of this shop is its use of a soda-making machine specially sourced from England. Kripal Amanna, Food Lovers Editor for Gourmet On The Road, visits this iconic spot to sample their offerings, including the Sarsaparilla soda, known for its medicinal benefits, a soothing ginger milk, and their homemade vanilla ice cream.

SIMPLY KODAVAS.title: Savouring the Taste Of Coorg In Mysore! SIMPLY KODAVAS | Pandi Curry | Chicken Curry | Pork Biryani
SIMPLY KODAVAS.address: 6th Main Rd, Manchegowdana koppalu, Vijayanagar 1st Stage, Vijayanagar, Mysuru, Karnataka 570 017

best_dishes.name: Pandi curry
best_dishes.summary: A finger-lickingly good pork dish with roasted spices, fresh coriander, the tartness of the kachampuli and a peppery heat.

best_dishes.name: Pork chilli
best_dishes.summary: The fat in this is spicy and flavourful! pork melts in your mouth and the delicious fat coats your palate. You have the deep brown roasted spices, a slight tartness from the kachampuli or coorgi vinegar, and the spice of the green chilli that lingers on the palate. a satisfying preparation!

best_dishes.name: Chicken curry
best_dishes.summary: This curry definitely holds its own against the pork items in terms of flavour. Made with a spicy coconut base, the gravy has certainly been cooked for a while for the flavours to deepen!

SIMPLY KODAVAS.summary: This episode of Gourmet On The Road features Simply Kodavas, a family-run restaurant in Mysore serving authentic Kodava cuisine.  Food Lovers’ Editor Kripal Amanna samples classic dishes like Pandi Curry, Pork Chilli and Chicken Curry, all featuring the distinct flavours of kachampuli. He also tries unique offerings like Pork Biryani and Pork Kebab, accompanied by traditional rice staples like Kadamputtu, Noolputtu and Paaputtu. The highlight of the restaurant is its commitment to preserving traditional Kodava flavours, making it a must-visit for those seeking an authentic culinary experience.

La Uppu.title: Tasting A Vegetarian MYSORE THALI & Non-Vegetarian KARNATAKA THALI At La Uppu | Grand Mercure Mysore
La Uppu.address: Grand Mercure Mysore, 2203/60 Nelson Mandela Circle, New Sayyaji Rao Rd, Mysuru, Karnataka, 570021

best_dishes.name: MYSORE BONDA
best_dishes.summary: mildly seasoned bonda. dunk it into the thili saaru to perk up its flavours

best_dishes.name: THILI SAARU
best_dishes.summary: there’s a puckering tartness in this rasam, gentle spice and slight, soothing sweetness in its flavours.

best_dishes.name: BALEKAI FRY
best_dishes.summary: raw banana fry with a nice masala coating. no-fuss, tasty, fried goodness.

best_dishes.name: BELE TAWE
best_dishes.summary: Thick, creamy lentil preparation with chilli, mustard and curry leaves. the kind that would perhaps be served in a typical Mysuru kitchen.

best_dishes.name: GORIKAYI PALYA
best_dishes.summary: Lightly tempered, this cluster bean preparation is delicious, savour it with the akki rotti.

best_dishes.name: BADNEKAYI GOJJU
best_dishes.summary: loaded with onions, the flavours of the masala make this brinjal dish shine!

best_dishes.name: CHITRANA
best_dishes.summary: a satisfying rice preparation, flavoured with tumeric, onions and lemon juice.

best_dishes.name: BISI BELE BATH
best_dishes.summary: a tasty bisi bele bath! the rice is fortified with lentils and a gentle warmth from the red chilli. the ghee on top makes this dish all the more irresistible!

best_dishes.name: KOSAMBARI
best_dishes.summary: the kosambari is quite generous in its use of grated coconut. perfect palate refresher in between tasting all the dishes on the thali.

best_dishes.name: MOSARANNA
best_dishes.summary: the cool yoghurt and mild tempering makes the mosaranna the best way to end an all vegetarian meal.

best_dishes.name: MYSORE PAK
best_dishes.summary: all the ghee makes this mysore pak melt in the mouth!

best_dishes.name: GODHI PAYASAM
best_dishes.summary: the best part to this wheat payasam is that it isn’t very sweet. it’s a light dish for a dessert, not leaving you feeling too heavy!

best_dishes.name: MUTTON DONNE BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: the rice in this biryani is very mellow in its flavours. you taste the signature donne masala or spicing but this isn’t overly powerful. the meat is soft and tender, cooked really well!

La Uppu.summary: The video features La Uppu restaurant at Grand Mercure Mysore, known for its traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian thalis. The host tries two thalis - Mysuru Thali (vegetarian) and Karnataka Thali (non-vegetarian). The Mysuru Thali features dishes like Bisi Bele Bath, Mysore Bonda, and Mysore Pak, while the Karnataka Thali includes Donne Biryani and Gorikayi Kara.  The highlight of the restaurant is its authentic Mysore and Karnataka thalis with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, offering a taste of the region's culinary heritage.

Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.title: Popular Breakfasts Bengaluru Mysuru Highway|Bidadi THATTE IDLI|Shivalli KADUBU|Maddur Tiffany's VADA
Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.address: Mysore Road, Near police Station, Bidadi, Karnataka 562109

best_dishes.name: THATTE IDLI
best_dishes.summary: These idlis are springy and very soft! they have a slight sour edge but eaten with that butter, it tastes heavenly! the chutneys served have a fiery, spicy bite to jolt your tastebuds awake!

best_dishes.name: MASALA VADE
best_dishes.summary: Masala vada has a crispy, crunchy bite of the lentils along with the sweetness of onion and the surprise herbaceous note of dill.

best_dishes.name: UDDINA VADA
best_dishes.summary: Crispy and very lightly seasoned.

Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.summary: This video reviews the best breakfast spots on the Bengaluru-Mysuru Highway. Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli, a small joint just off the highway in a town called Bidadi, is highly recommended for its Thatte Idli, described as springy, soft, and slightly sour, best enjoyed with butter and spicy chutneys.

Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.title: Popular Breakfasts Bengaluru Mysuru Highway|Bidadi THATTE IDLI|Shivalli KADUBU|Maddur Tiffany's VADA
Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.address: Mysore Road, Near police Station, Bidadi, Karnataka 562109

best_dishes.name: Plate of Idli Vada
best_dishes.summary: A plate of soft and spongy idlis with a slight sour taste paired with crispy vadas.

best_dishes.name: THATTE IDLI
best_dishes.summary: Springy and soft idlis with a slight sour edge, served with butter and spicy chutneys.

best_dishes.name: MASALA VADE
best_dishes.summary: Crispy and crunchy vada with the sweetness of onion and a hint of dill.

best_dishes.name: UDDINA VADA
best_dishes.summary: Crispy vada with light seasoning.

Shri Renukambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.summary: Located on the Bengaluru-Mysuru Highway, this small joint is a must-visit for breakfast. Their Thatte Idlis are a must-try, known for their unique sour taste and soft texture. They are best enjoyed with their spicy chutneys and a dollop of butter. The Masala Vada, with its crispy texture and blend of sweet and savory flavors, is another highlight. For those who prefer a lighter option, the Uddina Vada, crispy and lightly seasoned, is a good choice.

Shri Renukhambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.title: Popular Breakfasts Bengaluru Mysuru Highway|Bidadi THATTE IDLI|Shivalli KADUBU|Maddur Tiffany's VADA
