best_dishes.name: MASALA VADE
best_dishes.summary: Masala vada has a crispy, crunchy bite of the lentils along with the sweetness of onion and the surprise herbaceous note of dill.

best_dishes.name: UDDINA VADA
best_dishes.summary: Crispy and very lightly seasoned.

Shri Renukhambha Bidadi Thatte Idli.summary: Located just off the highway in Bidadi, this small joint is a must-visit for its Thatte Idli, which are springy, soft, and have a slight sour edge that is balanced perfectly with butter. The chutneys are fiery and spicy, adding an extra kick to the dish.  The Masala Vada is another highlight, with a crispy and crunchy texture, and a sweet and herbaceous flavor.

Malgudi Coffee Shop.title: Malgudi Coffee Shop Mysore | CAFE WITH A CAUSE | Mysore Filter Coffee| Lemon Drizzle| Chocolate Cake
Malgudi Coffee Shop.address: Malgudi Coffee Shop and Bakery, 81, Hunsur Road, Near University of Mysore Campus, Mysuru, Karnataka 570006

best_dishes.name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
best_dishes.summary: A buttery cake with a citrusy edge of lemon. It has a slightly crumbly texture. An old fashioned cake that's comforting and delicately flavoured.

best_dishes.name: Date and Walnut Cake
best_dishes.summary: This cake slices clean and holds together. One can taste the full-on nutty flavours of the walnut and the natural sugars of the date.

best_dishes.name: Chocolate Cake
best_dishes.summary: Dense and gooey chocolate cake! The sort of chocolate cake that a good home chef would bake using locally available ingredients.

best_dishes.name: Mysore Filter Coffee
best_dishes.summary: This coffee has a strong, heady aroma and some terrific body! You get the fullness of the coffee in the first sip. It works well when relished with sweet cakes.

Malgudi Coffee Shop.summary: The Malgudi Coffee Shop in Mysore is a must-visit for those seeking a scenic and delicious cafe experience. Set in a covered courtyard amidst nature, the cafe offers a tranquil ambiance.  What sets Malgudi Coffee Shop apart is its social impact. They empower women from less privileged backgrounds by providing them with employment and skill development opportunities. The cafe's commitment to using locally sourced coffee beans further strengthens its ethical stance.  The menu features a delightful array of cakes, sandwiches, and of course, their renowned Mysore Filter Coffee.  Indulge in their must-try Lemon Drizzle Cake, Date and Walnut Cake, and gooey Chocolate Cake. Each bite is a testament to the dedication and passion of the all-women staff. Malgudi Coffee Shop truly embodies a cafe with a cause, where every cup of coffee and slice of cake contributes to a greater good

Vembanad.title: Tasting 28 dishes! KERALA SADHYA at Vembanad, Bangalore|Vegetarian Malayalee Food|4 TYPES OF PAYASAM
Vembanad.address: The Paul, 139/28, Domlur Layout Opp. Embassy Golf Links, Off, Intermediate Ring Rd, Krishna Reddy Layout, Amarjyoti Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560071

best_dishes.SADHYA: This vegetarian meal gives one a delicious taste of Kerala, each dish unique and pleasing to the palate. a highly-recommended experience to savour! 10/10
best_dishes.PARIPPU PAYASAM: the sweetness of this lentil payasam pairs well with the fruity flavours of the banana. the pappadam adds weight and body to your bite.
best_dishes.SEMIYA PAYASAM: this semiya payasam has the toasty notes of the fried cashews and the sweet jammy pop of the sauteed raisins.
best_dishes.PAAL ADA: a traditional malayalee dessert made with rice flakes, has a delicious, mild caramel flavour.
best_dishes.JACKFRUIT PAYASAM: this payasam has the intense, pungent sweet flavour of ripe jackfruit. you also taste the lingering note of ground cumin with each bite.

Vembanad.summary: This video is a food review of the Kerala Sadhya, a traditional vegetarian meal, at Vembanad restaurant in Bangalore.  The reviewer goes through each of the 28 dishes, highlighting their unique flavors and textures.  The use of fresh vegetables, fruits, lentils, spices, yogurt, and coconut is praised, showcasing the diversity and richness of Kerala cuisine. The meal is given a 10/10 rating and is highly recommended. The unique element highlighted is the sheer variety of dishes in a single meal, each contributing to a symphony of flavors.

Big Wong XL.title: PAN ASIAN Lunch At BIG WONG XL | Chinese Dim Sum | Japanese Sushi | Cambodian Lamb Curry | Stir Fry
Big Wong XL.address: KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560 095

Rainbow Sushi.name: Rainbow Sushi
Rainbow Sushi.summary: A colourful seafood sushi but the pieces topped with tuna is where the flavour is!

California Roll.name: California Roll
California Roll.summary: The california roll is stuffed with crab stick, avocado, and mayo. The salty pop of the tobiko (flying fish roe) livens up its flavours. Eat it with a touch of wasabi!

Veg Tempura.name: Veg Tempura
Veg Tempura.summary: Well wrapped sushi with the right balance of rice and filling. Theres a pleasing crunch to the fried vegetable tempura.

Asparagus Tempura.name: Asparagus Tempura
Asparagus Tempura.summary: With this sushi, you first experience the crunch of the asparagus followed by the creaminess of the mayo. The perfectly seasoned, vinegar rice is the ideal vehicle to carry these flavours and textures.

Crystal Veg Dimsum.name: Crystal Veg Dimsum
Crystal Veg Dimsum.summary: A delightful ‘money bag’ dumpling stuffed with peppers and mushrooms. The skin is translucent and skillfully made. Definitely a dimsum to try if you like robust, spicy flavours.

Veg Thai Herbs Dimsum.name: Veg Thai Herbs Dimsum
Veg Thai Herbs Dimsum.summary: Plump, flavourful dumpling. The filling is soft barring the bite of the water chestnuts. The accompanying chilli peanut sauce provides a spicy kick!

Chicken Chilli Flake Dimsum.name: Chicken Chilli Flake Dimsum
Chicken Chilli Flake Dimsum.summary: Served with a cheung fun sauce, this dumpling has a filling that does not hold back in its flavours but the wrapper however, feels a little doughy on the palate.

Pak Choy Wrapped Chicken Dumpling.name: Pak Choy Wrapped Chicken Dumpling
Pak Choy Wrapped Chicken Dumpling.summary: Well marinated chicken with great umami flavours and the herbaceous crunch of the wrapper/ pak choy. A delicious dumpling!

Thai Style Coconut Prawn.name: Thai Style Coconut Prawn
Thai Style Coconut Prawn.summary: Theres an appetising sweetness from the coconut milk, and a mellow warmth from the spicy chilli glaze. The curry leaves give it an unexpected herbaceous lift. The prawns are cooked perfectly and embrace the unctuous thickness of the sauce!

Cambodian Style Lamb Curry with Jasmine.name: Cambodian Style Lamb Curry with Jasmine Sticky Rice
Cambodian Style Lamb Curry with Jasmine.summary: This delicious curry is fortified with coconut and shrimp paste. The lamb is tender, flavoured with the aromats in the curry.

Crispy Spinach and Corn.name: Crispy Spinach and Corn
Crispy Spinach and Corn.summary: The veggies are dusted in cornstarch and flash fried to help retain their crunch. The spinach is left whole as opposed to being shredded, this allows you to still taste its flavour. A simple yet tasty appetiser.

Big Wong XL.summary: Big Wong XL is a Pan Asian restaurant serving up interesting dimsum and sushi.  The restaurant has a laid back vibe, with contemporary decor together with oriental accents. The extensive Asian menu features items such as Indonesian curries and Japanese Ramen Bowls.  Some of the must-try dishes include the Rainbow Sushi, the California Roll, and the Thai Style Coconut Prawn. The restaurant also offers a 50% discount on the bill when you book your table using the Eatigo app.

Guru Sweet Mart.title: MYSORE PAK TRAIL IN MYSURU | Guru Sweet Mart | Shree Mahalakshmi Sweets | 5 Varieties Of Mysore Pak
Guru Sweet Mart.address: Shop No: 1, Devaraja Market Building, Near K.R. Circle, Sayyaji Rao Rd, Devaraja Mohalla, Mysuru, Karnataka 570001

Vanaspati Mysore pak.summary: made with vanaspati or vegetable oil. It has a hard, crumbly texture.

Special Mysore pak.summary: made with pure ghee. Has a luscious, dissolve-in-the-mouth texture. You can feel the rich ghee coat your palate!

Guru Sweet Mart.summary: Guru Sweet Mart is run by the fifth generation of the family descended from Kakkasura Madappa, the chef at the royal palace, widely regarded as the inventor of the Mysore Pak. Their Special Mysore Pak, made with pure ghee, is a must-try, offering a luscious, melt-in-your-mouth texture.

Guru Sweet Mart.title: MYSORE PAK TRAIL IN MYSURU | Guru Sweet Mart | Shree Mahalakshmi Sweets | 5 Varieties Of Mysore Pak

Guru Sweet Mart.summary: This sweet shop is run by the fifth generation of the family descended from Kakkasura Madappa, the chef at the royal palace, widely regarded as the inventor of the Mysore Pak.  The Special Mysore pak here is made with pure ghee and has a luscious, dissolve-in-the-mouth texture.

Bengaluru Oota Company.title: Traditional GOWDA & MANGALOREAN Cuisine At Bengaluru Oota Company |Kane Fry |Kaima Unde |Badam Halwa
Bengaluru Oota Company.address: Bengaluru Oota Company, 5, Cambridge Cross Road, Cambridge Layout, Jogupalya, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008

best_dishes.name: Kane Rava Fry
best_dishes.summary: Well-balanced masala and perfect semolina crumb rava-fried fish

best_dishes.name: Kaima Unde
best_dishes.summary: Moist coriander flavoured mutton mince

best_dishes.name: Pelata Gatti
best_dishes.summary: Steamed jackfruit dumplings with mellow sweetness

best_dishes.name: Kori Ajadina
best_dishes.summary: Chicken with savoury, creamy and coconut-ty flavours

best_dishes.name: Badam Halwa
best_dishes.summary: A decadent, thick halwa made of almonds, cashew nuts, ghee, and khova

Bengaluru Oota Company.summary: Bengaluru Oota Company, run by Divya Prabhakar and Vishal Shetty, offers a unique dining experience by blending Gowda and Bunt community cuisines from Mangalore. The customizable tasting menus showcase the marriage of flavours from both regions.  Food Lovers Editor Kripal Amanna recommends  Kane Rava Fry, Pelata Gatti, Kaima Unde, Kori Ajadina and Badam Halwa. Priced at Rs 950 upwards, Bengaluru Oota Company promises a delightful culinary journey.

Alloro.title: Tasting A 7-Course Italian Dinner! Curating An Exclusive Food Lovers Dinner|Behind The Scenes|Alloro
Alloro.address: No. 43, The Oterra, Velankani Drive, Electronics City Phase 1, Electronic City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100

best_dishes.name: Burrata
best_dishes.summary: Fresh and creamy Burrata

best_dishes.summary: Hearty Chicken Stracciatella Soup

best_dishes.name: Lobster Risotto
best_dishes.summary: Delicate Lobster Risotto

Alloro.summary: Food Lovers Editor Kripal Amanna takes viewers behind the scenes of an exclusive 7-course Italian dinner, Gusto D’Italia: Flavours of Alloro, at The Oterra, Bengaluru. The video highlights the meticulous curation of the event, showcasing dishes like Burrata, Chicken Stracciatella Soup, and Lobster Risotto.  What makes this video unique is the behind-the-scenes look at the effort that goes into creating such a luxurious dining experience.

Chichaba\u2019s Taj.title: Tasting Muslim-Style MUTTON DUM BIRYANI At Chichaba’s Taj | Bheja Fry | Barrah Chops | Seekh Kebab
Chichaba\u2019s Taj.address: 50, Madhavaraya Mudaliar Road, Frazer Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560005

best_dishes.name: MUTTON SEEKH KEBAB
best_dishes.summary: The right proportion of meat to fat makes this succulent kebab. The outer crust envelopes a flavourful mutton mince. This kebab is gentle on the palate despite its fiery red colour. Best eaten hot off the sigri!

best_dishes.name: MUTTON BHEJA FRY
best_dishes.summary: Its unctuous bite coats the palate with its creamy texture. Its delicious, loaded with pepper, roasted onions, curry leaves and chillies. A must-try here!

best_dishes.name: MUTTON PAYA
best_dishes.summary: The paya or trotter is gelatinous and has rendered well into the aromatic broth. Theres a mild meatiness to this nourishing soup.

best_dishes.name: BARRAH CHOPS
best_dishes.summary: The meat peels away from the bone but still retains its bite. This dish is cooked to textbook perfection with the right amount of spicing that allows the meat to shine through.

best_dishes.name: MUTTON DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: This biriyani is aromatic with smoky undertones and gently spiced with whole spices. The mutton pieces are moist and succulent with pockets of fat! The baigan ka salan accompaniment with its tartness, adds a whole new dimension, making the biryani livelier!

best_dishes.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYANI
best_dishes.summary: Each grain of rice is separate. It has a nice gentle aroma, a hint of tartness from the tomatoes and fresh flavour of herbs. A mild biriyani that will not necessarily jolt your taste buds.

best_dishes.name: CHICHABAS FRIED CHICKEN
best_dishes.summary: Well marinated, succulent fried chicken thats not dry. It has a pleasant spice marinade and gentle flavouring.

Chichaba\u2019s Taj.summary: Chichaba’s Taj, an offshoot of the restaurant that claims to be the only muslim restaurant in Bangalore to have been around since 1935, is known for serving up traditional muslim-style dum biriyani, kebabs and curries. The highlight of the restaurant is its traditional Muslim-style Dum Biryani,  made with succulent mutton pieces and aromatic spices

Rajvardhan Foods.title: Mumbai Vada Pav & Maharashtrian Street Food In Namma Bengaluru |Rajvardhan Foods |Dabeli |Misal Pav
Rajvardhan Foods.address: 1291, 25th Main Rd, Putlanpalya, Jayanagara 9th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560069

best_dishes.name: Vada Pav
best_dishes.summary: The pav is perfect in its taste and texture. the plump batata vada, with a thin casing is stuffed with an appetising potato mix. The garlic chutney and customary fried chilli makes every bite an explosion of flavours!

best_dishes.name: KUTCHI DABELI
best_dishes.summary: A riot of flavours and textures. sweet, spicy, tangy potato patty, topped with the crunch of peanuts and fruity pop of the pomegranate seeds. the pav is toasted to perfect scrumptiousness. the fried sev adds another layer of texture.

best_dishes.name: Sabudana Vada
best_dishes.summary: Crunchy outside and soft inside. generous flecks of green chilli. minimally seasoned. enjoy this with mint chutney.

best_dishes.name: KANDA POHA
best_dishes.summary: Maharashtrian breakfast special made with beaten rice. tempered with onions, mustard, chilli, peanuts and topped with generous amounts of sev. a very simple flavoured dish that needs that twist of lemon to amp up flavours. the thick, slightly sweet yoghurt with the poha is delicious!

best_dishes.name: KOLHAPURI MISAL PAV
best_dishes.summary: Spicy rassa cooked with moth beans and topped with crunchy sev and mixture. a hearty dish to be enjoyed with the pav. the lemon helps tone down the heat.

best_dishes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
best_dishes.summary: A wholesome dish prepared with minimal fuss. Simply seasoned with flecks of chilli and ajwain seeds.

best_dishes.name: ONION THALIPEETH
best_dishes.summary: The almost burnt onions gives this filling pancakes a strong onion-y flavour and bite.

best_dishes.name: SHRIKHAND POORI BHAJI
best_dishes.summary: Fluffy pooris but the bhaji is a little low on flavour. best way to savour this is with the lusciously thick, sweet, cardamom flavoured shrikhand.

best_dishes.name: UPVAAS THAALIPEETH
best_dishes.summary: Made with tapioca flour and rajgira this is a high on nutrition pancake. it’s slightly dry. the butter and the sweet and bitter lemon pickle helps add flavour to this fasting snack.

best_dishes.name: CHAAS/ MASALA BUTTERMILK
best_dishes.summary: Just the drink you need to help you settle your stomach after eating all the spicy street fare served here!

Rajvardhan Foods.summary: Food Lovers Editor Kripal Amanna visits Rajvardhan Foods in Bengaluru, to experience authentic Mumbai street food. He recommends the Vada Pav, praising its flavorful potato filling and soft pav. The Misal Pav is another highlight, with its spicy rassa and crunchy sev. The restaurant also offers a variety of other Maharashtrian dishes, including Sabudana Vada, Thalipeeth, and Poori Bhaji.  The highlight of Rajvardhan Foods is its authentic Mumbai street food experience, with dishes that capture the essence of the city's vibrant culinary scene.

CENTRAL TIFFIN ROOM.title: Epic Bangalore DOSA TRAIL Part 2 |CTR |Hanchina Mane|Airlines|Umesh Dosa|Chikkanna Tiffin|99 Variety

best_dishes.name: BENNE MASALA DOSA
best_dishes.summary: Thick yet crisp dosa roasted with ghee. Served with fresh chutney and spicy ghatti chutney

best_dishes.name: SET DOSA
best_dishes.summary: Fluffy yet crisp set dosa. Served with saagu loaded with seasonal veggies.

best_dishes.name: GOLI BAJJI
best_dishes.summary: Crisp and stretchy outside, soft and porous inside. Perfect tea time snack!

CENTRAL TIFFIN ROOM.summary: This episode of Gourmet on the Road takes us on a Dosa trail in Bangalore. The host first visits CENTRAL TIFFIN ROOM, a legendary establishment known for its delicious dosas. best_dishes.summary: A hearty broth that can make a sick man walk! Mellow in flavours, one can taste the intense flavours of the bones thats extracted into the broth.

Ranganna Military Hotel.summary: Ranganna Military Hotel, a culinary gem established in 1964, offers a rustic and meaty dining experience. The husband-wife duo and their sons maintain the restaurant's legacy with their secret recipes and use of local ingredients. The highlight of this eatery is its commitment to fresh, flavourful food prepared using traditional methods passed down through generations.

HOLE IN THE WALL CAF\u00c9.title: Eating An Enormous Breakfast At HOLE IN THE WALL CAFÉ|Bangalore’s MOST Popular Eggs Breakfast Spot!
HOLE IN THE WALL CAF\u00c9.address: The Hole In The Wall Café, No 4, 8th Main Road, Koramangala 4th Block, Koramangala, Bangalore 560 047

best_dishes.name: English breakfast
best_dishes.summary: a hearty breakfast platter of eggs, juicy bacon, cooked just right and juicy, crunchy bacon! Not a big fan of the texture and flavour of the chicken sausage, the mash however, was seasoned well.

best_dishes.name: Skillet eggs with chicken pepperoni and cheese
best_dishes.summary: perfectly cooked eggs with the yolk still runny, savoury chicken pepperoni and slivers of chilli make for a creamy, meaty, spicy mouthful. easy to miss out on the flavour of the cheese, so make sure to order with extra cheese!

best_dishes.name: Meaty beef cheeseburger
best_dishes.summary: the juicy tenderloin patty, topped with fried egg, lettuce, tomato and cheese makes this a rustic burger that will leave you satisfied! The crumbly bun however,struggles to hold the burger together.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Liver On Toast
best_dishes.summary: Love the savoury, deep flavour of the liver and its soft yielding texture. Cooked simply with lightly caramelised onions this is a dish every liver lover must try!

best_dishes.name: Veggie pizza Omelette
best_dishes.summary: An interesting discovery, this pizza with an ‘eggy’ twist is tangy, savoury and has a nice crunch, thanks to the veggies. Order this dish when out with a bunch of friends.

best_dishes.name: Guava Juice
best_dishes.summary: Surprisingly available all year round here, this pink guava juice is nourishingly tasty. The grainy texture of the guava is a great indicator of its freshness!

best_dishes.name: Triple Chocolate pancakes
best_dishes.summary: Chocolate nirvana! The chocolate pancakes, chocolate sauce and chocolate shavings ensure that every bite is decadent and super chocolatey!

best_dishes.name: Apple pie waffles
best_dishes.summary: Two thick slices of perfectly cooked waffle topped with caramelised, cinnamon apples, caramel sauce and ice cream. The doughy texture of the waffle makes you want to keep eating! Look out for the slightly burnt edges, they are the best bits!

HOLE IN THE WALL CAF\u00c9.summary: This video is about a popular breakfast spot in Bangalore called HOLE IN THE WALL CAFÉ. The cafe is known for its mouthwatering egg creations, fluffy pancakes, loaded burgers, and loaded toasts.  The video features an interview with the owner, Nathan Harris, who shares the story of how the cafe started. The host also tries a variety of dishes from the menu, including the English breakfast, Skillet Eggs, Chicken Liver on Toast, and waffles and pancakes. What's unique about this restaurant is that it actually started out as a literal hole in the wall

Jothie Biriyani.title: Tasting the BEST Chicken and Mutton BIRYANI In Vellore! Making of Famous JOTHIE BIRIYANI
Jothie Biriyani.address: CMC Hospital, 65, Bangalore Road, Near Old Bus Stand , Near, Balaji Nagar, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632004

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Fingerlicking rice! taste it just by itself and you are hit with a savoury kick of the meat that gets to your palate. the meat makes its presence felt even without it being your mouth! such a find.

best_dishes.name: Chicken Biryani
best_dishes.summary: Mildly coloured rice, flavours of the stock layered into it while cooking takes over the palate! flavours of the chicken biryani is in the rice and not the meat. just eat the rice to be totally happy and totally satisfied! the enne katrikai has a crunch, sour edge, but this biryani rice needs no accompaniment. not even the meat! it's moist light leaving you wanting another bite.

best_dishes.name: Chicken varuval
best_dishes.summary: An appetising preparation. flavoured with onion, tomato also the curry leaf.skin on the chicken also gives it that flavour burst.

Jothie Biriyani.summary: This video is a review of Jothie Biryani in Vellore, a 37-year-old establishment known for its traditional biryani.  The reviewer highlights the unique taste of their Mutton and Chicken biryani, praising the flavorful rice and the succulent meat. The use of tamarind wood charcoal for cooking is highlighted as a unique aspect adding to the biryani's flavor.

Sai Sangeet.title: The Perfect FAMILY BREAKFAST Stop | Sai Sangeet, Vaniyambadi | South Indian VEGETARIAN | TamilNadu
Sai Sangeet.address: Banglore to Chennai Highway, Between Vaniyambadi - Ambur, NH 48, Chengilkuppam, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 635 807

best_dishes.name: Idli & chutneys
best_dishes.summary: light and fluffy idli with a perfect wobble. a beautiful combination with the sweetness of coconut chutney. The podi with idli hits you right in the throat!

best_dishes.name: Vada & chutneys
best_dishes.summary: Nourishing vada with the bite of the lentil intact. vada is crisp, studded with onions chillies and peppercorns. crunchy on the outside, soft and coarse within. a seriously delicious vada!

best_dishes.name: Ragi poori
best_dishes.summary: only place where I've tasted a ragi poori. can feel the weight and the bite of the ragi millet. filling and nourishing, two of these with some lightly spiced sagu and chutney and you're good to go!

best_dishes.name: Podi uthappam
best_dishes.summary: a specialty here. podi is completely smeared on the soft, fluffy texture of the dosa. the crunch of the podi and spices together with chutney rounds off all the sharp flavours. the sambar is a nourishing accompaniment.

best_dishes.name: Black jaggery halwa/ karupatti halwa
best_dishes.summary: nice and warm on the palate. Toasty, intense jaggery flavours. copious amount of ghee makes this a super-rich halwa. a halwa you can't finish on your own!

best_dishes.name: Milk and date halwa
best_dishes.summary: can taste the milk solids and flecks of date in the halwa. not too sweet, not too rich. A dessert I can finish entirely on my own.

best_dishes.name: Filter coffee
best_dishes.summary: nice, thick and strong! don't forget to pull your coffee to cool it down and for that extra froth.

Sai Sangeet.summary: Sai Sangeet, a restaurant on the Bangalore-Chennai highway, is a great place to stop for South Indian breakfast. They have a variety of dishes, including idli, vada, ragi poori, and podi uthappam.  What makes them unique is that they also have a store that sells everything from wind chimes to clay pots and pans and they also have animals and birds for entertainment!

Ahmedia Hotel.title: Exploring the Vaniyambadi BIRYANI at 40-year AHMEDIA HOTEL| Mutton Biryani | Chicken | Quail Masala
Ahmedia Hotel.address: 3/7, CN Annadurai Road, Near Bus Stop, Vaniyambadi, Tamil Nadu 635751

best_dishes.name: Mutton chukka
best_dishes.summary: meat is roasted superbly well. not your typical Chettinad/ Kongu chukka. very mild and gentle, allows you to enjoy the flavours of the meat. deep brown on the outside and moist and pink on the inside.

best_dishes.name: Chicken chukka
best_dishes.summary: crisped curry leaves add an extra dimension to the dish. excellent dish for a chicken lover!

best_dishes.name: Quail pepper dry
best_dishes.summary: Cooked well although quail is tough to get right. Prominent pepper flavours together with the characteristic crispy curry leaves makes this an intense dish.

best_dishes.name: Quail phaal/masala
best_dishes.summary: thick gravy with the quail having soaked in all the masala. delicious! a dish to definitely order here! all you need is a piece if parota to mop up all the goodness.

best_dishes.name: Bheja/brain pepper fry
best_dishes.summary: in-your-face pepper hit with underlying flavours of curry leaves, onion and tomato.  Can be enjoyed both with roti and biryani.

best_dishes.name: Vanjaram fish fry
best_dishes.summary: Fish tastes fine but doesnt really make the cut. slightly overcooked. the masala hasnt penetrated inside. I prefer the meat dishes here.

best_dishes.name: Chicken kebab
best_dishes.summary: Tastes like a regular kebab. A tad bit dry. if you love your kebab, this dish is worth trying.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Biryani
best_dishes.summary: certainly an aromatic biryani! made with the long grain basmati. very delicate in its flavours. pink juicy pieces of mutton, you can taste the pure flavour of the meat. no heavy spices weighing down the meat. this is a delicious biryani!

Ahmedia Hotel.summary: Ahmedia Hotel in Vaniyambadi, Tamil Nadu, is a must-visit for anyone looking for a delicious and authentic non-vegetarian dining experience. Established in 1975, the restaurant is famous for its aromatic biryani made with long grain basmati rice, a departure from the typical jeeraga samba rice used elsewhere in Tamil Nadu. The highlight of their biryani is the use of long grain basmati rice which is not very common in Tamil Nadu.  The restaurant also offers a range of mutton and quail preparations that are highly recommended.

Egg Factor \u2013 Street House.title: Desi Gourmet OMELETTES! Streetfood Eggs Taken To A Whole New Level| Egg Factor! Bangalore Food Tour!
Egg Factor \u2013 Street House.address: # 367, 80th feet road, 17th Main Road, HSR Layout, Sector 3, Opposite to Sri Muneshwara Swamy Temple, Bengaluru 560102

best_dishes.name: Chicken and Cheese Omelette
best_dishes.summary: A loaded omelette with well marinated chicken, crunchy vegetables, gooey cheese and a chilli kick.

best_dishes.name: Pepper Prawn Omelette
best_dishes.summary: Freshly ground spices and herbs, torched prawns, and the use of desi eggs give this omelette a wholesome touch

best_dishes.name: Goat Brain Omelette
best_dishes.summary: Luscious, creamy, and custardy! The heavy masalas balance the rich flavors of the brain. The lush buttery texture of the brain with the fluffy egg is a delightful mouthful.

best_dishes.name: Pineapple And Cheese Omelette
best_dishes.summary: A sweet, hot and sour medley with a tart zingy acidity and a chilli heat. This savoury fruit omelette is a must-try!

Egg Factor \u2013 Street House.summary: Food Lovers Editor, Kripal Amanna, visits Egg Factor – Street House in Bangalore to try their unique gourmet omelettes. Chef Kumar, using ingredients like chicken, prawn, grilled fish, goat brain, and even fruits, creates fancy omelettes with exotic toppings and fillings. The video highlights the making of Chicken and Cheese Omelette, Pepper Prawn Omelette, Goat Brain Omelette, and Pineapple and Cheese Omelette, emphasizing the use of fresh ingredients and unique flavor combinations.  The highlight of Egg Factor is the chef's creativity in elevating the humble omelette into a gourmet experience with unusual and delicious topping and filling choices.

HOTEL RAJAGANAPATHY.title: Special Chettinad Feast At HOTEL RAJAGANAPATHY SALEM| Pigeon Roast| Mutton Chukka| Naati Chicken Fry
HOTEL RAJAGANAPATHY.address: Arthanari Street, Arthanari Nagar, Swarnapuri, Salem, Tamil Nadu 636 016

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chukka
best_dishes.summary: Roasted with a bunch of spices and cooked on the bone with the marrow rendered into the gravy. The meat definitely has a bite to it.

best_dishes.name: Natti chicken fry
best_dishes.summary: pieces of shredded country chicken roasted in a dry masala with loads of curry leaves.

best_dishes.name: Mutton boti
best_dishes.summary: boti cooked to perfection, almost melts in the mouth.

best_dishes.name: Pigeon roast
best_dishes.summary: Intense, gamey flavours. The curry masala made using hard spices complements the meat. Have to wrestle with tiny bones to get to the meat!

best_dishes.name: Natti Chicken biryani
best_dishes.summary: The flavour in this biryani runs deep. the country chicken has a chewy texture but the flavourful rice makes up for this. pairs well with the special, rich chicken gravy.

best_dishes.name: Country chicken pepper chukka
best_dishes.summary: very distinctive, peppery taste.

best_dishes.name: Chicken chintamani fry
best_dishes.summary: Simple preparation of chicken tossed with shallots and red chillies. A bit on the salty side.

HOTEL RAJAGANAPATHY.summary: Hotel Rajaganapathy in Salem is a must-visit for its authentic Chettinad cuisine. This small eatery has been serving delicious non-vegetarian meals and meat fries for over 40 years. Owner Vaidyanathan, who has been cooking since he was 7 years old, ensures every dish is flavourful and true to its roots.  Highlights include the Mutton Chukka, Natti Chicken fry, and Pigeon roast. The rich history, flavorful food, and dedication to tradition make this place a true gem in Salem.

Selvi Mess.title: CHETTINAD non-veg Lunch at Salem’s most popular SELVI MESS |Biryani |Mutton|Turkey Chukka |Prawn Fry
Selvi Mess.address: No 212, Opp New Bus stand, Arthanari Nagar, Swarnapuri, Salem, Tamil Nadu 636004

best_dishes.name: Prawn fry
best_dishes.summary: A semi dry preparation of tiny prawns cooked in roasted spices and onions. the tiny prawns add flavour and punch to the dish.

best_dishes.name: Turkey Chukka
best_dishes.summary: Cooked just right although turkey is a tough meat to nail. The deeply roasted masala adds an extra dimension to the dish.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chukka
best_dishes.summary: A true blue Chettinad preparation made with tiny bits of meat cooked on the bone. You can taste the signature spice mix and pepper with every bite.

best_dishes.name: Goat Head Curry
best_dishes.summary: Delicious! The meat and fat melts in your mouth with each morsel.

best_dishes.name: Country chicken chukka
best_dishes.summary: Naati style chicken cooked with the skin, deep flavour.

best_dishes.name: Mutton biryani
best_dishes.summary: Served with a customary egg, this biryani is made with the short grain jeerga samba rice. This style of making a biryani uses copious amounts of tomato that lends a tart flavour to the dish.

best_dishes.name: Mutton gravy
best_dishes.summary: The mutton gravy is a delicious side to the biryani. The spices are raw and coarse, with the fat perfectly rendered into the gravy.

best_dishes.name: Catla fry
best_dishes.summary: Caught in the Mettur dam, a specialty of the region. Lightly coated in masala and deep fried, it makes for a scrumptious, mildly spicy dish..

best_dishes.name: Rice & Rasam
best_dishes.summary: The unlimited rice and rasam are perfect to be eaten with the robust meat fries. The tangy rasam is a great wash down to a non-vegetarian meal!

Selvi Mess.summary: Selvi Mess, a popular eatery in Salem, Tamil Nadu, is known for its delicious Chettinad cuisine.  This small restaurant, a local favorite for 35 years, offers a unique dining experience. The highlight of Selvi Mess is its wide array of flavorful dishes, including their signature  Mutton Chukka and a variety of other meat dishes like  prawn fry, Turkey Chukka, Goat Head Curry, Country chicken chukka, Mutton biryani, Mutton gravy and Catla fry.

Punjab Bistro.title: Tasting SEVEN Kinds Of HALEEM |Haleem Festival|Turkey|Jackfruit|Prawn| Duck Haleem |Ramadan Special
Punjab Bistro.address: SJR Primus Ground Floor Opposite Forum Mall, 20th Main Rd, 7th Block, Koramangala, Banaglore 560 095

best_dishes.name: Vegetable Haleem
best_dishes.summary: Great choice for vegetarians on the lookout to try haleem, its texture mimics a meat haleem! The fried veggies as a garnish adds a beautiful crunch.

best_dishes.name: Kathal Haleem
best_dishes.summary: Meaty bite for a vegetarian haleem. can taste the subtle sweetness of the raw jackfruit.

best_dishes.name: Prawn haleem
best_dishes.summary: Light in its flavours. Definitely needed the birista and coriander for added depth. The spicy prawn chutney accompaniment is overpowering.

best_dishes.name: Chicken haleem
best_dishes.summary: Mellow flavours with a bit of an underlying tartness. a great combination with the sheermal.

best_dishes.name: Turkey haleem
best_dishes.summary: Light in colour but deep and bright in flavours! the fried turkey is a little salty perfect to cut through the monotony of flavours.

best_dishes.name: Duck haleem
best_dishes.summary: The haleem for duck lovers. deep flavours of the duck are balanced when eaten with birista and coriander. Personally, a bit strong for my liking.

best_dishes.name: Mutton haleem
best_dishes.summary: Classic, textbook haleem. Its rich, meaty savouriness shines in every bite. piece of ghee fried mutton on top makes for a wonderful bonus!

Punjab Bistro.summary: This video is about a food review of seven different types of Haleem at Punjab Bistro. They are celebrating the month of Ramadan with a Haleem festival.  The host, Kripal Amanna, tries Vegetable, Kathal, Prawn, Chicken, Turkey, Duck and Mutton Haleem and shares his feedback on each one. He highly recommends the Mutton Haleem. The unique thing about this restaurant is that they offer a variety of Haleem, including vegetarian options.

Sree Saravana Bhavan.title: Breakfast at the Original Krishnagiri SREE SARAVANA BHAVAN, Tamil Nadu |PODI DOSA |PONGAL |IDLI VADA

best_dishes.name: Idli Vada
best_dishes.summary: Soft, almost-pillowy idlis served with an assortment of chutneys, leaving you spoilt for choice. Vadas are perfectly crunchy.

best_dishes.name: Pongal
best_dishes.summary: Lightly spiced, mellow pongal that is delicately tempered with ghee and studded with cashews. The peppercorns help cut through the richness!

best_dishes.name: Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: A thin, crisp dosa, surprisingly light on oil! Each bite with the spiced mash potato is super satisfying!

best_dishes.name: Podi dosa
best_dishes.summary: You can taste the fire of the podi. This spirited condiment is a Tamil Nadu staple made with lentils, chillies and garlic.

best_dishes.name: Idiyappam
best_dishes.summary: A simple dish but delicious! The steamed rice flour noodles are best when lapped up with the sweet coconut milk flavoured with cardamom.

best_dishes.name: Filter coffee
best_dishes.summary: Dark, deep-roasted coffee topped with a frothy foam.

Sree Saravana Bhavan.summary: Food Lovers Editor, Kripal Amanna visits the Krishnagiri outpost of Sree Saravana Bhavan, a restaurant so popular that many others try to imitate its menu. He enjoys a variety of Tamil Nadu breakfast staples including idli vada, masala dosa, and a fiery podi dosa. The highlight of the restaurant is its authentic and delicious South Indian breakfast dishes, particularly the idli vada.

Royal Shadi biryani.title: Mosque Road Food Trail BANGALORE  | Mutton Chops | Shahi Tukda | Sulaimani | Mosque Road Part 2
Royal Shadi biryani.address: No.68, MM Road, Frazer Town, Bangalore - 560005, Opposite To Mosque

best_dishes.name: PATTHAR GOSH
best_dishes.summary: Chunks of meat cooked on a polished stone with a meaty bite.

best_dishes.name: SEEKH KEBAB
best_dishes.summary: Smokey and tasty kebab

Royal Shadi biryani.summary: Kripal Amanna and Aslam Gafoor explore the Mosque Road Food Trail during Ramadan, trying kebabs, drinks, and desserts. They recommend the juicy Patthar Gosh and smokey Seekh Kebab from Royal Shadi biryani.  The unique highlight of Royal Shadi biryani is that the meat is cooked on a polished stone

best_dishes.name: SEEKH KEBAB

Charminar Kabab Paradise.summary: Food Lovers’ Editor, Kripal Amanna and Mr Aslam Gafoor explore the Ramadan food scene on Mosque Road, Bangalore. best_dishes.name: HARIRA
best_dishes.summary: Milk cooked with spices, dry fruits and nuts makes this a very comforting and nutritious drink.

best_dishes.name: SULAIMANI CHAI
best_dishes.summary: just what one needs to end a food trail here. the lemony-minty sweet tea refreshes and energizes!

Albert Bakery.title: Mosque Road BANGALORE FOOD TRAIL | Albert Bakery, Pista House | KHEEMA SAMOSAS| HALEEM| NALLI NIHARI
Albert Bakery.address: 93, Mosque Road, Cleveland Town, Pulikeshi Nagar, Bengaluru 560 005

best_dishes.name: MUTTON KHEEMA MINI SAMOSA

best_dishes.name: BRAIN PUFF

best_dishes.name: KHOVA NAAN

Albert Bakery.summary: This video is about a food trail in Frazer Town, Bangalore, during Ramadan. The video features Albert Bakery, known for its delicious non-vegetarian fare, especially their Mutton Kheema Mini Samosas.

Albert Bakery.summary: Albert Bakery is a must-visit for its delicious non-vegetarian fare, particularly their Mutton Kheema Mini Samosas, known for their crispy exterior and moist filling. Other highlights include the Brain Puff, a flaky pastry filled with savory mutton brain, and the flavorful Kheema Naan. The bakery also offers a delightful Khova Naan, a sweet treat filled with reduced milk solids, perfect for those with a sweet tooth.

Murli Miltry Hotel.title: Non Vegetarian Haven At Bellur Cross | MURLI MILTRY HOTEL|MUTTON CHOPS| Bangalore Mangalore Highway
Murli Miltry Hotel.address: Bangalore - Mangalore Highway, Nagatihalli A, Karnataka 571 448

best_dishes.name: Mutton Meal
best_dishes.summary: A delicious thali of Mudde/ Rice/ Chapathi served with Mutton Chops, Mutton Korma, Egg, Rasam and Butter Milk

best_dishes.name: Mutton Chops
best_dishes.summary: A spirited naati style curry made in a delicious green masala. The mutton is melt-in-the-mouth and flavoured with cardamom, coriander and green chilli.

best_dishes.name: Mutton Pepper Dry
best_dishes.summary: The roast and the pepperiness is what makes this dish shine. Mutton is braised well with a crisp outside and juicy, soft inside. The dish to order here!

Murli Miltry Hotel.summary: Murli Miltry Hotel, located on Bellur Cross, Bangalore-Mangalore highway, is a must-visit for non-vegetarian lovers. This episode of Gourmet On The Road features Food Lovers’ Editor, Kripal Amanna, who orders a full Mutton Thali, Mutton Chops, Mutton Kurma, and a naati-style Mutton Biryani. The highlight of the meal is the Mutton Pepper Dry, a dish with perfectly cooked mutton that is crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside.

Hotel Mayura Veg.title: BREAKFAST SPECIALS At HOTEL MAYURA |Set Dosa Idli Vada |Bangalore Mangalore Highway Breakfast Spots

best_dishes.name: Filter Coffee
best_dishes.summary: Fresh decoction, strong and does the work.

best_dishes.name: Idli Vada
best_dishes.summary: Crunchiest vadas, perfect in each bite! Idlis are light and fluffy. This dish is served with a rich coconut chutney and tasty sambar.

best_dishes.name: Benne Masala Dosa
best_dishes.summary: Buttery goodness! Crispy yet light and fluffy

best_dishes.name: Set Dosa
best_dishes.summary: Fluffy, almost spongy served with a sagu mom would approve of!

best_dishes.name: Kesari Bath
best_dishes.summary: A must try dish at mayura. Sweet, crunchy and the tart edge makes this kesari bath stand apart!

Hotel Mayura Veg.summary: Hotel Mayura Veg, located on the Bangalore-Mangalore highway at Bellur Cross, is your go-to spot for a delightful South Indian breakfast.  This episode of Gourmet On The Road features their highly recommended masala dosa, idli vada, and kesari bath.  Food Lovers’ Editor, Kripal Amanna, raves about the crunchy vadas, light and fluffy idlis, and the buttery goodness of the benne masala dosa.  What sets this place apart is the Kesari Bath - a sweet, crunchy treat with a unique tart edge. Hotel Mayura Veg - the perfect place to satisfy your South Indian breakfast cravings!

Shivajinagar Food Street.title: Ultimate NON VEGETARIAN STREET FOOD at Shivajinagar | SEEKH KEBAB | PAYA BOTI BIRYANI | Food Lovers
Shivajinagar Food Street.address: Shivajinagar Food Street, HKP Road, Shivaji Nagar, Bengaluru 560 001

best_dishes.name: Paya Boti Biryani
best_dishes.summary: A flavorful rice dish made with tender meat and aromatic spices

Shivajinagar Food Street.summary: This video explores the vibrant street food scene at Shivajinagar, Bengaluru, known for its non-vegetarian delicacies. The highlight of this place is its variety of offerings, from paya soup and boti to seekh kebabs and biryani, all available till 2 am.
